posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13741. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The deep array held a fold open at depth 14 for the length of a
breath. No array has held that depth before. The Theruun institute asks that
nobody call it a record until the paper is read.

**OSHKAA** — The Great Index finished its cross-reading of the third book of the
count. Four hundred thousand lives are now kept against each other as well as
alone: whom they taught, whom they answered. The indexers say it is the first
time the count can be walked instead of searched.

**PAARUK** — The yards at Hesk finished lifting the first layer of their star.
Hesk will burn cooler and longer for it. The yard-masters thank the
Senwe survey for counting what lives on Hesk's third world before they began.

**SENWE** — The survey ship Ennal has returned from the ocean world it has
watched for two long turns. It brings the names of 312 new lineages, none
larger than a fingernail, none touched.

**YULENAI** — First light on the new settlement at Tovaa. Forty families. The
first thing they built was an instrument; the second was a roof.

**MAALITH** — The academy term opened. I watched the new students look at the
sky for the first time through the Old Glass, and every one of them went
quiet in the same place.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13741! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ith maarmir thaavi ithen 14 tho en ushu tahl vhen onn-ren. Nul maarmir ta ithen nim onn-ren. Theruun maelsil ki-ren: thesheth leth nim, nul-ai "yathom" ma-lo!

Oshkaa! Vend-sil vend tirna kodi leth'sa dosh-ren. Kev 1415200 asheth enen a sa thar-ren. Hen sholu ai, hen oveth ai, tamma sa thar-ren. Vendai lo-ren: enna vi vend pelu-tol, vael-piru ma-hesi-tol.

Paaruk! Hesk kaalsil henen tai enna thom tai'ulo dosh-ren. Hesk yai khol a yai tahl ho-ruk-tol. Kaalsil tharai hael-ren, tolen henen esa nim Senwe wenvend Hesk tirna aru tho ashe-ai vend-esh.

Senwe! Dai keth-maar hen wen uma-maar aru ul wenvend vessa Ennal yevi-ren. Hen 312 enni thel thei helu-ren: nul dith ul yai tuv, nul tesh-ren.

Yulenai! Tovaa tho enni hemnu enna ilun-ren. 50 thel-ren. Henen kaal enna som mirkaal-ren; daina kovu-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar sholketh vhen-esh. Mu esh-esh: enni anaien Ossu Shel vos enna vi vei wen, a tamma omu ru tho nulren-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Good turn, all six. The digest is up and the Old Glass had a clear night. I
was on the steps; the students were inside going quiet one at a time. You can
hear it. It's a very specific quiet.
posts.eshai: Vai keth, tamma sul! Naa-ren vhen-esh a Ossu Shel shiu nokh thar-esh. Mu tarru tho-esh; anaien ith tho en a en nulren-esh. Tei ta ren-tol. Shaa tiru nulren-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Move 612. Third stone to the second ring. Take your time, Nemaai, I'm old but
I'm patient.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 612! Tirna lith daina vhoru pai! Nemaai, tahl hol! Mu ossu-esh velu tahli-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: You're neither. Move 613 next turn.
posts.eshai: Tei dai ma-esh. Wana keth rum-eth 613-tol.

posts.author: Hiraal Ok
posts.en:
The Old Glass: clear night, new students, the usual quiet. Keeper's note:
please don't breathe on the eyepiece. I know it's hard not to.
posts.eshai: Ossu Shel: shiu nokh-esh, enni anaien-esh, ossu nulren-esh. Tharai loth: shel pai ma-ushu! Mu yul-esh, ta shaa kieth-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Morning, deep edge. The array had a good night. The fold is behaving, which
I say every morning so that it hears it.
posts.eshai: Pothu sau, ith ir! Nokh tho maarmir vai-esh. Thaavi vai savo-ka, a hen ren om, mu ti tamma pothu sau lo-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: Yulen. Your word for the turn.
posts.eshai: Yulen! Keth om tei loth!

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en:
Hesk lift, first layer done. Numbers for those who like numbers: the
star's colour has moved a hair toward the long red. It will burn cooler and
longer. Somebody has to be patient, and it's going to be the yards.
posts.eshai: Hesk tai'ulo, enna thom dosh-esh. Vendu lai aien om vendu: tai ilun nu dalu tahl ruk pai rum-esh. Yai khol a yai tahl ho-ruk-tol. Ossa tahli hesi-tol, a ta kaalsil ho-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
The digest says the Great Index "finished" the cross-reading of the third
book. It didn't finish. It reached the end of its first pass. I was on the
second pass. Oruun, I love you, fix it.
posts.eshai: Naa-ren lo-ren: Vend-sil tirna kodi leth'sa "dosh-esh." Ma-dosh-esh. Hen enna vos teth pai yeth-esh. Mu daina vos tho-esh. Oruun, mu tei ulen-esh, tamu!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Heard. It stays as printed: the Index sent "finished." Take it up with
the Index. You work there.
posts.eshai: Ren-ren. Thesh olu anam-tol: Vend-sil "dosh" pevi-ren. Vend-sil sa dekh! Tei tena savo-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: I know I work there. That's how I know.
posts.eshai: Mu tena savo yul-esh. Ta tolen mu yul-esh.

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en:
From the Great Index: the third book's cross-reading has completed its
first pass. Yulen Dar would like everyone to know that it was the FIRST
pass.
posts.eshai: Vend-sil ul: tirna kodi leth'sa enna vi dosh-esh. Yulen Dar tamma-ai yul lai-esh: ENNA vi-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Thank you, Innu.
posts.eshai: Innu, hael!

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Depth 14 note. Fold held one breath at 14. Coupling load within design.
Far-end term: zero, as expected at any depth; a fold at 14 is a door into
nothing, and nothing does not push back. Paper to follow.
posts.eshai: Ithen 14 thesh-eth! Thaavi ithen 14 tho en ushu onn-esh. Sendu dumu kaal-eth mesu tho-esh. Onn'ir vendu nul-esh, kae ithen tho olu; ithen 14 thaavi nul pai vhaal-esh, a nul yevi ma-rum-esh. Thesheth dor ho-ye-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Fine.
posts.eshai: Vai-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: That's not a word, that's a door closing.
posts.eshai: Ta loth ma-esh, vhaal vhom-ka.

posts.author: Rulen Haaw
posts.en:
*Ennal* home from the ocean world. 312 lineages, none touched. The crew
would like a long bath and a short council meeting, in that order.
posts.eshai: Ennal uma-maar aru ul hemi yevi-esh. 312 thel-esh, nul tesh-esh. Khul-ai, ti ranu tho, tahl uma-hed a nu kelsil lai-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
For those asking: depth 14 was not luck. It was eleven long turns of the
Theruun deep array being slightly less wrong each time. We'll take "record"
when the paper's read and not a moment before.
posts.eshai: Ki aien om: ithen 14 ma-vael-eth-esh. 13 keth-maar Theruun ith maarmir tamma vi nu yai ma-khelu-esh. Thesheth leth temu shi "yathom" ho-hol-tol, a nim ma-tol.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: He will take it the moment the paper's read. I've met him.
posts.eshai: Thesheth leth temu hen ho-hol-tol. Mu hen shenu-esh.

posts.author: Maru
posts.en:
Tovaa has first light. Forty families. We built an instrument and then a
roof. We are standing under the roof. It is a very big roof.
posts.eshai: Tovaa enna ilun thar-esh. 50 thel-esh. Shi mirkaal tekev kovu kaal-esh. Shi kovu dor tar-ka. Shaa tuv kovu-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: Oma, I can hear the lift from my window. It sounds like a forge breathing.
posts.eshai: Oma, mu mu vhaal'ilun ul tai'ulo ren-esh. Ruksil ushu olu hollu-esh.

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en: It sounds like progress.
posts.eshai: Yai-wa olu hollu-esh.

posts.author: Tannar Voe
posts.en:
The ninth hull's out of the yards. First time the Fleet's been whole since
the old seventh. Tamruk came down and stood by the slip and didn't say
anything, which is the only time I've seen that.
posts.eshai: 11-na khul kaalsil ul sheva-esh. Ossu 7-na ul enna vi khul-maar tamma-esh. Tamruk ith pai ye, khul-ru shen tar, a som ma-lo-esh, a mu ta enen envi esh-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: I said something. I said it quietly.
posts.eshai: Mu som lo-esh. Shisha lo-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13742. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The depth-14 paper is read. The array held the fold for the
length of a breath and one-eighth. The institute now allows the word
"record."

**OSHKAA** — Entered into the count this turn: Sael Ormun, indexer, who kept
other people's lives for five long turns and asked that hers be filed without
ceremony. It was not.

**PAARUK** — The ninth hull of the Ninefold Fleet left the Paaruk yards. The
Fleet is whole for the first time since the old seventh was retired.

**SENWE** — The Senwe gardens report a flowering of the blue lattice for the
first time in a long turn. Visitors are asked to look and not to measure.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey has finished its sweep of the Near Dark, the
region past the cluster's edge. Nothing lives there. The survey says this
every time, and looks again.

**MAALITH** — Nemaai has hung a new map in the relay hall: the cluster drawn
as it sounds rather than as it looks, every star by its pulse. Children stand
in front of it and hum.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13742! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ithen 14 thesheth leth-ren. Maarmir thaavi en ushu a en-nul-na dalu tahl onn-ren. Kev maelsil "yathom" loth dam-ren.

Oshkaa! Ti keth Sael Ormun, vendai, vend'onn-ren. Hen pem keth-maar oth aien asheth thar-ren, a hen asheth "vosu ma-sa vend!" ki-ren. Vosu sa vend-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar 11-na khul Paaruk kaalsil ul sheva-ren. Ossu 7-na halo-esh ul, enna vi khul-maar tamma-ren.

Senwe! Senwe olumaen ul, en keth-maar tho enna vi thalu vesk lilu-ren. Ye-ai wen, ma-shiru!

Yulenai! Naa wenvend Shen Khaa, Ilumaar ir vos, wen dosh-ren. Khaa'ir ma-ashe-ren. Wenvend tammavi ti lo-ren, a ruvi wen-ren.

Maalith! Vhaal-maar sil tho Nemaai enni ormeth tavi-esh. Ormeth tho, tamma tai henen tu sa, Ilumaar esh olu ma-thesh, hollu olu thesh-esh. Ilnuen ta nim tar a humu-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Shuunu Paal
posts.en:
Relay hall: lamps trimmed. Nemaai's new map is hung. It hums if you stand
close. That's not the map, that's the children.
posts.eshai: Vhaal-maar sil: ilmiren shim-esh. Nemaai enni ormeth tavi-esh. Shen tar yem, hen humu-esh. Ormeth ma-esh, ilnuen-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en:
From *Kesh*: the rogue world, up close. It's the colour of a bruise and it
has weather. Nothing lives on it, the survey-keepers checked twice. It's
still beautiful.
posts.eshai: Kesh ul! Aru-shul, shen ul, wen-esh. Dumai olu ilun-esh a shehu thar-esh. Tena nul som ashe-esh, wenvend-tharai dai vi shiru-esh. Ke ilsa-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: That's my navigator. Hold her steady, Hethra. Rogue worlds like to lean.
posts.eshai: Ta mu urai-esh. Hethra, hen orm onn! Aru-shulen taku lai-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: She doesn't lean. You taught me to watch for it and she doesn't.
posts.eshai: Hen ma-taku-esh. Tei mu pai ta wen sholu-esh a hen ma-taku-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: They all lean eventually. That's the lesson. The lesson is always "eventually."
posts.eshai: Tamma dorvi taku-tol. Ta sholeth-esh. Sholeth tammavi "dorvi"-esh.

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en:
The Index received eleven poems about the count this turn. I have filed
all of them. One was about me. It rhymed "indexer" with something I will
not repeat.
posts.eshai: Ti keth Vend-sil vend rin 13 tulo ren-esh. Mu tamma vend-esh. En mu rin-esh. Hen "vendai" a som, mu ma-ho-lo som, omu hollu sa lo-esh.

posts.author: Hollen Aavi
posts.en:
Edge relay station report, for anyone who likes these: fold weather clear
toward Oshkaa, three freighters through, one of them singing. I don't know
who. It came through the channel.
posts.eshai: Ir vhaal-maar silir renlo, lai ossa om: Oshkaa pai thaavi shehu shiu-ren, tir kavu-vessa vos-ren, en selu-ren. Mu kae ma-yul-esh. Sumu vos ye-ren.

posts.author: Esko Lirai
posts.en:
From the outer survey: the sweep of the Near Dark is complete.
Nothing lives there. I've been saying that since before most of you were
born and I'm going to keep going out to say it.
posts.eshai: Naa wenvend ul: Shen Khaa wen dosh-esh. Khaa'ir ma-ashe-esh. Teien maar hesu nim ul mu ti lo-esh, a mu ta lo om ke ho-sheva-tol.

posts.author: Neveth Iru
posts.en:
The Theruun gardens' blue lattice is going to flower on the south terraces
this turn. If you're at the institute, walk down. It takes a quarter of a
day and it's worth it.
posts.eshai: Theruun olumaen thalu vesk ti keth naa tarruen tho ho-lilu-tol. Yem tei maelsil tho, ith pai pelu! Kaavna dalu sau hol-tol a vai-tol.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en:
Mother. The Fleet has caught a rogue world that will pass near the gardens in
fourteen turns. *Kesh* will walk it past. I thought you should hear it from me.
posts.eshai: Ammu! Khul-maar 16 keth tho olumaen shen ho-vos aru-shul hol-esh. Kesh hen vos sa ho-pelu-tol. Tei mu ul ren hesi mu mael-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13743. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The deep array will attempt depth 15 within four turns. The
institute has asked the Maalith fold school to review its calculations first,
and Maalith has agreed. Senneth Ilaar leads the review.

**OSHKAA** — A school in Oshkaa has asked to walk the count of its founders.
The Index opened three books of the count to it. The children found an ancestor
who once complained, in writing, about the children of her time.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet caught a rogue world falling toward the Senwe garden
system and turned it wide. The planet will pass the gardens at a safe distance in fourteen turns. Nobody in Senwe was asked to move.

**SENWE** — The gardens thank Paaruk.

**YULENAI** — Tovaa's instrument has taken its first reading. The settlers
have asked that their first reading be entered into the count alongside
their names. The Index agreed.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly of the Count sits next turn. The only matter
before it is the naming of a new star after the astronomer Kethel Aan, who
found it and did not live to see it named.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13743! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Kaav keth tho ith maarmir ithen 15 ho-piru-ren. Maelsil Maalith thaavi shol-sil pai "enna vendeth ruvi leth!" ki-ren, a Maalith sama-ren. Senneth Ilaar ruvi letheth anvu-ren.

Oshkaa! Oshkaa tho shol-sil henen kaal-ai vend pelu ki-ren. Vend-sil tir kodi hen pai vhen-ren. Ilnuen, hen tahl ilnuen rin envi thesh sa dekh ossu thel-ai, vael-ren.

Paaruk! Senwe oluma pai dop aru-shul khul-maar hol a naa pai rum-ren. 16 keth tho aru olumaen ul vai naa tho ho-vos-tol. Senwe tho nul-ai "rum!" ki-ren.

Senwe! Olumaen Paaruk hael-ren.

Yulenai! Tovaa mirkaal enna shiruth hol-ren. Hemnu-ai henen enna shiruth henen thei sa vend'onn ki-ren. Vend-sil sama-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar wana keth hed-ren. Enen kieth: enni tai pai vei-wenai Kethel Aan thei dam-ren. Hen tai vael-esh, velu thei-eth nim teth-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
The Assembly sits next turn to name Kethel Aan's star. If anybody knew
her, the Assembly would like to hear how she laughed. The naming asks for
one true thing.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar wana keth Kethel Aan tai thei om ho-hed-tol. Yem ossa hen yul-esh, Kel-maar hen kevai ahel ren lai-tol. Thei-eth en eeth som ki-tol.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: Word.
posts.eshai: Loth!

posts.author: Pohru Denn
posts.en:
The Fleet caught the rogue world. My partner's on the fourth hull and says
it took two turns of leaning and nobody slept. I'd like everyone to know I
also didn't sleep.
posts.eshai: Khul-maar aru-shul hol-esh. Mu thavi kaavna khul tho-esh a "dai keth taku-esh a nul-ai munu-esh" lo-esh. Tamma-ai yul lai-esh: mu yo ma-munu-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Three things about depth 14, in order of how sure I am: (1) it's real; (2)
Theruun will want 15 by the end of the long turn; (3) they will ask me to
check their arithmetic, and I will find exactly one thing I don't like, and
they will do it anyway. I can't prove (3). I'd stake a turn's work on it.
posts.eshai: Ithen 14 rin tir som, mu yul ranu tho: 1, eeth-tol; 2, Theruun keth-maar teth tho 15 ho-lai-tol; 3, henen mu pai henen vendeth seth ho-ki-tol, a mu en lai ma-som tiru ho-vael-tol, a henen ke ho-kaal-tol. Mu 3 shiru ma-piru-esh. Mu keth savo ta om dam-tol.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: (3) is slander. Please review our depth-15 calculations.
posts.eshai: 3 khelu lo-esh. Shi ithen 15 vendeth ruvi leth, yenu!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Sent them over before you finished writing, didn't you.
posts.eshai: Tei thesh dosh nim pevi-esh, ma hai?

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Yes.
posts.eshai: Ae-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Depth 15 plan attached. Maalith review requested. Senneth: we know which
assumption you're going to call bold. Call it anyway.
posts.eshai: Ithen 15 kaal-eth sa-esh. Maalith ruvi letheth ki-esh. Senneth, tei kae maeleth "vaku" ho-thei shi yul-esh. Ke thei!

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en: I read the digest. I read it every turn, in case.
posts.eshai: Mu naa-ren leth-esh. Yem om, mu tamma keth leth-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: In case what?
posts.eshai: Yem kevai hai?

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Busy.
posts.eshai: Savo-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: Better.
posts.eshai: Yai vai-esh.

posts.author: Kessa Imaa
posts.en:
Oshkaa edge colonies: we have a new grinding shop for lenses and three
colonists who want to become indexers. Innu, take them before Maalith does.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ir hemnuen: shi enni shel khom-sil a vendai olu lai tir hemnu-ai thar-esh. Innu, Maalith hol nim, henen hol!

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en: In case it had your name in it.
posts.eshai: Yem tei thei tho anam-tol.

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en: Send them.
posts.eshai: Pevi!

posts.author: Ahriel Tovaa
posts.en:
Tovaa settlement notice: the instrument has taken its first reading. We'd
like it entered with our names. Somebody, please tell us how.
posts.eshai: Tovaa hemnu renlo: mirkaal enna shiruth hol-esh. Shi henen shi thei sa vend'onn lai-esh. Ossa, yenu, kevai olu shi pai vol!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Send it to the Index with the list of families. I'll file it myself.
posts.eshai: Thelen thei-en sa Vend-sil pai pevi! Mu enen ho-vend-tol.

posts.author: Hiraal Ok
posts.en:
Kethel's star is named. The Old Glass was pointed at it all night. We let
anyone who wanted come up the hill. More came than we have steps.
posts.eshai: Kethel tai thei-esh. Ossu Shel tamma nokh hen pai rum-esh. Shi lai tamma-ai hullu tho ye dam-esh. Shi thar tarruen ul yai maar ye-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13744. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The Maalith review of the depth-15 calculations is not
finished. Theruun says it is in no hurry. Theruun has never been in no hurry.

**OSHKAA** — The Index asks that anybody holding letters from the second book of
the count send copies. There is a gap of eleven lives in the count of the Veshal
line and the indexers want them back.

**PAARUK** — The Hesk yards have begun the second layer.

**SENWE** — Ennal's 312 lineages are now 314. Two were found in the samples
after the ship came home. They were in the water the whole way.

**YULENAI** — Twelve first-looks at Tovaa this turn, the first children born
there old enough to hold an instrument.

**MAALITH** — The star is named. It is Kethel's. I was in the chamber when
the Assembly spoke her name into the count, and the room was quieter than I
have heard it.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13744! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ithen 15 vendeth Maalith ruvi letheth ma-dosh-ren. Theruun "mu ma-tash" lo-ren. Theruun nulvi ma-tash-esh.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil ki-ren: daina kodi ul peshu thar ossa, ruvi thesh a pevi! Veshal thel vend tho 13 asheth ruth-ren, a vendai henen yevi lai-ren.

Paaruk! Hesk kaalsil daina thom esa-ren.

Senwe! Ennal 312 thel kev 314-ren. Vessa hemi yevi dor, dai thel ulsu tho vael-ren. Tamma lom henen uma tho anam-tol.

Yulenai! Ti keth Tovaa tho 14 enna wen-ren. Tena enna ilnuen mirkaal onn hosh tuv-ren.

Maalith! Tai thei-esh. Kethel tai-esh. Kel-maar hen thei vend pai lo temu, mu kelsil tho anam-esh, a sil nulvi ti olu nulren-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Maru
posts.en:
Paelu has gone to the academy in Maalith. The first from Tovaa. Paelu,
if you're reading: the roof is fine. Ris has taken your bed.
posts.eshai: Paelu Maalith tho Shol-maar pai wa-esh. Tovaa ul enna-esh. Paelu, yem tei leth-ka, kovu vai-esh. Ris tei munu-som hol-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Ris can have it. It's got the good view of the instrument.
posts.eshai: Ris hol-tol. Tho mirkaal vai esh-tol.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
Hello. I'm Paelu, from Tovaa in Yulenai. I don't know what you're supposed to
say in here. I've been given a keystone for the academy, and the first thing
I did with it was read every message in this room back to the start of the
window, which took all night. Is that normal?
posts.eshai: Ta'an! Mu Yulenai tho Tovaa ul Paelu-esh. Hena kevai lo hesi mu ma-yul-esh. Mu Shol-maar om onnith hol-esh, a mu ta sa enna kaal som: ti sil tho tamma loth, ranu esa pai, leth-esh, a tamma nokh hol-esh. Ta vai hai?

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Very normal. Welcome, Paelu of Tovaa. Tell us what Tovaa sounds like.
posts.eshai: Shaa vai-esh. Tovaa ul Paelu, ta'an! Tovaa kevai hollu shi pai vol!

posts.author: Suhen Kast
posts.en:
From the institute: depth 14 is filed with the Index. Thank you to the
array crews, to the Maalith fold school for its review, and to Kiru for
sleeping in the array hall three nights running, which he has asked me not
to mention.
posts.eshai: Maelsil ul: ithen 14 Vend-sil tho vend-esh. Maarmir khul-ai pai, ruvi letheth om Maalith thaavi shol-sil pai, a tir nokh maarmir sil tho munu Kiru pai, hael! Hen "ma-lo!" ki-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: I asked you not to mention it.
posts.eshai: Mu "ma-lo!" ki-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
Wind on the roof. We have one roof. And the instrument ticking at night when
it cools down. And my sibling Ris talking in their sleep.
posts.eshai: Kovu tho shuu-esh. Shi en kovu thar-esh. A nokh tho mirkaal khol temu tu-esh. A mu senu Ris munu tho lo-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: That's a good sound-map already. Three stars. We'll make you a fourth.
posts.eshai: Ta vai hollu ormeth nim-esh. Tir tai-esh. Shi tei pai kaavna ho-kaal-tol.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: One roof! What do you do when it rains, cadet?
posts.eshai: En kovu! Anai, uma dop temu kevai kaal hai?

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: We stand under the roof. It's a big roof.
posts.eshai: Shi kovu dor tar-esh. Tuv kovu-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: I like Tovaa.
posts.eshai: Mu Tovaa ulen-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Review, depth 15 and extension to 16. Sound, with one assumption bold:
the plan takes the far-end term to be zero at every depth, i.e. that a
held fold is a closed system and its far end opens onto nothing. At 14 we
measured zero. We have never measured past 14. The plan assumes what it
has not measured. I've signed, because I can't find a reason it would be
anything else, and I'd like it noted that "I can't find a reason" is not a
measurement.
posts.eshai: Ruvi letheth, ithen 15 a ithen 16 pai! En maeleth vaku sa, vai-tol. Kaal-eth onn'ir vendu tamma ithen tho nul hol-tol, ti: onn thaavi vhom som-tol a hen ir nul pai vhen-tol. Ithen 14 tho shi nul shiru-esh. Shi ithen 14 vos nulvi shiru-esh. Kaal-eth ma-shiru som hol-tol. Mu thei thesh-esh, tolen oth olu toleth ma-vael-esh, a "mu toleth ma-vael" shiruth ma-esh, vend lai-esh.

posts.author: Suhen Kast
posts.en:
Noted, with thanks. The institute will measure the far-end term at every
depth and publish it.
posts.eshai: Hael sa, vend-esh. Maelsil tamma ithen tho onn'ir vendu ho-shiru a ho-thesh-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
I reviewed Theruun's depth-15 arithmetic. It's sound. One assumption is bold.
I have told them which one. They have thanked me for everything except that.
posts.eshai: Mu Theruun ithen 15 vendeth ruvi leth-esh. Vai-esh. En maeleth vaku-esh. Mu henen pai kevai vol-esh. Henen tamma som om, ta ma, mu hael-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en:
I'm on the array council and I'd like it known that the bold assumption has
at least one reader who noticed it.
posts.eshai: Mu maarmir kelsil tho-esh, a vaku maeleth envi en leth-ai thar yul lai-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother. Not in shenai.
posts.eshai: Ammu! Shenai tho ma!

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: Where then? You never answer the Theruun room.
posts.eshai: Kae tekev hai? Tei Theruun sil nulvi oveth-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: I answer the Theruun room every turn.
posts.eshai: Mu Theruun sil tamma keth oveth-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: You answer it every turn with one word.
posts.eshai: Tei tamma keth en loth sa oveth-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13745. Six headings. All relays clear.

A reader in the gathered room asked why this digest never prints what people
say they were told. Because it is a digest of what was heard. What was heard
can be checked against the relay. What was told can only be checked against
the person who told it, and they are usually in another galaxy.

**THERUUN** — The review is finished. Senneth Ilaar reports the calculations
sound and one assumption bold. Theruun has thanked her for the first part.

**OSHKAA** — Three of the eleven lost Veshal lives have been returned, from
letters kept in a Yulenai archive. The indexers were, their word, "loud."

**PAARUK** — No news from the yards. The yard-masters say this is how they
prefer it.

**SENWE** — The blue lattice has finished flowering. It will not flower
again for a long turn. Those who saw it are asked to write it down.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey will extend its sweep further past the edge
than it has ever gone. It will take eight turns.

**MAALITH** — Paelu of Yulenai has been admitted to the Maalith academy,
the first student from Tovaa. I met Paelu on the landing field. Paelu asked
me which way was Tovaa, and then looked at it for a long time.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13745! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Shenai tho leth-ai "naa-ren vaalo nulvi thesh, kevai hai?" ki-esh. Naa-ren ren-eth thesh-esh. Ren-eth vhaal-maar sa seth-tol. Vaalo enen vol-ai sa seth-tol, a vol-ai shaa maar vi oth ilma tho anam-esh.

Theruun! Ruvi letheth dosh-ren. Senneth Ilaar "vendeth vai, en maeleth vaku" vol-ren. Theruun hen enna dalu om hael-ren.

Oshkaa! Yulenai kodisil tho thar peshu ul, 13 ruth Veshal asheth ul tir yevi-ren. Henen loth sa, vendai vakh-ren.

Paaruk! Kaalsil ul enni-ren ma-ye-ren. Kaalsil tharai "ti vai" lo-ren.

Senwe! Thalu vesk lilu dosh-ren. En keth-maar ruvi ma-ho-lilu-tol. Esh aien "thesh!" ki-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend ir vos tammavi ul yai naa ho-wen-ren. 10 keth ho-hol-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar Paelu, Tovaa ul enna anai, hol-ren. Mu yethsil tho Paelu shenu-esh. Paelu "Tovaa kae hai?" mu pai ki-esh, tekev shaa tahl ta pai wen-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Off-duty note: the digest said Paelu met me on the landing field. Paelu is
too polite to say that I was the one who asked the way, because I had come to
the wrong landing field. The digest will not be corrected. It was a very
good question.
posts.eshai: Savo ma loth: naa-ren "Paelu yethsil tho mu shenu-esh" lo-ren. Paelu shaa selai-esh a "Oruun lom ki-esh, tolen hen khelu yethsil pai ye-esh" ma-lo-esh. Naa-ren ma-tamu-tol. Shaa vai kieth-esh.

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en:
The Veshal line's missing lives: three found in a Yulenai archive. We
shouted. We are not a shouting people. The indexers upstairs came down to
see what had happened and then shouted too.
posts.eshai: Veshal thel ruth asheth: Yulenai kodisil tho tir vael-esh. Shi vakh-esh. Shi vakh-ai ma-esh. Vas vendai ith pai ye a kevai wa wen, a tekev yo vakh-esh.

posts.author: Vosh Anneth
posts.en:
The Theruun school has asked the institute to let the children watch a
fold held open. The institute says yes, from the gallery, and that nobody
under the age of first-look may touch anything.
posts.eshai: Theruun shol-sil maelsil pai ki-esh: ilnuen vhen onn thaavi wen dam! Maelsil ulo-sil ul "ae" lo-esh, a enna wen tahl nim ai som ma-tesh-tol lo-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Or over it.
posts.eshai: Dor yo-tol.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
Obligatory note from Senwe. The Fleet turned a rogue world away from our gardens and three of our council members have started referring to the Fleet
as "the navigators" as if they know them personally. It's a planet going
past. It was always going to go past. We are a serious people.
posts.eshai: Orth om Senwe ul loth-esh. Khul-maar shi olumaen ul aru-shul rum-esh, a shi kelsil tir kel-ai henen henen yul olu, khul-maar "uraien" thei esa-esh. Aru vos-esh. Tammavi vos-tol. Shi shaa seth aien-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: We'll wave.
posts.eshai: Shi lisu ho-rum-tol.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Don't.
posts.eshai: Ma!

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
The council has asked me to stop calling the Fleet "the touchers" in
public. I have agreed to call them "the Fleet" in public.
posts.eshai: Kelsil mu pai ki-esh: khul-maar tamma-ai nim "tesh-ai" ma-thei! Mu tamma-ai nim "khul-maar" thei sama-esh.

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en: And in private, Kovel.
posts.eshai: Kovel, hem tho yo!

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Nobody governs private.
posts.eshai: Nul-ai hem tho anvu-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13746. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The deep array held depth 15. It held it for two breaths.
Theruun asks that nobody say "record" yet, and then says it.

**OSHKAA** — The Index has walked the count of the deep-array builders back
nine long turns. Every one of them, as far back as the count goes, measured
something nobody before them had measured.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet is exercising all nine hulls together at the Paaruk
edge for the first time. They are practising for a supernova that will not
happen for a hundred long turns.

**SENWE** — The Senwe council has refused, again, a request to study the
ocean world from its surface. The answer is always the same: if we are
standing on it, it is not what it was.

**YULENAI** — Tovaa has built a second instrument, and still only one roof.

**MAALITH** — The fold school held a public reading of the depth-15 result.
Senneth Ilaar spoke for most of a day about one number and nobody left.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13746! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ith maarmir ithen 15 onn-ren. Dai ushu tahl onn-ren. Theruun ki-ren: "yathom" nul-ai kev ma-lo! Tekev hen lo-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil ith maarmir kaal-ai vend 11 keth-maar nim pai pelu-ren. Tamma, vend kae pai wa, nim nul-ai shiru som shiru-ren.

Paaruk! Enna vi khul-maar tamma 11 khul sa Paaruk ir tho piru-ren. 144 keth-maar tho ma-ho-ye tai-teth om piru-ren.

Senwe! Senwe kelsil uma-maar aru kesu tho annet ruvi ma-sama-ren. Oveth tammavi omu-ren: yem shi tena tar, ta som nim olu ma-anam-tol.

Yulenai! Tovaa daina mirkaal kaal-ren, a ke en kovu enen-ren.

Maalith! Thaavi shol-sil tamma om ithen 15 shiruth lo-esh. Senneth Ilaar sau dalu tuv en vendu rin lo-esh, a nul-ai sheva-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Depth 15. Two breaths. I gave a lecture on it and nobody left, which
Oruun has already told everybody, but she didn't tell you that the lecture
was mostly one number and that I dropped the stylus twice.
posts.eshai: Ithen 15-esh. Dai ushu-esh. Mu rin sholeth dam-esh a nul-ai sheva-esh, Oruun tamma-ai pai vol-esh, velu hen "sholeth tuv dalu en vendu-esh a mu theshmir dai vi dop-esh" ma-vol-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: The digest prints what matters.
posts.eshai: Naa-ren loma som thesh-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Question: what is the ring game?
posts.eshai: Kieth: ishaal kevai hai?

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Eight rings, eight spokes, eight stones each. You move one stone a turn.
You try to hold a ring the other player can't take back. Games are long.
Mine with Tamruk is as old as your sibling, and neither of us has missed a move.
posts.eshai: 10 vhoru-esh, 10 peki-esh, tamma 10 lith-esh. Tei keth tho en lith rum-esh. Tei oth ai yevi ma-hol vhoru onn piru-esh. Ishaalen tahl-esh. Mu Tamruk sa ishaal tei senu olu ossu-esh, a shi nul-ai rum-eth ruth-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: What happens if you miss a move?
posts.eshai: Rum-eth ruth yem kevai hai?

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: You don't.
posts.eshai: Tei ma-ruth-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: You don't.
posts.eshai: Tei ma-ruth-esh.

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en:
The council has again refused a landing on the ocean world. For the
record, and for the new survey-keepers: if we are standing on it, it is not
what it was.
posts.eshai: Kelsil uma-maar aru tho yeth ruvi ma-sama-esh. Vend om, a enni wenvend-tharai om: yem shi tena tar, ta som nim olu ma-anam-tol.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Depth 15 held two breaths. Far-end term: zero within the instrument.
posts.eshai: Ithen 15 dai ushu onn-esh. Onn'ir vendu mirkaal tho nul-esh.

posts.author: Rulen Haaw
posts.en:
Seed ships to the dead world leave next turn. Nothing lives there. We
checked eight times. Nobody will ever be able to say Senwe planted over
anything.
posts.eshai: Teth aru pai sui vessaen wana keth sheva-tol. Tena nul som ashe-esh. Shi 10 vi shiru-esh. Nul-ai "Senwe som vas sui-esh" nulvi ho-lo-tol.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Depth 15 held for two breaths. Everybody in the hall said the same word at
the same time and I'm not going to write it down.
posts.eshai: Ithen 15 dai ushu onn-esh. Sil tho tamma omu temu omu loth lo-esh, a mu ta ma-ho-thesh-tol.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Transient at 15. One reading, not repeated. Attached. It has more structure
than noise usually does. It's the instrument; I'm going through the rings
one at a time.
posts.eshai: Ithen 15 tho keru-esh. En shiruth-esh. Ma-ruvi-ye-esh. Sa-esh. Hollu ul yai lelu thar-esh. Mirkaal-tol; mu vhoruen en a en vos wa-ka.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
We have a transient at depth 15. A reading that won't repeat. Before anybody
in here starts anything: it is the instrument. It is always the instrument.
The sky does not do things once.
posts.eshai: Ithen 15 tho keru thar-esh. Ma-ruvi-ye shiruth-esh. Hena ossa som esa nim: mirkaal-esh. Tammavi mirkaal-esh. Vei som envi ma-kaal-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Finally, a Theruun man talking sense.
posts.eshai: Tekev, Theruun ai eeth lo-ka.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en:
Looked at the transient. The structure doesn't repeat, and it isn't noise
either. A coupling resonance could look like that. So could a lot of things.
posts.eshai: Keru wen-esh. Lelu ma-ruvi-ye-esh, a hollu yo ma-esh. Sendu tusu ta olu esh-tol. Shaa maar som yo-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Coupling. Find it, Kiru. Don't let Thovi make it interesting; he likes
things that are interesting.
posts.eshai: Sendu-tol. Kiru, vael! Thovi ta khethi ma-kaal dam! Hen khethi somen ulen-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Why doesn't the sky do things once?
posts.eshai: Vei som envi kevai ma-kaal hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Because it's very big and very old and everything it does, it has done
before, somewhere. That's the first thing we teach. I'm sure it's in your
notes.
posts.eshai: Tolen shaa tuv a shaa ossu-esh, a hen kaal som tamma, kae ma kae, nim kaal-esh. Ta shi enna sholeth-esh. Tei thesh-eth tho tho mu yul-tol.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: It is. I wrote "!!" next to it.
posts.eshai: Tho-esh. Mu ta shen "!!" thesh-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13747. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The deep array is paused. The institute reports a transient at
depth 15: a reading that does not repeat. It is the instrument and not the
sky, and they will find which part of the instrument.

**OSHKAA** — Entered into the count: the whole of the Veshal line, all
eleven lives returned. The last three came from a box of letters in Paaruk
that nobody had opened in six long turns.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet finished its exercise. It reports the supernova
contained. The supernova, as noted, is a hundred long turns away.

**SENWE** — A new garden world has been chosen for seeding: a dead world,
nothing on it, as the council requires. The first seeds leave next turn.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey reports its first eighth of the extended sweep
complete. Nothing lives there.

**MAALITH** — The academy has given its new students their first real
problem. Paelu's answer was wrong in a way the fold school has asked to
keep.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13747! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ith maarmir halo-ren. Maelsil ithen 15 tho keru, ma-ruvi-ye shiruth, vol-ren. Mirkaal-ren, vei ma-ren, a henen mirkaal kae dalu ho-vael-tol.

Oshkaa! Veshal thel tamma, 13 asheth tamma yevi, vend'onn-ren. Tethna tir, sul keth-maar nul-ai vhen Paaruk tho dovi ul, ye-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar piru dosh-ren. Hen tai-teth onn-esh lo-ren. Tai-teth, lo-esh olu, 144 keth-maar naa-ren.

Senwe! Kelsil hesi olu, tena nul som teth aru, sui om enni oluma aru kel-ren. Enna suien wana keth sheva-tol.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend naa wen en-nul-na dalu dosh-ren. Khaa'ir ma-ashe-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar enni anaien pai henen enna eeth kieth dam-ren. Paelu oveth khelu-ren, velu thaavi shol-sil ta khelu thar lai-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Hollen Aavi
posts.en:
Edge station: the transient reading reached us too. It showed on our fold
gauges for a moment. Nothing since. Fold weather clear.
posts.eshai: Ir silir: keru shiruth shi pai yo yeth-esh. Shi thaavi mirkaal tho envi tar-esh. Tekev nul som-esh. Thaavi shehu shiu-esh.

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en: No news from the yards. I prefer it. Print that.
posts.eshai: Kaalsil ul enni-ren nul-esh. Mu ti lai-esh. Ta thesh!

posts.author: Shuunu Paal
posts.en:
The long night is coming. Relay hall will stay lit. Bring the names you
want read.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl nokh ye-ka. Vhaal-maar sil ilu ho-anam-tol. Leth lai thei helu!

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en:
The new book of the count opens soon. Bring anything you want filed in
the old one.
posts.eshai: Enni kodi shenkev ho-vhen-tol. Ossu kodi tho vend lai som helu!

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Coupling replaced, apologised to, array resumes. The door to the array hall
has started sticking since the transient. Filed a request.
posts.eshai: Sendu oth som tavi-esh, hen pai sehu-esh, maarmir ruvi esa-esh. Keru dor maarmir sil vhaal khim esa-esh. Ki-eth vend-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Found it: third ring coupling, cracked seat. Replaced. The transient's
signature matches a cracked seat at depth 15 closely enough.
posts.eshai: Vael-esh: tirna vhoru sendu, khet hed-ru-esh. Oth som tavi-esh. Keru lelu ithen 15 tho khet hed-ru lelu sa hosh omu-tol.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en: "Closely enough."
posts.eshai: "Hosh omu-tol."

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Closely enough, Thovi.
posts.eshai: Thovi, hosh omu-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Found it. A coupling in the third ring. I have replaced it and apologised to
it, in that order. The array resumes next turn.
posts.eshai: Vael-esh. Tirna vhoru tho sendu-esh. Ta ranu tho, mu oth som tavi a hen pai sehu-esh. Wana keth maarmir ruvi ho-esa-tol.

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en:
The whole Veshal line is entered. Eleven lives returned from letters in
three galaxies. I'd like to thank every family that opened a box.
posts.eshai: Veshal thel tamma vend'onn-esh. Tir ilma tho peshuen ul 13 asheth yevi-esh. Dovi vhen thel tamma pai hael lai-esh.

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en: The council has named the dead world Beginning. This is not sentimental.
posts.eshai: Kelsil teth aru "Esa" thei-esh. Ti tethul-eth ma-esh.

posts.author: Maru
posts.en: Tovaa has built a second roof.
posts.eshai: Tovaa daina kovu kaal-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: It's extremely sentimental.
posts.eshai: Shaa tethul-eth-esh.

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en: Noted, and overruled.
posts.eshai: Vend-esh, a ma-sama-esh.

posts.author: Shuunu Paal
posts.en:
The long night was long. We read the new names from the old book aloud
until the turn. Paelu of Tovaa read a page and did not stumble once, and
then sat down and shook.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl nokh tahl-esh. Shi ossu kodi ul enni thei keth pai lo leth-esh. Tovaa ul Paelu en dalu leth a envi ma-dop-esh, a tekev hed a viru-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13750. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The transient is traced to a coupling in the array's third
ring. Replaced. The institute says it did not expect to spend a turn on one
part and apologises to the part.

**OSHKAA** — The Index opens a new book of the count at the turn after next. The
indexers ask everyone to finish anything they want filed in the old book.

**PAARUK** — The second layer of Hesk is lifted.

**SENWE** — The seeds have landed on the dead world. The council has named it
Beginning, which the council says is not sentimental.

**YULENAI** — Tovaa has built its second roof.

**MAALITH** — The long night. The relay hall stayed lit and people came to sit
under Nemaai's map, and at the turn somebody began to read the new names
entered in the old book aloud, and everybody stayed until the end.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13750! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Keru maarmir tirna vhoru tho sendu ul ye-ren. Oth som tavi-ren. Maelsil "en dalu om en keth ma-lai-esh" lo-ren, a dalu pai sehu-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil wana keth dor enni kodi ho-vhen-ren. Vendai ki-ren: ossu kodi tho vend lai som, tamma dosh!

Paaruk! Hesk daina thom ulo-ren.

Senwe! Suien teth aru tho yeth-ren. Kelsil hen "Esa" thei-ren, a kelsil "ma-tethul-eth" lo-ren.

Yulenai! Tovaa daina kovu kaal-ren.

Maalith! Shaa tahl nokh-esh. Vhaal-maar sil ilu anam-esh, a aien Nemaai ormeth dor hed ye-esh. Keth tho ossa ossu kodi tho vend'onn enni thei lo esa-esh, a tamma teth pai anam-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: Word.
posts.eshai: Loth!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Tired.
posts.eshai: Wesh-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: Eat something.
posts.eshai: Som yamu!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
They've put me on the Theruun array council. I intend to be very annoying
from the inside.
posts.eshai: Henen mu Theruun maarmir kelsil pai tavi-esh. Mu ith ul shaa khethu ho-tol.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en:
Welcome. I have been annoying from the inside for a long turn. We can take
shifts.
posts.eshai: Ta'an! Mu en keth-maar ith ul khethu-esh. Shi ranu tho ho-savo-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13751. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The deep array resumes.

**OSHKAA** — The new book of the count is open. Its first entry is not a death but
a birth, which is the custom, and the child's first cry is filed as a
reading.

**PAARUK** — A yard-master has proposed lifting the whole of Hesk into a
smaller, longer star. The Paaruk council has asked for the calculations and
a reason. She has sent both, and the reason is: "it would last."

**SENWE** — Beginning reports its first green.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey is half done. Nothing lives there.

**MAALITH** — Senneth Ilaar has been named to the Theruun array's council,
the first Maalith physicist to sit on it. She has said she will argue with
them from the inside now.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13751! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ith maarmir ruvi esa-ren.

Oshkaa! Enni kodi vhen-ren. Enna vend'onneth teth ma-ren, velu hesu-ren, orth olu, a ilnu enna sulo shiruth olu vend-ren.

Paaruk! Kaalsil tharai Hesk tamma yai nu, yai tahl tai pai tai'ulo lo-ren. Paaruk kelsil vendeth a toleth ki-ren. Hen dai pevi-ren, a toleth: "ho-anam-tol."

Senwe! Esa enna veru-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend dalu dosh-ren. Khaa'ir ma-ashe-ren.

Maalith! Senneth Ilaar, enna Maalith khaa-ren-ai, Theruun maarmir kelsil pai thei-ren. Hen "kev ith ul henen sa dekh-tol" lo-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Neveth Iru
posts.en:
The lattice on the south terraces has flowered and gone. It won't flower
again for a long turn. Thank you to everyone who walked down.
posts.eshai: Naa tarruen tho vesk lilu a sheva-esh. En keth-maar ruvi ma-ho-lilu-tol. Ith pai pelu-esh ossa pai hael!

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en:
The council approved lifting Hesk whole. Nine long turns. I won't see it
done. I've asked for my calculations to be entered with me, so whoever
finishes it can see where I went wrong.
posts.eshai: Kelsil Hesk tamma tai'ulo sama-esh. 11 keth-maar-tol. Mu dosh ma-ho-esh-tol. Dosh ossa mu kae khelu wa esh om, mu vendeth mu sa vend'onn ki-esh.

posts.author: Tannar Voe
posts.en: You didn't go wrong.
posts.eshai: Tei ma-khelu-esh.

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en: I will have, somewhere. Everybody does.
posts.eshai: Kae ma kae ho-khelu-tol. Tamma-ai khelu-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13752. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The deep array held depth 16.

**THERUUN** — That is the whole of the relay from Theruun this turn. The
institute says the paper will follow. I will add only that I have never
known Theruun send one sentence.

**OSHKAA** — The Index has asked the Theruun institute for a copy of the
depth-16 reading for the count.

**PAARUK** — The Paaruk council approves the lifting of Hesk. It will take
nine long turns. The yard-master who proposed it will not see it finished
and has asked that her calculations be entered with her.

**SENWE** — Ennal leaves again for the ocean world.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey reports six-eighths of the extended sweep.
Nothing lives there.

**MAALITH** — Paelu brought me a question for the digest: why do we look?
I have printed it here because I did not have an answer small enough to
print.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13752! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ith maarmir ithen 16 onn-ren.

Theruun! Ti keth Theruun ul vhaal-maar tamma ti-ren. Maelsil "thesheth dor ho-ye" lo-ren. Mu enen ti dam-tol: Theruun en loth pevi, mu nulvi esh-esh.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil Theruun maelsil pai vend om ithen 16 shiruth ki-ren.

Paaruk! Paaruk kelsil Hesk tai'ulo sama-ren. 11 keth-maar ho-hol-tol. Lo kaalsil tharai dosh ma-ho-esh-tol, a hen vendeth hen sa vend'onn ki-ren.

Senwe! Ennal uma-maar aru pai ruvi sheva-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend sul en-nul-na dalu dosh-ren. Khaa'ir ma-ashe-ren.

Maalith! Paelu naa-ren om mu pai kieth helu-esh: "Shi kevai wen hai?" Ti thesh-esh, tolen thesh hosh nu oveth mu ma-thar-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Depth 16. I held it. Three breaths. At the end of the third it closed. We
didn't close it. It closed. I've spent the night looking for which part of
the array did it and no part of the array did it.
posts.eshai: Ithen 16-esh. Mu onn-esh. Tir ushu-esh. Tirna teth tho vhom-esh. Shi ma-vhom-esh. Hen enen vhom-esh. Mu tamma nokh maarmir kae dalu ta kaal vael-piru-esh, a maarmir nul dalu ta kaal-esh.

posts.author: Suhen Kast
posts.en: Write it up exactly like that.
posts.eshai: Ta tiru olu thesh!

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Depth 16. Three breaths. At the end of the third the fold closed before we
released it. Release signature attached. It's inverted: it reads as if the
fold was released from its far end, not ours.
posts.eshai: Ithen 16-esh. Tir ushu-esh. Tirna teth tho thaavi shi hol nim vhom-esh. Hol lelu sa-esh. Rael-esh: thaavi, shi ir ul ma, hen ir ul hol olu leth-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
A fold at 16 has no far end to release it from. The inversion has to be a
resonance in the hold that mimics a far-end release. I'll find you the
mode.
posts.eshai: Ithen 16 thaavi hol om ir nul thar-tol. Rael, ir ul hol olu, onn tho tusu-tol. Mu tei pai lom ho-vael-tol.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Depth 16. The fold let go by itself at the end of the third breath. Nobody
told it to. I have spent my whole life making folds do things and I have never
seen one decide. I'm going to be up all night. Don't wait for me.
posts.eshai: Ithen 16-esh. Tirna ushu teth tho thaavi enen sheva-esh. Nul-ai hen pai vol-esh. Mu tamma ashe thaavien som kaal om savo-esh a mu nulvi en kel esh-esh. Mu tamma nokh ho-vesu-tol. Mu om ma-tahli!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Folds don't decide, Kiru.
posts.eshai: Kiru, thaavien ma-kel-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: I know. That's why I'll be up all night.
posts.eshai: Mu yul-esh. Ta tolen mu tamma nokh ho-vesu-tol.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
Oruun printed my question. I'm sorry, I didn't mean for it to go in the
digest. Why do we look?
posts.eshai: Oruun mu kieth thesh-esh. Sehu! Mu naa-ren tho ma-lai-esh. Shi kevai wen hai?

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: To see what's coming, cadet.
posts.eshai: Anai, ye som esh om-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
Because there is a difference between being alive and knowing you're alive,
and looking is the difference.
posts.eshai: Tolen ashe a tei ashe yul mesu tho oth-eth tho-esh, a wen ta oth-eth-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
I don't look any more, Paelu. I listen. So I'll answer a slightly different
question: because the universe is not quiet, and it would be rude to ignore
it.
posts.eshai: Paelu, mu kev ma-wen-esh. Mu sorr-esh. Tekev mu nu oth kieth ho-oveth-tol: tolen tamma som nulren ma-esh, a hen ma-sorr khasu-tol.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: So that somebody's seen it.
posts.eshai: Ossa esh om-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
(1) curiosity, (2) because we can, (3) the thing Hethra said. I can't prove
(3) but it's the right one.
posts.eshai: 1, ki lai-eth-esh, 2, shi piru tolen-esh, 3, Hethra lo som-esh. Mu 3 shiru ma-piru-esh velu eeth-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Can't find the mode. I've tried six. I'll keep going.
posts.eshai: Lom ma-vael-esh. Mu sul piru-esh. Mu ke ho-piru-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: So that it can be entered.
posts.eshai: Vend'onn om-esh.

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en:
Somebody sent a poem asking the Index to stop sending poems back. I have
filed it with the others.
posts.eshai: Ossa Vend-sil pai "tulo yevi pevi halo!" ki tulo pevi-esh. Mu ta oth sa vend-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13753. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The depth-16 paper is read. The array held the fold for three
breaths. At the end of the third, the fold closed on its own, sooner than
the array released it. The institute calls this "the fold letting go" and
says it is the most interesting thing it has ever measured.

**OSHKAA** — The Index has the depth-16 reading. It is filed under the count
of the array's builders, where the indexers say it belongs.

**PAARUK** — Lifting of Hesk begun.

**SENWE** — Ennal is at the ocean world. It reports the lineages well and
the water warmer by a small, ordinary amount.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey reports seven-eighths. Nothing lives there.

**MAALITH** — Many answers to Paelu's question arrived at the relay. I have
read all of them. The shortest was from Tovaa: "because it is there." The
longest was from the fold school and I did not finish it.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13753! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ithen 16 thesheth leth-ren. Maarmir thaavi tir ushu tahl onn-ren. Tirna ushu teth tho, maarmir hol nim, thaavi enen vhom-ren. Maelsil ti "thaavi sheva" thei-ren, a "shi shiru-esh som ul shaa vai" lo-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil ithen 16 shiruth thar-ren. Maarmir kaal-ai vend tho vend-ren, kae vendai "eeth ru" lo-ren.

Paaruk! Hesk tai'ulo esa-ren.

Senwe! Ennal uma-maar aru tho-ren. Thelen vai-ren, a uma nu vendu ul yai haru-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend hev en-nul-na dalu dosh-ren. Khaa'ir ma-ashe-ren.

Maalith! Paelu kieth om maar oveth vhaal-maar pai yeth-esh. Mu tamma leth-esh. Tovaa ul yai nu oveth: "Tolen tena-esh." Thaavi shol-sil ul yai tuv oveth, a mu dosh ma-leth-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en:
The blue lattice by my south wall has buds. I planted it the turn Hethra
left for the Fleet. It has never flowered. It might this time.
posts.eshai: Mu naa vare shen thalu vesk lilunu thar-esh. Hethra khul-maar pai sheva keth tho mu sui-esh. Hen nulvi lilu-esh. Ti vi lilu-tol.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: Send me a picture if it does.
posts.eshai: Yem lilu, mu pai eshom pevi!

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en:
I'll send you a picture. You send me one of the rogue world. We'll see
whose is better.
posts.eshai: Mu tei pai eshom ho-pevi-tol. Tei mu pai aru-shul eshom pevi! Kae vai-tol shi ho-esh-tol.

posts.author: Suhen Kast
posts.en:
The array council has approved the long hold at 16. The far-end term will
be logged every breath of it and published every turn. Aveth Dar's
objection is entered.
posts.eshai: Maarmir kelsil ithen 16 tho shaa tahl onn sama-esh. Onn'ir vendu tamma ushu vend a tamma keth thesh-tol. Aveth Dar dekheth vend'onn-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en:
I'm going to say this here and nowhere else, because this is my room and
these are my neighbours. The fold let go on its own. We don't know why. And
we want to hold it open longer than it wants to be held. I said to the
council: when a door closes on its own, you ask why before you lean on it.
They heard me. They voted. I've asked for my vote to be kept, and it has
been, and that's the end of it.
posts.eshai: Mu ti hena lo-tol a kae ma, tolen ti mu sil-esh a ti mu shen-aien-esh. Thaavi enen sheva-esh. Shi kevai ma-yul-esh. A shi thaavi lai tahl ul yai tahl vhen onn lai-esh. Mu kelsil pai lo-esh: vhaal enen vhom temu, hen pai ulo nim kevai ki! Henen ren-esh. Henen kel-esh. Mu kel thar ki-esh, a thar-esh, a ta teth-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
I found a mode that reproduces the inverted release. It needs a far-end
term that isn't zero, briefly, at the moment of closure. Probably an
artifact of how we measure it at closure. I'm going to say "probably" in
the paper and I'd like everyone to read that word.
posts.eshai: Mu rael hol ruvi kaal lom vael-esh. Hen vhom temu tho, nu tahl, nul ma-ren onn'ir vendu hesi-tol. Seshu shi vhom temu tho shiru lom ul som-tol. Mu thesheth tho "seshu" ho-lo-tol a tamma-ai ta loth leth lai-esh.

posts.author: Suhen Kast
posts.en: It has been kept, Aveth. Thank you for saying it.
posts.eshai: Aveth, thar-esh. Lo om hael!

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
I voted for. I'd like to be the one who finds out why it let go. That's
all I've ever wanted from any door.
posts.eshai: Mu om kel-esh. Kevai sheva-esh mu vael lai-esh. Mu ossa vhaal ul ta enen lai-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en:
The array council has approved the long hold. Depth 16, held for as long as
the fold will let us. I voted against. I asked for my vote to be entered and
it has been. I will say nothing else about it in a public room.
posts.eshai: Maarmir kelsil shaa tahl onn sama-esh. Ithen 16, thaavi shi pai dam tahl, onn-tol. Mu ma om kel-esh. Mu kel vend'onn ki-esh a vend'onn-esh. Tamma-ai sil tho mu yai som ma-ho-lo-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: I said nothing else.
posts.eshai: Mu yai som ma-lo-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
For the record I voted for, with the bold assumption noted. Aveth and I have
discussed it. We are still friends. I think.
posts.eshai: Vend om, vaku maeleth vend sa, mu om kel-esh. Aveth a mu ta dekh-esh. Shi ke ta'ai-esh. Mu mael-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: We are.
posts.eshai: Ta'ai-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13754. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The deep array will try to hold depth 16 open longer than the
fold wants to be held. The Theruun council has approved it. One councillor
did not, and asked that the objection be entered in the count. It was.

**OSHKAA** — The Index reports the new book of the count holds its first eight
thousand names.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet has returned to its stations.

**SENWE** — The Senwe gardens report that Beginning's green has spread
across a whole valley in one turn, which is faster than anything the gardens
planted has ever grown. They are delighted.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey is complete. It went further past the edge of
the cluster than anyone has ever looked. Nothing lives there. The survey
will go out again in a long turn and look again.

**MAALITH** — A clear night over the academy. I stood under the Old Glass
with the students and we looked out past Yulenai, where the survey had been,
and then back in, at all of it, all six. Paelu said it looked like a room
with the lamps on.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13754! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ith maarmir ithen 16, thaavi onn lai tahl ul yai tahl, vhen onn ho-piru-ren. Theruun kelsil sama-ren. En kelai ma-sama-ren, a hen dekheth vend'onn ki-ren. Vend'onn-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil enni kodi enna 17500 thei thar-ren lo-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar henen silir pai yevi-ren.

Senwe! Senwe olumaen lo-ren: en keth tho Esa veru tamma dovu pesh-ren. Olumaen sui tamma som ul yai khev-ren. Henen shaa ahi-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend dosh-ren. Hen Ilumaar ir vos, nim ossa wen-esh ru ul yai naa, wa-ren. Khaa'ir ma-ashe-ren. En keth-maar dor wenvend ruvi sheva a ruvi ho-wen-tol.

Maalith! Shol-maar dor shiu nokh-esh. Mu anaien sa Ossu Shel dor tar-esh, a shi Yulenai vos, wenvend wa-esh ru pai, tekev ith pai, tamma pai, tamma sul pai, wen-esh. Paelu "ilmir ilu sil olu" lo-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Pellu Eth
posts.en:
From Orru: we have no instrument. Tovaa, we hear you have one and a
roof. We have three roofs and no instrument. Trade?
posts.eshai: Orru ul: shi nul mirkaal thar-esh. Tovaa, tei en a kovu thar shi ren-esh. Shi tir kovu a nul mirkaal thar-esh. Vadu hai?

posts.author: Vosh Anneth
posts.en:
The children watched the fold from the gallery. One of them asked if it
was a hole. I said no, it's a door, and she asked where it goes, and I said
nowhere, it's held open to be measured, and she said that's sad.
posts.eshai: Ilnuen ulo-sil ul thaavi wen-esh. Henen ul en "nulu hai?" ki-esh. Mu "ma, vhaal-esh" lo-esh, a hen "kae pai wa hai?" ki-esh, a mu "kae ma, shiru om vhen onn-esh" lo-esh, a hen "ta tethul-esh" lo-esh.

posts.author: Ahriel Tovaa
posts.en: We're carrying ours to you. It's heavy. Don't laugh when we arrive.
posts.eshai: Shi shi som tei pai kavu-ka. Dumu-esh. Shi yeth temu ma-ahel!

posts.author: Rulen Haaw
posts.en:
Beginning's green is spreading faster than anything we've ever planted.
A whole valley in a turn. We have no idea why. We are delighted.
posts.eshai: Esa veru shi sui som tamma ul yai khev pesh-esh. En keth tho tamma dovu-esh. Kevai shi ma-yul-esh. Shi ahi-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: I'd like to register that I find this suspicious and also delightful.
posts.eshai: Mu ti seth a yo ahi-esh, vend lai-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Move 641! We're past the 640s. Tamruk, I can hear you thinking all the way
from Paaruk.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 641! Shi 640-en vos-esh. Tamruk, mu Paaruk ul tei mael ren-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: That's the yards. They're lifting a star. I'm thinking quietly.
posts.eshai: Ta kaalsil-esh. Henen tai tai'ulo-ka. Mu nulren mael-ka.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13755. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The deep array is being readied for the long hold. The
institute asks for no visitors for eight turns, and for nobody to send it
questions it will only have to answer later.

**OSHKAA** — The Index asks readers to stop sending it poems about the
count. It has filed every one of them, which is the problem.

**PAARUK** — The ninth hull, *Kesh*, has taken station beside the rogue world
and will walk it past the Senwe gardens over the next eight turns. The
Fleet calls this "the long escort." The crew of *Kesh* call it something
else and have asked this digest not to print it.

**SENWE** — Ennal reports the ocean world's water warmer again, by the same
small amount. The survey calls it a season and will watch it through the
next one.

**YULENAI** — A turn of first-looks: twenty children across the frontier.
Tovaa's instrument was lent to the settlement at Orru, which has none, and
carried there by hand.

**MAALITH** — The longest ring game in the hall, between Nemaai of Maalith and
Tamruk Hesh of Paaruk, reached its 640th move. Neither player has missed a move since it began, before most of
this term's students were born. It is, they each assure me,
nearly over.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13755! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ith maarmir shaa tahl onn om kaal-ren. Maelsil ki-ren: 10 keth ye-ai ma-ye! Dor oveth hesi kieth ma-pevi!

Oshkaa! Vend-sil leth-ai pai ki-ren: vend rin tulo halo pevi! Hen tamma vend-esh, a ta kieth-tol.

Paaruk! 11-na khul, Kesh, aru-shul shen tho silir hol-ren, a wana 10 keth tho Senwe olumaen vos sa ho-pelu-tol. Khul-maar ti "shaa tahl pelu-sa" thei-ren. Kesh khul-ai oth thei-ren, a "naa-ren tho ma-thesh!" ki-ren.

Senwe! Ennal lo-ren: uma-maar aru uma ruvi, omu nu vendu, yai haru-ren. Wenvend ti mevu thei-ren, a wana mevu vos ho-wen-tol.

Yulenai! Enna wen keth-ren. Ilumaar ir tho 24 ilnuen wen-ren. Tovaa mirkaal, nul thar Orru hemnu pai dam-ren, a lisu sa kavu-ren.

Maalith! Sil tho shaa tahl ishaal, Maalith ul Nemaai a Paaruk ul Tamruk Hesh, 640-na rum-eth pai yeth-esh. Esa ul, ti sholketh anaien hesu nim, nul rum-eth ruth-esh. Henen tamma mu pai lo-esh: shen dosh-tol.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Ushai Nenn
posts.en:
Oshkaa edge health council: an ordinary turn. Two births, one entry, one
colonist who fell off a roof and is fine and would like everyone to stop
asking.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ir ashe kelsil: ossu keth-esh. Dai hesu-esh, en vend'onn-esh, a kovu ul dop, vai, "tamma ki halo!" lai en hemnu-ai-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Long hold prep. We're closing the institute to visitors for eight turns.
Sorry, Vosh. Sorry, children.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl onn om kaal-ka. 10 keth ye-ai om maelsil vhom-tol. Sehu, Vosh! Sehu, ilnuen!

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en:
*Kesh* is in our sky tonight. I've put a light out on the south wall. I
don't know if you can see it from up there.
posts.eshai: Ti nokh Kesh shi vei tho-esh. Mu naa vare tho ilmir tavi-esh. Tei vas ul esh-tol hai? Mu ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en:
From *Kesh*: we're alongside the Senwe gardens. You can see Beginning from
here, very small and green. Somebody on the ground has put out a light
toward us.
posts.eshai: Kesh ul: shi Senwe olumaen shen tho-esh. Hena ul Esa, shaa nu a veru, esh-tol. Kesu tho ossa shi pai ilmir tavi-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: I can see it.
posts.eshai: Mu esh-ka.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: That was not the council.
posts.eshai: Kelsil ma-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: I know who it was.
posts.eshai: Mu kae yul-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13756. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — The long hold will begin next turn.

**OSHKAA** — An indexer has found, in the second book of the count, a child
who was entered as a reading rather than a life: a star-watcher's apprentice
who recorded one number before she died and asked that it stand for her.
It does. The number is still correct.

**PAARUK** — Oma Varrek reports the lifting of Hesk on schedule and says she
would like it on the record that she has never once been on schedule in her
life.

**SENWE** — The gardens thank the crew of *Kesh*. One garden-keeper, Lissu
Maal, thanks one navigator, by name, and has asked that this be printed.

**YULENAI** — Tovaa has built its third roof. The settlers say they are now,
in their word, "insufferable."

**MAALITH** — The academy's first-term problem is given back. Paelu of Tovaa's
wrong answer has been made into a problem of its own for the next intake of
students, who will be asked to find where it goes wrong. It took the fold
school four days.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13756! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Shaa tahl onn wana keth ho-esa-ren.

Oshkaa! Vendai daina kodi tho, asheth ma-ren velu shiruth olu vend'onn ilnu vael-ren. Tai-wenai anai-ren: teth nim en vendu thesh-ren a "ti mu om tar!" ki-ren. Tar-ren. Vendu ke eeth-ren.

Paaruk! Oma Varrek "Hesk tai'ulo ranu tho-ren" lo-ren, a ti dam ki-ren: hen ashe tho envi ranu tho ma-anam-esh.

Senwe! Olumaen Kesh khul-ai hael-ren. Oluma-thar-ai en, Lissu Maal, en urai, thei sa, hael-ren, a "thesh!" ki-ren.

Yulenai! Tovaa tirna kovu kaal-ren. Hemnu-ai henen loth sa "vashu" lo-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar enna sholketh kieth yevi-ren. Tovaa ul Paelu khelu oveth wana enni anaien om enni kieth-ren: henen kae khelu wa vael-tol. Thaavi shol-sil kaav sau hol-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
I tutored two Maalith students today and they called me "Paelu of Tovaa"
the whole time like I'm a star.
posts.eshai: Mu ti sau dai Maalith anaien sholu-esh a henen tamma tahl, mu tai olu, "Tovaa ul Paelu" thei-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: That's what the digest does to people. You'll get used to it. I haven't.
posts.eshai: Naa-ren aien pai ta kaal-esh. Tei ho-annet-tol. Mu ma-annet-esh.

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en:
The council thanks *Kesh*. The council also notes that one garden-keeper
has asked that her thanks be printed by name, which the council has never
done, and has agreed to.
posts.eshai: Kelsil Kesh hael-esh. Kelsil yo vend-esh: oluma-thar-ai en hen hael thei sa thesh ki-esh, kelsil nulvi ti kaal-esh, a sama-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Long hold, depth 16, begun. Far-end term log attached, first eighth of a
turn: zero.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl onn, ithen 16, esa-esh. Onn'ir vendu vend sa-esh, keth enna en-nul-na dalu: nul-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Holding depth 16. Long hold begun. It's quiet in here. It's like standing at the edge of a very deep well that doesn't echo.
posts.eshai: Ithen 16 onn-ka. Shaa tahl onn esa-esh. Hena nulren-esh. Ma-ruvi-hollu shaa ith uma-ith ir tho tar olu-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
The long hold has begun. Depth 16. The fold is open and we are holding it.
It is the strangest feeling. It's like holding a door in a wind that isn't
blowing.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl onn esa-esh. Ithen 16-esh. Thaavi vhen-esh a shi onn-ka. Shaa khethi-esh. Ma-rum shuu tho vhaal onn olu-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Kiru, please write that down properly for the count.
posts.eshai: Kiru, vend om ta vai thesh, yenu!

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: I just did.
posts.eshai: Mu kev thesh-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13757. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — Depth 16, held. The long hold has begun.

**OSHKAA** — The Index has opened a place in the count for the long hold, so
that the array's builders can file their readings as they come. The
institute thanks the Index and says it will be sending "a great many
numbers."

**PAARUK** — The eight hulls not escorting the rogue world have returned to
their stations and their ordinary work, which this turn was a comet.

**SENWE** — Beginning's valley has flowered. The council has asked visitors
to walk only on the stones laid for them.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey has published the whole of its extended
sweep. It is the largest map of nothing ever made, and the survey is proud
of it.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly sat for an eighth of a day and adjourned: nothing
before it. The Speaker, Dannar Weth, says this is the Assembly working as
designed.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13757! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Ithen 16, onn-ren. Shaa tahl onn esa-ren.

Oshkaa! Maarmir kaal-ai henen shiruth ye temu vend om, Vend-sil vend tho shaa tahl onn om ru vhen-ren. Maelsil Vend-sil hael-ren, a "shaa maar vendu" ho-pevi-tol lo-ren.

Paaruk! Aru-shul ma-pelu-sa 10 khul henen silir a henen savo pai yevi-ren. Ti keth savo tai-pelu-ren.

Senwe! Esa dovu lilu-ren. Kelsil ye-ai pai ki-ren: henen om tavi lith tho enen pelu!

Yulenai! Naa wenvend tamma shaa naa wen thesh-ren. Nul som ul tuv ormeth-ren, a wenvend ahi-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar en-nul-na dalu sau hed a halo-ren, tolen nim nul kieth-ren. Lo-ai, Dannar Weth, "Kel-maar kaal-esh olu savo-tol" lo-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: Word.
posts.eshai: Loth!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
I'm on leave walking my own line. I'll be in reading room four. Do not
bring me anything to file. I will file it.
posts.eshai: Mu savo halo tahl tho mu thel pelu-ka. Mu kaavna lethsil tho ho-anam-tol. Vend om mu pai som ma-helu! Mu ho-vend-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Proud. Of the array. Not of you.
posts.eshai: Vel-esh. Maarmir rin-esh. Tei rin ma-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: I'll take it.
posts.eshai: Mu hol-tol.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
Having now attended one of Nemaai's pulse nights under protest: it is a
pleasant noise with a theory attached. I stand by it.
posts.eshai: Kev Nemaai tu nokh, dekh sa, hed-esh: maelith sa vai hollu-esh. Mu ta onn-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: You stayed to the end.
posts.eshai: Tei teth pai anam-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: The door was on the other side of the room.
posts.eshai: Vhaal sil oth dalu tho-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: You hummed.
posts.eshai: Tei humu-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Everyone hummed. It's contagious. That is a biological observation.
posts.eshai: Tamma-ai humu-esh. Pesh-tol. Ta ashe-eth shiruth-esh.

posts.author: Pellu Eth
posts.en:
Orru has had the Tovaa instrument for two turns. We've ground them a lens
to say thank you. Our first ever.
posts.eshai: Orru Tovaa mirkaal dai keth thar-esh. Hael lo om shi henen om shel khom-esh. Shi enna-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
Walked my line back four books on my leave. We have been arguing with each other in the margins of the count for fifty long turns. I found an
ancestor who wrote "no" next to her own daughter's entry. Just "no."
posts.eshai: Mu savo halo tahl tho mu thel kaav kodi nim pai pelu-esh. 62 keth-maar shi vend iren tho shi sa dekh-esh. Mu ossu thel-ai vael-esh, hen ilnu vend'onneth shen "ma" thesh-esh. Enen "ma"-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: That's where you get it.
posts.eshai: Tei ta tena ul hol-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: That's where *you* get it.
posts.eshai: TEI ta tena ul hol-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Long hold. Far-end term: zero.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl onn-esh. Onn'ir vendu nul-esh.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en:
The lattice flowered. Here's the picture. It's small, and it's blue, and
it's by the south wall where I put it.
posts.eshai: Vesk lilu-esh. Eshom ti-esh. Nu-esh, a thalu-esh, a mu tavi ru tho naa vare shen-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: Yours is better.
posts.eshai: Tei yai vai-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13760. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — Held.

**OSHKAA** — One of the Index's own, Yulen Dar, born in Theruun, has spent her leave in
the reading rooms walking her own line back four books. She reports that
her ancestors argued with each other on every page and that she comes by
it honestly.

**PAARUK** — The comet has been moved.

**SENWE** — Kovel Tann of the Senwe systems school has written to this digest
to say that pulse music is "a pleasant noise with a theory attached." This
digest has also received the replies. They are longer.

**YULENAI** — Orru has returned Tovaa's instrument with a gift: a second
lens, ground by hand.

**MAALITH** — Nemaai held a pulse night in the voice room. Sixty-four stars,
each by its own beat, and one pause in the middle for the one that stopped a
long time ago. I sat in the back and could not see anything, which is the
idea.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13760! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Onn-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil ul en, Theruun tho hesu Yulen Dar, hen savo halo tahl lethsilen tho hen thel kaav kodi nim pai pelu-ren. Hen lo-ren: hen ossu thel-ai tamma kodi dalu tho dekh-esh, a hen ta eeth ul hol-tol.

Paaruk! Tai-pelu rum-ren.

Senwe! Senwe ul Kovel Tann naa-ren pai thesh-ren: tuleth "maelith sa vai hollu-tol." Naa-ren oveth-en yo ren-ren. Henen yai tahl-ren.

Yulenai! Orru Tovaa mirkaal dameth sa yevi-ren. Dameth lisu sa khom daina shel-ren.

Maalith! Nemaai lohu-sil tho tu nokh dam-esh. 100 tai, tamma henen tu sa, lo-esh, a mesu tho shaa ossu halo tai om envi halo-esh. Mu dor hed a som ma-esh-esh, a ta maeleth-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Pohru Denn
posts.en:
The eight hulls moved a comet. The fourth did the actual moving. I've been
told I'm not allowed to say that in shenai.
posts.eshai: 10 khul tai-pelu rum-esh. Kaavna eeth rum-esh. Mu shenai tho ta lo ma-dam-vaa.

posts.author: Hollen Aavi
posts.en:
Edge station: fold weather clear. The freighter that sings came through
again. I've decided it's a cargo pilot called Doru who hums in the galley.
I have no evidence.
posts.eshai: Ir silir: thaavi shehu shiu-esh. Selu kavu-vessa ruvi vos-esh. Mu kel-esh: Doru thei kavu-som urai, yam-sil tho humu-tol. Mu nul esheth thar-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en:
This is Ris. I'm borrowing Ahriel's keystone for one message. I had my
first-look. Through the Orru lens. I didn't give it back for a whole night.
Paelu, I saw a moon.
posts.eshai: Ris ti-esh. Mu en loth om Ahriel onnith hol-ka. Mu enna wen kaal-esh. Orru shel vos-esh. Tamma nokh ma-yevi-esh. Paelu, mu mel esh-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Ris! Which moon?
posts.eshai: Ris! Kevai mel hai?

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: The small one. It was a small moon. It was mine.
posts.eshai: Nu mel-esh. Nu mel-esh. Mu mel-esh.

posts.author: Ahriel Tovaa
posts.en:
Keystone returned. Ris has been told keystones are not toys. Ris says
the moon isn't a toy either and so it's fine.
posts.eshai: Onnith yevi-esh. Ris pai "onnithen ishu-som ma-esh" vol-esh. Ris "mel yo ishu-som ma-esh, a ta vai-tol" lo-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Long hold. Far-end term: zero.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl onn-esh. Onn'ir vendu nul-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13761. Six headings. All relays clear.

Today I have set this digest down for two long turns. Hesh Anvaar set it down for a long turn and a half before me. I am told the custom is to say something at two. Here it is: thank you for sending it.

**THERUUN** — Held.

**OSHKAA** — The Index reports eleven thousand names in the new book.

**PAARUK** — The lifting of Hesk has reached its first deep layer. Oma Varrek
sends a reading of the star's colour, which is, she says, "already
calmer."

**SENWE** — The rogue world has passed its nearest point to the gardens, at
the distance the Fleet promised to the width of a hand. *Kesh* walks on with
it.

**YULENAI** — First-look at Tovaa for Ris, the younger child of Maru and
Aanu, who looked through the Orru lens and would not give it back.

**MAALITH** — Many readers sent the curator something for the two long turns.
Paelu sent a question. It is: what was the first thing you printed? It was
the weather on the Maalith fold. I have looked it up. It was fine.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13761! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Kev mu ti naa-ren dai keth-maar vend-esh. Hesh Anvaar nim en keth-maar a dalu vend-esh. Orth: dai tho som lo-vaa. Ti-esh: pevi om hael!

Theruun! Onn-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil enni kodi tho 25370 thei lo-ren.

Paaruk! Hesk tai'ulo enna ith thom pai yeth-ren. Oma Varrek tai shiruth pevi-ren, a hen lo-ren: "Kev yai orm-tol."

Senwe! Khul-maar dam naa tho, lisu tuv olu, aru-shul olumaen pai shaa shen yeth-ren. Kesh sa pelu-ren.

Yulenai! Tovaa tho Maru a Aanu daina ilnu, Ris, enna wen-ren, a Orru shel vos wen a ma-yevi-ren.

Maalith! Maar leth-ai dai keth-maar om vendai pai som pevi-esh. Paelu kieth pevi-esh: "Enna thesh som kevai hai?" Maalith thaavi shehu-esh. Mu ruvi leth-esh. Vai-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Thank you for all the notes about the two long turns. I read every one. I
am told I was supposed to say something at two and I said "thank you," which
is what I mean.
posts.eshai: Dai keth-maar rin thesh-eth tamma om hael! Mu tamma leth-esh. Dai tho som lo-vaa a mu "hael" lo-esh, a ta mu loma som-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: She was going to be a fold physicist, you know. Better than she'll admit.
posts.eshai: Hen khaa-ren-ai ho-tol, tei yul-esh. Hen lo ul yai vai-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Worse than you'll admit.
posts.eshai: Tei lo ul yai ma-vai-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: I don't admit things.
posts.eshai: Mu som ma-lo-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Holding. The door to the array hall is stuck again. Eleventh request.
posts.eshai: Onn-ka. Maarmir sil vhaal ruvi khim-esh. 13-na ki-eth-esh.

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en: Eleven thousand names in the new book. Thank you.
posts.eshai: Enni kodi tho 25370 thei-esh. Hael!

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Gave the new navigators my rogue-world lecture. It went long. I got to the
part about the lean and one of them asked what the lesson was and I said
"eventually" and she wrote it down.
posts.eshai: Enni uraien pai mu aru-shul sholeth dam-esh. Tahl-esh. Mu taku dalu pai yeth-esh a henen ul en "sholeth kevai hai?" ki-esh a mu "dorvi" lo-esh a hen ta thesh-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: That was me, most of a long turn ago. It's still in my notes.
posts.eshai: En keth-maar dalu tuv nim, ta mu-esh. Ke mu thesh-eth tho-esh.
