posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Long hold. Far-end term: zero. The array hall door sticks. Unrelated,
filed separately, eleventh time.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl onn-esh. Onn'ir vendu nul-esh. Maarmir sil vhaal khim-esh. Oth som-esh, oth vend-esh, 13-na vi-esh.

posts.author: Hiraal Ok
posts.en:
The Old Glass closes for cleaning. Once a long turn. Please do not leave
flowers at the door. Last time we couldn't open it.
posts.eshai: Ossu Shel shim om vhom-ka. En keth-maar tho envi-esh. Yenu, vhaal tho lilu ma-tavi! Nim vi shi vhen ma-piru-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13762. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — Held.

**OSHKAA** — At Yulen Dar's request the Index has sent her mother in Theruun copies of
four books of their line. It has also asked Yulen to stop correcting the
other indexers' handwriting, which it notes is not her job.

**PAARUK** — Tamruk Hesh, who commanded the old seventh hull, gave the
Fleet's new navigators their first lecture of the term. It was, the Fleet
reports, "long, and about a rogue world, and then suddenly about
everything."

**SENWE** — The Senwe council has agreed to let one child from each garden
world see the ocean world through Ennal's instruments, from orbit, without
landing. The children are asked to look and not to measure.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey will go out again, further, in a long turn.
The survey's director says she already knows what it will find, and will go
anyway, because that is not the same as looking.

**MAALITH** — The academy's winter term. The Old Glass is closed for cleaning,
which the students are told happens once a long turn and is treated as a
small death.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13762! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Onn-ren.

Oshkaa! Yulen Dar ki sa, Vend-sil Theruun tho hen ammu pai henen thel kaav kodi pevi-ren. Hen Yulen pai yo ki-ren: oth vendai thesh ma-tamu! Ta hen savo ma-ren.

Paaruk! Ossu 7-na khul anvu-esh Tamruk Hesh khul-maar enni urai pai enna sholeth dam-ren. Khul-maar lo-ren: "Tahl-esh, aru-shul rin-esh, tekev khev tamma som rin-esh."

Senwe! Senwe kelsil sama-ren: tamma oluma aru ul en ilnu Ennal mirkaal vos, vhoru tho, ma-yeth, uma-maar aru ho-wen-tol. Ilnuen pai ki-ren: wen, ma-shiru!

Yulenai! Naa wenvend en keth-maar dor, yai naa, ruvi ho-sheva-ren. Wenvend anvu-ai lo-ren: hen ho-vael som kev yul-esh, velu ke ho-wa-tol, tolen ta wen olu ma-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar khol mevu-esh. Ossu Shel shim om vhom-esh. Anaien ti en keth-maar tho envi-vaa, a nu teth olu thar-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Neveth Iru
posts.en: The rest of the gardens are quiet. The south terraces are resting.
posts.eshai: Olumaen oth nulren-esh. Naa tarruen hed-ka.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
The Old Glass is closed for cleaning. We're told it's like a small death.
Is that true?
posts.eshai: Ossu Shel shim om vhom-esh. Nu teth olu-vaa. Ta eeth hai?

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: It's a very clean death. It comes back.
posts.eshai: Shaa shim teth-esh. Hen yevi-tol.

posts.author: Tannar Voe
posts.en: New hull begun. Hull ten. In case the Fleet ever needs ten.
posts.eshai: Enni khul esa-esh. 12-na khul-esh. Yem khul-maar envi 12 hesi-tol.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: Word.
posts.eshai: Loth!

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Long hold. Far-end term: drifting above zero in the last place, within
tolerance. Probably the instrument warming.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl onn-esh. Onn'ir vendu tethna dalu tho, vai mesu tho, nul ul ulo rum-ka. Seshu mirkaal haru-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Library.
posts.eshai: Lethsil-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: That's where you live, that's not a word.
posts.eshai: Tei tena ashe-esh, ta loth ma-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13763. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — Held.

**OSHKAA** — A reading room in the Index has been given over to the long
hold's numbers. The indexers say they are the most beautiful thing they have
filed since the poems, and much easier to shelve.

**PAARUK** — The yards report a new hull begun, the first in half a long turn,
"in case the Fleet ever needs ten."

**SENWE** — The children have seen the ocean world. One of them asked
whether the lineages knew they were being watched. The council has taken the
question seriously and will answer it next turn.

**YULENAI** — Tovaa's children have been taught to grind a lens. Tovaa now
has four lenses and one grinding stone, which is, the settlers say, the
wrong way round.

**MAALITH** — The Old Glass is clean. The students were allowed back in and
did not speak for a long time.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13763! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Onn-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil tho lethsil shaa tahl onn vendu om dam-ren. Vendai lo-ren: tulo dor henen vend ilsa som-ren, a onnu pai tavi yai vai-ren.

Paaruk! Dalu keth-maar tho enna, kaalsil enni khul esa-ren: "Yem khul-maar envi 12 hesi-tol."

Senwe! Ilnuen uma-maar aru wen-ren. Henen ul en ki-ren: "Thelen henen wen-ka yul hai?" Kelsil kieth shaa seth-ren, a wana keth ho-oveth-tol.

Yulenai! Tovaa ilnuen shel khom annet-ren. Kev Tovaa kaav shel a en khom-lith thar-ren, a hemnu-ai "khelu lom-tol" lo-ren.

Maalith! Ossu Shel shim-esh. Anaien ruvi vhen-esh, a shaa tahl ma-lo-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Holding. It's routine now, which is its own kind of miracle. Also: the door
to the array hall is stuck again. It has been stuck since the transient. I
have filed a request. I have filed eleven requests. I am starting to believe
the door has opinions.
posts.eshai: Onn-ka. Kev ossu ranu-esh, a ta khethi vai som-esh. Yo: maarmir sil vhaal ruvi khim-esh. Keru ul khim-esh. Mu ki-eth vend-esh. Mu 13 ki-eth vend-esh. Mu vhaal mael-eth thar mael esa-ka.

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en: First deep layer of Hesk. The star is calmer. You can see it.
posts.eshai: Hesk enna ith thom-esh. Tai yai orm-esh. Tei esh-tol.

posts.author: Hollen Aavi
posts.en: Edge station: fold weather clear. Quiet night.
posts.eshai: Ir silir: thaavi shehu shiu-esh. Nulren nokh-esh.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en:
Long hold. Far-end term: within tolerance. Log attached. Going to get the
door open.
posts.eshai: Shaa tahl onn-esh. Onn'ir vendu vai mesu tho-esh. Vend sa-esh. Mu vhaal vhen om wa-ka.

posts.author: Kiru Senn
posts.en: Door's stuck again. Service hatch. Twelfth request filed. The fold's fine.
posts.eshai: Vhaal ruvi khim-esh. Nu vhaal-esh. 14-na ki-eth vend-esh. Thaavi vai-esh.

posts.author: Vosh Anneth
posts.en: Tomorrow's lesson is the lattice.
posts.eshai: Wana sau sholeth vesk-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother, you haven't sent your turn's word to the Theruun room.
posts.eshai: Ammu, tei keth loth Theruun sil pai ma-pevi-esh.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: I'm at the array. Eat something. You never eat when you're at the Index.
posts.eshai: Mu maarmir tho-esh. Som yamu! Tei Vend-sil tho anam temu nulvi yamu-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: I'm eating.
posts.eshai: Mu yamu-ka.

posts.author: Aveth Dar
posts.en: You're lying. Eat something. Talk next turn.
posts.eshai: Tei khelu lo-ka. Som yamu! Wana keth lo!

posts.author: Hiraal Ok
posts.en:
The Old Glass is clean. The first student back in stood there so long we
had to ask her to let the next one have a turn.
posts.eshai: Ossu Shel shim-esh. Enna yevi anai shaa tahl tar-esh, a shi hen pai "wana ai wen dam!" ki hesi-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13764. Six headings. All relays clear.

**THERUUN** — Held.

**OSHKAA** — Quiet at the Index. The indexers have used the quiet to repair
the oldest shelf, and have entered the repair.

**PAARUK** — Nothing from the yards. Oma Varrek reports this is her preference
and asks that it be printed again.

**SENWE** — The council's answer to the child: the lineages do not know they
are watched, and that is why we must behave as though they do.

**YULENAI** — The frontier council has asked that the next outer survey carry
a child from each settlement, "so that somebody young has seen the edge."

**MAALITH** — A clear turn. Nothing before the Assembly. The relay hall's
lamps were left on all night so that the students could sit under Nemaai's
map and listen to it. Several of them fell asleep there.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13764! Sul yathi-ren. Tamma vhaal-maar shiu-ren.

Theruun! Onn-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil tho nulren-ren. Vendai nulren tho ossu onnu tamu-ren, a tameth vend'onn-ren.

Paaruk! Kaalsil ul nul som-ren. Oma Varrek "mu ti lai-esh" lo-ren, a "ruvi thesh!" ki-ren.

Senwe! Kelsil ilnu pai oveth-ren: thelen henen wen-ka ma-yul-tol, a ta tolen shi henen yul olu savo hesi-tol.

Yulenai! Ilumaar ir kelsil ki-ren: wana naa wenvend tamma hemnu ul en ilnu kavu, "enni ossa ir esh om!"

Maalith! Shiu keth-esh. Kel-maar nim nul kieth-esh. Anaien Nemaai ormeth dor hed a ren om, vhaal-maar sil ilmiren tamma nokh ilu anam-esh. Henen ul maar tena munu-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: Move 660. Your fifth stone is in trouble, Nemaai.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 660! Nemaai, tei pemna lith kieth tho-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: My fifth stone is bait, Tamruk.
posts.eshai: Tamruk, mu pemna lith khava-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: I know. I'm taking it anyway. Life's short.
posts.eshai: Mu yul-esh. Mu ke hol-ka. Ashe nu-esh.

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en:
Quiet turn. We repaired the oldest shelf and entered the repair. It's the
most Oshkaa thing I've ever done.
posts.eshai: Nulren keth-esh. Shi ossu onnu tamu a tameth vend'onn-esh. Ta mu kaal-esh som ul shaa Oshkaa-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: *Kesh* is home. Mother, I'm coming down.
posts.eshai: Kesh hemi tho-esh. Ammu, mu dop pai ye-ka.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en: Senwe doesn't meet hulls.
posts.eshai: Senwe khul ma-shenu-esh.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en: I'll be at the landing.
posts.eshai: Mu yethsil tho ho-anam-tol.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Someone at the Maalith array recorded a pulsar nobody's heard before, out
past Yulenai. It ticks like a small clock and then, every eighth tick,
stutters. I've played it forty times today. I'm going to call it the
Hiccup and nobody can stop me.
posts.eshai: Maalith maarmir tho ossa nim nul-ai ren-esh tai-tu, Yulenai vos, thesh-esh. Nu tumir olu tu-esh a tekev, tamma 10-na tu, ukku-esh. Mu ti sau 50 vi ishu-esh. Mu "Ukku" ho-thei-tol a nul-ai halo-piru-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13765. Six headings. The Theruun relay is late.

**THERUUN** — Nothing heard this turn. The Theruun relay has been late
before, in bad fold weather, and the Oshkaa relay reports its Theruun link
open.

**OSHKAA** — The Index asks the long hold's builders to resume sending their
numbers when the relay returns; the reading room has shelves waiting.

**PAARUK** — The lifting of Hesk continues.

**SENWE** — The rogue world is past. *Kesh* has handed it on to the empty
space beyond Senwe and is coming home.

**YULENAI** — The Orru settlement reports its first first-look through its
own lens.

**MAALITH** — The academy's mid-term. Paelu of Tovaa has been asked to tutor two
students from Maalith, which Paelu reports is "very strange."

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13765! Sul yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar kheru-ren.

Theruun! Ti keth nul som ren-esh. Theruun vhaal-maar nim, ma-vai thaavi shehu tho, kheru-esh, a Oshkaa vhaal-maar henen Theruun sumu shiu lo-ren. Ma-vokh-tol.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil ki-ren: vhaal-maar yevi temu, shaa tahl onn kaal-ai henen vendu ruvi pevi! Lethsil tho onnuen tahli-ren.

Paaruk! Hesk tai'ulo ke-ren.

Senwe! Aru-shul vos-ren. Kesh hen Senwe dor nul ru pai dam-ren a hemi yevi-ren.

Yulenai! Orru hemnu henen shel vos enna enna wen-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar sholketh mesu-ren. Maalith ul dai anaien om Tovaa ul Paelu sholu ki-ren, a Paelu "shaa khethi" lo-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
Has anybody heard from Theruun this turn? My mother hasn't answered in two.
She's at the array for the long hold, so probably nothing, but she always
sends her word.
posts.eshai: Ti keth ossa Theruun ul ren-esh hai? Mu ammu dai keth tho ma-oveth-esh. Hen shaa tahl onn om maarmir tho-esh, a seshu nul som-tol, velu hen tammavi hen loth pevi-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: The Theruun relay is late. It has been late before.
posts.eshai: Theruun vhaal-maar kheru-ren. Nim yo kheru-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
The council hasn't met this turn either. I'm sure it's the hold. They'll all
be staring at one number. Kiru will be arguing with a door.
posts.eshai: Ti keth kelsil yo ma-hed-esh. Shaa tahl onn-tol, mu yul-esh. Tamma en vendu wen-tol. Kiru vhaal sa dekh-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Probably.
posts.eshai: Seshu-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Nothing from the institute's log for two turns. Theruun colleagues: if you
are reading this, post one number. Any number.
posts.eshai: Dai keth maelsil vend ul nul som-esh. Theruun savo-ai, yem teien ti leth-ka, en vendu thesh! Kae vendu!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13766. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

There is no Theruun heading this turn, because there is nothing heard to put
under it. The Oshkaa relay reports the link open and nothing on it. It has
checked its own end three times.

**OSHKAA** — The Index has kept the long hold's shelves open.

**PAARUK** — Hesk continues.

**SENWE** — *Kesh* is home. The garden-keeper who thanked its navigator went
to meet the hull, which Senwe does not do.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey has asked for permission to point its
instruments inward, toward Theruun, for a turn.

**MAALITH** — The fold school reports no fold weather between Oshkaa and
Theruun that would explain the silence. It reports this as a fact and not as
a worry.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13766! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Ti keth Theruun yathi nul-esh, tolen tho tavi ren-eth nul-esh. Oshkaa vhaal-maar sumu shiu a tena nul som lo-ren. Hen henen ir tir vi shiru-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil shaa tahl onn onnuen vhen thar-ren.

Paaruk! Hesk ke-ren.

Senwe! Kesh hemi tho-ren. Henen urai hael-esh oluma-thar-ai khul shenu om wa-ren, a Senwe ta nulvi savo-esh.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend en keth om henen mirkaal ith pai, Theruun pai, rum dam ki-ren.

Maalith! Thaavi shol-sil lo-ren: Oshkaa a Theruun mesu tho nulren toleth thaavi shehu nul-ren. Hen ti eeth olu vol-ren, vokh olu ma-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Theruun's too busy being clever to talk to the rest of us. Give them a
turn.
posts.eshai: Theruun shaa savo-ka a shi sa ma-lo-tol. Henen en keth dam!

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
Theruun has always believed the cluster runs on Theruun time. This is a
relay fault and some vanity. Next turn they'll send us a paper about it.
posts.eshai: Theruun tammavi Ilumaar Theruun tahl tho savo mael-esh. Ti vhaal-maar khelu a nu vel-tol. Wana keth henen shi pai ta rin thesheth ho-pevi-tol.

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en:
The Oshkaa relay has checked the Theruun link three times. It's open and
there's nothing on it.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa vhaal-maar Theruun sumu tir vi shiru-esh. Shiu-esh a tena nul som-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Can you still reach them by keystone? The relay and the hall are different.
posts.eshai: Tei ke henen onnith sa yeth-tol hai? Vhaal-maar a sil oth-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Good question. I've tried. Nobody on the array council is answering their
keystone. That's the part I don't like. I'm telling you because you asked
exactly the right question, not because I know what it means.
posts.eshai: Vai kieth-esh. Mu piru-esh. Maarmir kelsil tho nul-ai henen onnith oveth-esh. Mu ta dalu ma-lai-esh. Mu kevai loma yul tolen ma, tolen tei tiru eeth kieth ki-esh, mu tei pai vol-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Nobody in the Theruun room has posted since the turn before the relay went quiet.
posts.eshai: Vhaal-maar nulren nim keth ul, Theruun sil tho nul-ai thesh-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Nobody on the array council answers a keystone. Keystones don't use the
relay. I don't know what takes out every keystone in a galaxy and leaves
the hall's own lines clear. I've checked the hall's lines. They're clear.
posts.eshai: Maarmir kelsil tho nul-ai onnith oveth-esh. Onnithen vhaal-maar ma-hol-esh. Ilma tho tamma onnith khet a sil henen sumu shiu thar kevai som-tol mu ma-yul-esh. Mu sil sumu shiru-esh. Shiu-esh.

posts.author: Esko Lirai
posts.en:
The outer survey has asked to turn its instruments inward, toward Theruun.
First time in the survey's history. It feels wrong. We're doing it.
posts.eshai: Naa wenvend henen mirkaal ith pai, Theruun pai, rum ki-esh. Wenvend tho enna vi-esh. Khelu-esh. Shi ta kaal-ka.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13767. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

I have been asked why this digest has not printed what the freighter crews
are saying. The answer is in digest 13745.

**OSHKAA** — The Oshkaa relay will send a ship down the Theruun link to find
where it is broken.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet has been asked by the Assembly to prepare to go to the
Theruun edge if the relay ship finds nothing. The Fleet reports it is
prepared, and was before it was asked.

**SENWE** — The outer survey's inward look is granted.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey looks inward.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly sits on the Theruun relay next turn.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13767! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Ossa mu pai ki-esh: kavu-vessa khul-ai lo som naa-ren kevai ma-thesh hai? Oveth naa-ren 13745 tho-esh.

Oshkaa! Kae khet vael om, Oshkaa vhaal-maar Theruun sumu vos vessa ho-pevi-ren.

Paaruk! Kel-maar khul-maar pai ki-ren: yem vhaal-maar vessa nul vael, Theruun ir pai wa om kaal! Khul-maar tharu-esh lo-ren, a ki nim tharu-esh.

Senwe! Naa wenvend ith pai wen dam-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend ith pai wen-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar wana keth Theruun vhaal-maar rin ho-hed-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en:
My cousin runs freight on the Oshkaa–Theruun line. He says a freighter came
back from the Theruun edge. The relay station was lit and nobody answered.
He heard it from the pilot's crew.
posts.eshai: Mu thel-ai Oshkaa a Theruun lom tho kavu-som savo-esh. Hen lo-esh: kavu-vessa Theruun ir ul yevi-vaa. Vhaal-maar silir ilu-vaa a nul-ai oveth-vaa. Hen urai khul-ai ul ren-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Hanu, I'm sorry, that's told, not heard.
posts.eshai: Hanu, sehu! Ta vol-eth-esh, ren-eth ma-esh.

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en: I know. I'm saying it anyway. It's the only thing anybody knows.
posts.eshai: Mu yul-esh. Mu ke lo-ka. Ossa yul enen som-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Thank you, Hanu.
posts.eshai: Hanu, hael!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Pohru Denn
posts.en:
The Fleet's been told to be ready to go to Theruun. My partner says it's
nothing. My partner always says it's nothing.
posts.eshai: Khul-maar pai "Theruun pai wa om tharu!" lo-vaa. Mu thavi "nul som-esh" lo-esh. Mu thavi tammavi "nul som-esh" lo-esh.

posts.author: Kessa Imaa
posts.en:
Edge colonies: a freighter came back past us from the Theruun side. The
pilot wouldn't say much. He said the station was lit.
posts.eshai: Ir hemnuen: kavu-vessa Theruun dalu ul shi vos yevi-esh. Urai nuri lo-esh. Hen silir ilu lo-vaa.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en: Where is *Kesh* going?
posts.eshai: Kesh kae pai wa hai?

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13770. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

**OSHKAA** — The relay ship has gone down the Theruun link.

**PAARUK** — The Assembly has sent the Ninefold Fleet to the Theruun edge. All
nine hulls left within the turn. It is four turns to the edge.

**SENWE** — The Senwe council asks the Fleet to take a survey-keeper, in case
there is anything alive that must not be touched. The Fleet has taken two.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey reports Theruun's stars as they were. The
survey notes that this means nothing: the light it sees left Theruun long
ago.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly sat for most of a day on the Theruun relay and
decided to wait for the Fleet. The Speaker says waiting was also a decision
and asks that it be recorded as one.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13770! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Oshkaa! Vhaal-maar vessa Theruun sumu vos wa-ren.

Paaruk! Kel-maar 11 khul-maar Theruun ir pai pevi-ren. Keth tho tamma 11 khul sheva-ren. Ir pai kaav keth-ren.

Senwe! Senwe kelsil khul-maar pai ki-ren: wenvend-tharai hol, tesh ma-hesi ashe som tena anam yem! Khul-maar dai hol-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend Theruun taien nim olu esh-ren. Wenvend ti nul ma-lo-tol lo-ren: hen esh ilun shaa ossu ul Theruun ul sheva-esh.

Maalith! Kel-maar sau dalu tuv Theruun vhaal-maar rin hed-ren, a khul-maar tahli kel-ren. Lo-ai lo-ren: tahli yo kel-eth-esh, a ta olu vend ki-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
The Assembly's sending the girls and boys to the Theruun edge. All nine
hulls. Four turns, and it'll be something dull, and
Theruun will be embarrassed for a long turn. We'll know in a few turns.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar ilnuen Theruun ir pai pevi-ka. Tamma 11 khul-esh. Kaav keth-tol, a wesh som ho-tol, a Theruun en keth-maar ho-shimu-tol. Nuri keth tho shi ho-yul-tol.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: We're going. Can't say more. Tamruk, I'll hold her steady.
posts.eshai: Shi wa-ka. Yai lo ma-piru-tol. Tamruk, mu hen orm ho-onn-tol.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: I know you will.
posts.eshai: Mu yul-esh.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en: Theruun edge. I can't say more, Mother. I'll write when I can.
posts.eshai: Theruun ir-esh. Ammu, mu yai ma-lo-tol. Piru temu mu ho-thesh-tol.

posts.author: Tannar Voe
posts.en:
All nine left the stations. The yards are very quiet without them.
Hull ten is half built. We keep building.
posts.eshai: Tamma 11 silir sheva-esh. Henen ma-sa kaalsil shaa nulren-esh. 12-na khul dalu kaal-esh. Shi ke kaal-ka.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
For the Fleet's survey-keepers, what to measure if there's nobody to ask,
in order: (1) the far-end term at the array, if the array is running;
(2) any remains, of anything; (3) the fold weather along the relay; (4)
everything else. I can't tell you why (1) is first. It's first.
posts.eshai: Khul-maar wenvend-tharai om, ki om nul-ai yem, kevai shiru, ranu tho! 1: maarmir tho onn'ir vendu, yem maarmir savo! 2: teth som, kae som! 3: vhaal-maar vos thaavi shehu! 4: tamma oth som! 1 kevai enna-esh mu ma-vol-tol. Enna-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: What do you think it is?
posts.eshai: Teien kevai mael hai?

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
A relay fault that took out their keystone node too. Rare, not impossible.
Everybody panicking is more dangerous than whatever it is.
posts.eshai: Henen onnith ru yo khet vhaal-maar khelu-tol. Nuri vi-tol, ma-piru ma-tol. Tamma-ai vokh ta som ul yai ma-vai-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
(1) It isn't a relay fault; keystones don't go through the relay. (2) Kovel
is right that panic is dangerous. (3) I don't know what it is. That's the
one I can prove.
posts.eshai: 1, vhaal-maar khelu ma-tol; onnithen vhaal-maar vos ma-wa-esh. 2, Kovel eeth-tol: vokh ma-vai-tol. 3, mu kevai ma-yul-esh. Mu ta enen shiru piru-esh.

posts.author: Esko Lirai
posts.en:
Theruun's stars are as they were. That means nothing. That light left
before any of this.
posts.eshai: Theruun taien nim olu-esh. Ta nul som loma-tol. Ta ilun ti tamma nim sheva-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13771. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

For the first time in two long turns this digest prints something it was told
and did not hear. I print it because it is the only thing anybody knows
about Theruun, and a digest with nothing in it is a lie of its own kind. I am
sorry for it.

A freighter bound for Theruun turned back at the Theruun edge relay station.
The station was lit, its instruments running, and nobody answered the
freighter's call. The pilot did not go aboard.

**OSHKAA** — The relay ship has not reported. It is not yet late.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet is two turns from the edge.

**SENWE** — The gardens report nothing. The council asks that this be read as
an ordinary report.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey continues to look inward.

**MAALITH** — The fold school has sent Senneth Ilaar's questions for the
Fleet with the survey-keepers: what to measure, and in what order, if
there is nobody there to ask.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13771! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Dai keth-maar tho enna vi ti naa-ren vol-eth, ren-eth ma-ren, thesh-esh. Thesh-esh, tolen Theruun rin ossa yul enen som-esh, a nul som naa-ren henen khelu lo-esh. Mu sehu-esh.

Kavu-vessa, Theruun pai wa, Theruun ir vhaal-maar silir tho yevi-vaa. Silir ilu-vaa, henen mirkaal savo-vaa, a nul-ai kavu-vessa hura oveth-vaa. Urai tho ma-wa-vaa.

Oshkaa! Vhaal-maar vessa ma-vol-ren. Ke ma-kheru-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar ir ul dai keth-ren.

Senwe! Olumaen nul som lo-ren. Kelsil ki-ren: ta ossu renlo olu leth!

Yulenai! Naa wenvend ith pai wen ke-ren.

Maalith! Tena ki ossa nul yem, kevai shiru a kevai ranu tho: thaavi shol-sil Senneth Ilaar kieth-en wenvend-tharai sa khul-maar pai pevi-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
I have printed the freighter in the digest, marked as told. I'm sorry,
Hanu. You were right to say it.
posts.eshai: Mu naa-ren tho kavu-vessa, vol-eth olu, thesh-esh. Hanu, sehu! Tei lo vai-esh.

posts.author: Veth Kaari
posts.en:
A pilot on the Oshkaa edge run said the sky at the Theruun edge looked
"used." I don't know what that means. He didn't either.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ir lom tho urai lo-esh: Theruun ir tho vei "thoru" olu-vaa. Mu kevai loma ma-yul-esh. Hen yo ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Used how?
posts.eshai: Thoru kevai hai?

posts.author: Veth Kaari
posts.en: He said: like a room somebody's just left.
posts.eshai: Hen lo-esh: ossa kev sheva sil olu-vaa.

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en:
The council asks all six galaxies to keep the Theruun families in their
thoughts. The council has never asked this of anyone. We're asking.
posts.eshai: Kelsil tamma sul ilma pai ki-esh: Theruun thelen mael-eth tho thar! Kelsil nulvi ossa pai ti ki-esh. Shi ki-ka.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13772. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

**OSHKAA** — The relay ship has not reported. It was due at the Theruun edge
half a turn ago.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet is one turn from the edge.

**SENWE** — The Senwe council has asked all six galaxies to keep the Theruun
families in their thoughts, which Senwe has never asked for anybody.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — The Theruun students at the academy have been given a room of
their own, at their request, and permission to be excused from lectures. None
of them has taken it.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13772! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Oshkaa! Vhaal-maar vessa ma-vol-ren. Dalu keth nim Theruun ir tho yeth om-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar ir ul en keth-ren.

Senwe! Senwe kelsil tamma sul ilma pai ki-ren: Theruun thelen mael-eth tho thar! Senwe nim nul-ai om ti ma-ki-esh.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar Theruun anaien, henen ki sa, henen sil hol-esh, a sholeth ul sheva dam-esh. Nul-ai ta hol-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en:
The relay ship hasn't reported. It's not late yet. I'm saying that for my
own benefit.
posts.eshai: Vhaal-maar vessa ma-vol-esh. Ke ma-kheru-esh. Mu ti mu om lo-ka.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en:
The lattice has dropped its flowers. It'll do it again in a long turn.
I'm keeping the stems for you.
posts.eshai: Vesk henen lilu dop-esh. En keth-maar ruvi ho-kaal-tol. Mu keskuen tei om thar-ka.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
Oshkaa's relay ship is overdue. I have been sleeping in the Index. I've
pulled my mother's line up to the last entry and I just sit with it.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa vhaal-maar vessa kheru-ren. Mu Vend-sil tho munu-ka. Mu ammu thel tethna vend'onneth pai vhen a tena hed-ka.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Yulen, come to the pulse night. You don't have to be in Maalith; sit in
the voice room. You don't have to talk.
posts.eshai: Yulen, tu nokh pai ye! Tei Maalith tho anam ma-hesi-tol; lohu-sil tho hed! Lo ma-hesi-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Maybe.
posts.eshai: Seshu-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13773. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

**OSHKAA** — Two ships came home to the Oshkaa edge colonies from near the
Theruun link. The Oshkaa health council reports their crews exhausted and
confused. Crew members told the colony that the crews did not know which
ship was theirs.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet reached the Theruun edge at the end of the turn. It will
report next turn.

**SENWE** — Nothing.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — Nothing before the Assembly. The Assembly sat anyway.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13773! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Oshkaa! Theruun sumu shen ul dai vessa Oshkaa ir hemnuen pai yevi-ren. Oshkaa ashe kelsil khul-ai wesh a ma-yul lo-ren. Khul-ai ul aien hemnu pai lo-vaa: khul-ai henen vessa kae ma-yul-vaa.

Paaruk! Keth teth tho khul-maar Theruun ir tho yeth-ren. Wana keth ho-vol-tol.

Senwe! Nul som-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar nim nul kieth-ren. Kel-maar ke hed-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Ushai Nenn
posts.en:
Edge health council, and I'm going to say it here because I don't want to
say it in the big room: two ships came back to us from near the Theruun
link. The crews are exhausted. That isn't the part that worries me. One of
the pilots didn't know which ship was his. Not confused. He didn't know it
was a thing he could own. I had to show him his name on the hull.
posts.eshai: Ir ashe kelsil, a mu ti hena lo-tol, tolen tuv sil tho lo ma-lai-esh: Theruun sumu shen ul dai vessa shi pai yevi-esh. Khul-ai wesh-esh. Ta mu vokh som ma-esh. Uraien ul en hen vessa kae ma-yul-esh. Ma-yul ma-esh. Hen ta thar som olu ma-yul-esh. Mu khul tho hen thei hen pai wen dam hesi-esh.

posts.author: Kessa Imaa
posts.en: Ushai, what do you need?
posts.eshai: Ushai, tei kevai hesi hai?

posts.author: Ushai Nenn
posts.en: I don't know yet.
posts.eshai: Mu kev ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en:
The Oshkaa edge colonies have two ships back from near the Theruun link.
My sister's on the health council. She says the crews were exhausted and
confused, and that one of them asked her which ship was his. She had to
show him.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ir hemnuen Theruun sumu shen ul dai vessa yevi-esh. Mu senu ashe kelsil tho-esh. Hen lo-esh: khul-ai wesh a ma-yul-vaa, a en hen pai hen vessa kae ki-vaa. Hen wen dam hesi-vaa.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Exhaustion. Long runs do that. It's in every field manual.
posts.eshai: Wesh-tol. Tahl lomen ta kaal-tol. Tamma savo kodi tho-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: He's right. I once forgot my own hull's name after a double watch.
posts.eshai: Hen eeth-esh. Envi mu dai wen tahl dor mu khul thei ma-annu-esh.

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en: She said it wasn't like that. She said he didn't know it was his.
posts.eshai: Hen "ta olu ma-esh" lo-esh. Hen "hen ta hen thar som ma-yul-esh" lo-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Pohru Denn
posts.en:
They're at the Theruun edge. I haven't heard anything that isn't in the
digest. I read the digest four times.
posts.eshai: Henen Theruun ir tho-ren. Mu naa-ren tho ma-tho som ma-ren-esh. Mu naa-ren kaav vi leth-esh.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en:
Fleet readings from the Theruun edge are in. No remains of anything
living. Not decay: absence. Structures intact, instruments running, matter
where it should be. Only the living matter is missing, and the mass isn't
missing. It's there, in a different arrangement. I don't have a word for
the arrangement.
posts.eshai: Theruun ir ul khul-maar shiruth ye-ren. Ashe som teth som nul-esh. Teth ma-esh: nul-eth-esh. Kaal-somen tamma-esh, mirkaal savo-esh, ruma kae anam hesi tho-esh. Ashe ruma enen nul-esh, a ruma ma-ruth-esh. Oth ranu tho tena-esh. Ranu om mu loth ma-thar-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13774. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet reports from the Theruun edge. It asks that this
digest print its words exactly, and I have.

"The first three worlds of the Theruun edge are intact. Cities standing. The
lights are on. The instruments are running. There is water in the channels
and food on the tables. We have searched for a turn. We have found nobody.
We have not found the dead. We have found nobody, living or dead, anywhere.
We are going further in."

**OSHKAA** — The relay ship has not reported.

**SENWE** — The survey-keepers with the Fleet report nothing alive to be
protected. Nothing at all. Not a lineage. Not the blue lattice in the
Theruun gardens, which the survey had counted there for as long as there has been a survey.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13774! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar Theruun ir ul vol-ren. Hen "henen loth tiru thesh!" ki-ren, a mu thesh-esh.

"Theruun ir enna tir aru tamma-esh. Hemmaar tar-esh. Ilmiren ilu-esh. Mirkaal savo-esh. Sumu tho uma a tavu tho yam-esh. Shi en keth vael-piru-esh. Shi nul-ai vael-esh. Shi tethai ma-vael-esh. Shi nul-ai, ashe ai a tethai, kae pai, vael-esh. Shi yai ith pai ho-wa-tol."

Oshkaa! Vhaal-maar vessa ma-vol-ren.

Senwe! Khul-maar sa wenvend-tharai thar om ashe som nul lo-ren. Nul som-ren. Nul thel-ren. Wenvend tammavi tena vend-esh Theruun olumaen tho thalu vesk yo nul-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: The Fleet report's in the digest.
posts.eshai: Khul-maar renlo naa-ren tho-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Nobody.
posts.eshai: Nul-ai-esh.

posts.author: Pohru Denn
posts.en: Nobody. What does nobody mean.
posts.eshai: Nul-ai-ren. Nul-ai kevai loma hai?

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Then they went somewhere. A whole galaxy doesn't vanish. They've gone
somewhere, and the Fleet will find where.
posts.eshai: Tekev henen kae pai wa-tol. Ilma tamma ma-nul-tol. Henen kae pai wa-esh, a khul-maar kae ho-vael-tol.

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en: I don't know, Pohru. Come and sit in the yard office. It's warm in there.
posts.eshai: Pohru, mu ma-yul-esh. Kaalsil savo-sil tho ye a hed! Tena haru-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Went where? The food's on the tables.
posts.eshai: Kae pai hai? Yam tavu tho-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: I don't know, Kovel. I don't know.
posts.eshai: Kovel, mu ma-yul-esh. Mu ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother. The Fleet says nobody. I'm still going to say the word.
posts.eshai: Ammu! Khul-maar "nul-ai" lo-ren. Mu ke loth ho-lo-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Nemaai, your move.
posts.eshai: Nemaai, tei rum-eth!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Nemaai?
posts.eshai: Nemaai hai?

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13775. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

**OSHKAA** — The Great Index will enter Theruun from memory. It has never
entered a life without a record of that life, and it says so. It says also
that it has never had a galaxy without a record. Anybody who remembers
anybody from Theruun is asked to send what they remember: a name, a face,
what they said once, what they were like to argue with. The Index will
enter it. It asks that nobody wait until they are sure.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet has gone into Theruun's inner systems.

**SENWE** — Nothing.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — The academy's Theruun students have begun sending to the Index.
So have I.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13775! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil Theruun annu ul ho-vend'onn-ren. Hen asheth esheth ma-sa nulvi vend'onn-esh, a ti lo-ren. Hen esheth ma-sa ilma yo nulvi thar-esh lo-ren. Theruun ul ossa annu ossa, annu som pevi: thei, esh-eth, envi lo som, dekh sa kevai! Vend-sil vend'onn-tol. Hen ki-ren: yul nim ma-tahli!

Paaruk! Khul-maar Theruun ith taien pai wa-ren.

Senwe! Nul som-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar Theruun anaien Vend-sil pai pevi esa-esh. Mu yo-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
The Index is going to enter Theruun from memory. It has never done this.
We have never had to. Please, if you knew anybody from Theruun, even a
little, send it. A name. What they were like. A thing they said once. Don't
wait until you're sure. We'll enter it.
posts.eshai: Vend-sil Theruun annu ul ho-vend'onn-tol. Hen ti nulvi kaal-esh. Shi nulvi hesi-esh. Yenu, yem tei Theruun ul ossa yul, nu yo, pevi! Thei! Kevai olu! Envi lo som! Yul nim ma-tahli! Shi ho-vend'onn-tol.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Kiru Senn apologised to a coupling once and meant it.
posts.eshai: Kiru Senn envi sendu pai sehu a eeth lo-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Kiru Senn could hold a fold at depth 16 and could not hold a door.
posts.eshai: Kiru Senn ithen 16 thaavi onn-esh velu vhaal ma-onn-esh.

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en:
My cousin's pilot, Doru, from the Theruun edge station. He hummed in the
galley. Everybody complained. I don't know his other name.
posts.eshai: Mu thel-ai urai, Doru, Theruun ir silir ul! Hen yam-sil tho humu-esh. Tamma-ai dekh-esh. Mu hen oth thei ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
The Theruun students who came to my pulse nights: Taam, who always sat on
the left, and Sethe, who asked for the Hiccup to be played again every time.
posts.eshai: Mu tu nokhen pai ye Theruun anaien! Taam, tammavi naa dalu tho hed! A Sethe, tammavi Ukku ruvi ki!

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en:
The Great Index will enter Theruun from memory. Indexers: every reading room
is open. Every shift is open. We have never done this. We know how to do it.
It's the same as always. Somebody tells us a life and we keep it.
posts.eshai: Vend-sil Theruun annu ul ho-vend'onn-tol. Vendai: tamma lethsil vhen-esh. Tamma ranu vhen-esh. Shi ti nulvi kaal-esh. Shi ta kaal yul-esh. Tammavi olu omu-esh. Ossa shi pai asheth vol, a shi thar-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Commander Olaa Setth of the Theruun inner patrol. Beat me at the ring game
once, when I was young, in eleven moves. I've never told anybody that.
posts.eshai: Theruun ith pelu-ai thar-khul Olaa Setth! Envi, mu enni temu, ishaal tho 13 rum-eth tho mu tovu-esh. Mu ta nulvi ossa pai vol-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
There was a Theruun girl at the academy, Lirru, who lent me her notes the first turn and told me the fold school's water tasted of old copper. I don't
know her line.
posts.eshai: Shol-maar tho Theruun ilnu, Lirru, enna keth mu pai hen thesh-eth dam-esh a "thaavi shol-sil uma ossu kopu yam olu-esh" lo-esh. Mu hen thel ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Lirru Keel. I've found her. Thank you.
posts.eshai: Lirru Keel-esh. Mu hen vael-esh. Hael!

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en: Reading room four is Theruun now. I've put a sign up.
posts.eshai: Kaavna lethsil kev Theruun-esh. Mu thei-tavu tavi-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
My mother. Aveth Dar. Theruun array council. She argued with me every turn
of my life. She voted against the long hold and asked that it be kept. She
told me to eat something the last time she spoke to me, and I didn't. I'd
like that entered too.
posts.eshai: Mu ammu! Aveth Dar! Theruun maarmir kelsil! Hen mu ashe tamma keth mu sa dekh-esh. Hen shaa tahl onn om ma kel-esh a ta thar ki-esh. Hen tethna vi mu sa lo temu "som yamu!" lo-esh, a mu ma-yamu-esh. Mu ta yo vend'onn lai-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother. I've entered you.
posts.eshai: Ammu! Mu tei vend'onn-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Heard, and sure.
posts.eshai: Ren'ren! Yul'esh!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Move 703. Sorry, Tamruk. I couldn't, for a turn.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 703! Tamruk, sehu! Mu en keth ma-piru-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: I know. I waited.
posts.eshai: Mu yul-esh. Mu tahli-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Fleet: the array is running at 16 with nobody at it. Before you release
it, log the far-end term. Please. One eighth of a turn of it. Then do what
the standing orders say.
posts.eshai: Khul-maar, maarmir ithen 16 tho nul-ai sa savo-ka. Vhen nim onn'ir vendu vend! Yenu! En keth en-nul-na dalu! Tekev orth ki som kaal!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13776. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet reports Theruun's inner systems as it found the edge.
Lights. Instruments. Nobody.

At the institute the Fleet found the deep array running and holding the
fold open at depth 16, with nobody at it. The Fleet has released the array
from the institute's own controls, as the Theruun council's standing orders
require for an unattended instrument.

**OSHKAA** — The Index reports 1,400 Theruun lives entered from memory. The
indexers say the memories are arriving faster than they can be entered and
have asked nobody to stop.

**SENWE** — Nothing.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — Nothing before the Assembly that the Assembly can decide.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13776! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar Theruun ith taien ir olu vael-ren. Ilun-ren. Mirkaal-ren. Nul-ai-ren.

Maelsil tho khul-maar ith maarmir savo a ithen 16 thaavi vhen onn, nul-ai sa, vael-ren. Theruun kelsil orth nul-ai thar mirkaal om hesi olu, khul-maar maarmir maelsil anvu-mir ul vhen-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil 1400 Theruun asheth annu ul vend'onn lo-ren. Vendai lo-ren: annu henen vend'onn ul yai khev yeth-ka, a henen nul-ai pai "halo!" ma-ki-ren.

Senwe! Nul som-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar kel-tol som nim nul-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en:
The Fleet logged it and released the array. Log attached. I'm not going to
say anything about the log.
posts.eshai: Khul-maar vend a maarmir vhen-esh. Vend sa-esh. Mu vend rin som ma-ho-lo-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Neither am I.
posts.eshai: Mu yo ma-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en:
We're in Theruun's inner systems. It's the same. The lights. Everything
running. I'm writing down what I see so it's written down. I don't want to
say more in here yet.
posts.eshai: Shi Theruun ith taien tho-esh. Omu-esh. Ilmiren-esh. Tamma som savo-esh. Thesh-esh om, mu esh som thesh-ka. Hena kev yai lo ma-lai-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: Come home when they let you.
posts.eshai: Henen dam temu hemi ye!

posts.author: Ushai Nenn
posts.en:
Edge health council: more of them. Crews and now colonists who never went
near the link. It starts with somebody else's name. You watch them look for
it. Then it's their own.
posts.eshai: Ir ashe kelsil: yai maar-esh. Khul-ai-esh, a kev sumu shen pai nulvi wa hemnu-ai yo-esh. Oth ai thei ul esa-esh. Tei henen ta vael-piru wen-esh. Tekev henen thei-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 13777. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent. The Oshkaa edge
relay is late.

**OSHKAA** — The edge relay is late. The Oshkaa relay reports its inner links
clear. The Index works through the night on the Theruun entries.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet has searched Theruun for three turns.

**SENWE** — Senwe asks the Fleet to bring the survey-keepers home. They have
asked to stay.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey asks to turn its instruments to Oshkaa.

**MAALITH** — The fold school has asked the Fleet for every reading it has
taken at Theruun, all of them, including those it thinks are nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 13777! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren. Oshkaa ir vhaal-maar kheru-ren.

Oshkaa! Ir vhaal-maar kheru-ren. Oshkaa vhaal-maar henen ith sumu shiu lo-ren. Vend-sil tamma nokh Theruun vend'onneth om savo-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar Theruun tir keth vael-piru-ren.

Senwe! Senwe khul-maar pai ki-ren: wenvend-tharai hemi helu! Henen anam ki-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend henen mirkaal Oshkaa pai rum ki-ren.

Maalith! Thaavi shol-sil khul-maar pai Theruun tho hol shiruth tamma, khul-maar nul olu mael som yo, ki-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: The Oshkaa edge relay is late.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ir vhaal-maar kheru-ren.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Relays are late. Don't.
posts.eshai: Vhaal-maaren kheru-esh. Ma!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: I'm not doing anything. I'm saying it.
posts.eshai: Mu som ma-kaal-ka. Mu lo-ka.

posts.author: Esko Lirai
posts.en: Turned to Oshkaa.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa pai rum-esh.

posts.author: Ushai Nenn
posts.en:
It's like cold. It comes from the edge side of the house first. We're
moving everybody to the inner rooms. I'll report next turn.
posts.eshai: Khol olu-esh. Hem ir dalu ul enna ye-esh. Shi tamma-ai ith silen pai rum-ka. Wana keth mu ho-vol-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14000. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent. The Oshkaa edge
relay is silent.

**OSHKAA** — The Oshkaa edge colonies are silent. They had been reporting
the confused crews for two turns. The last report from the edge said that
more of the colonists had the confusion and that it seemed to be spreading
by nearness, like cold. Then nothing.

**PAARUK** — The Assembly has recalled the Fleet from Theruun to the Oshkaa
edge. The Fleet is under way.

**SENWE** — The survey-keepers are coming home with the Fleet.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey turns to Oshkaa.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly has not said what the Fleet is to do at the Oshkaa
edge. The Speaker says the Assembly does not know, and that the Fleet has
never needed telling.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14000! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren. Oshkaa ir vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Oshkaa! Oshkaa ir hemnuen nulren-ren. Dai keth henen ma-yul khul-ai vol-esh. Ir ul tethna renlo lo-esh: yai maar hemnu-ai ma-yul-ka, a ta khol olu shen-eth sa pesh-vaa. Tekev nul som-ren.

Paaruk! Kel-maar khul-maar Theruun ul Oshkaa ir pai yevi hura-ren. Khul-maar wa-ren.

Senwe! Wenvend-tharai khul-maar sa hemi ye-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend Oshkaa pai rum-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar Oshkaa ir tho khul-maar kevai savo ma-lo-ren. Lo-ai lo-ren: Kel-maar ma-yul-esh, a khul-maar nulvi vol-eth hesi-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en:
The Oshkaa edge colonies have stopped answering. My sister is on the health
council at the edge. She's stopped answering.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ir hemnuen oveth halo-ren. Mu senu ir tho ashe kelsil tho-esh. Hen oveth halo-ren.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en:
Oshkaa edge: fold weather along the Theruun–Oshkaa relay has changed. The
channel's thinner. Like it's been used a great deal, very recently.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ir: Theruun a Oshkaa vhaal-maar tho thaavi shehu rum-esh. Sumu yai nu-esh. Shaa savo, shaa kheru ma, olu-esh.

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en: The Assembly has recalled the Fleet from Theruun to the Oshkaa edge.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar khul-maar Theruun ul Oshkaa ir pai yevi hura-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: To defend it against what?
posts.eshai: Kevai ul onn om hai?

posts.author: Kessa Imaa
posts.en: Ushai? The health council hasn't reported.
posts.eshai: Ushai hai? Ashe kelsil ma-vol-esh.

posts.author: Tannar Voe
posts.en: The Fleet's been sent to the Oshkaa edge. Hull ten's got a deck now.
posts.eshai: Khul-maar Oshkaa ir pai pevi-ren. 12-na khul kev kesu thar-esh.

posts.author: Rulen Haaw
posts.en:
The survey-keepers who went with the Fleet say there was nothing alive at
Theruun. Not a lineage. Nothing to protect. They say they've never seen
anywhere so clean, and that it frightened them more than anything they've
ever seen.
posts.eshai: Khul-maar sa wa wenvend-tharai lo-ren: Theruun tho nul som ashe-esh. Nul thel-esh. Thar om nul som-esh. Henen ru ti olu shim nulvi esh-esh, a ta henen esh som tamma ul yai vokh-esh lo-ren.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Is anyone going to answer that?
posts.eshai: Ossa ta ho-oveth-tol hai?

posts.author: Kessa Imaa
posts.en: We're leaving the edge. All of us. Toward the Index worlds.
posts.eshai: Shi tamma ir sheva-ka. Vend-sil aruen pai wa-ka.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14001. Five headings. The Theruun relay is silent. The Oshkaa edge is
dark.

**OSHKAA** — The Oshkaa council has moved the edge districts' remaining
people inward, toward the Index worlds. It reports the move orderly. It does
not report how many.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet has taken station at the Oshkaa edge, all nine hulls,
in the line it uses for a stellar flare.

**SENWE** — Senwe has offered its gardens to anybody from Oshkaa who wishes
to come.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey reports the Oshkaa edge stars as they were.

**MAALITH** — The fold school asks that every reading the Fleet takes at the
edge be sent to it the moment it is taken.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14001! Pem yathi-ren. Theruun vhaal-maar nulren-ren. Oshkaa ir khaa-ren.

Oshkaa! Oshkaa kelsil ir hemmaar dalu tho anam aien ith pai, Vend-sil aruen pai, rum-ren. Hen rum ranu tho lo-ren. Kevai maar ma-lo-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar tamma 11 khul sa, tai-vakh om lom tho, Oshkaa ir tho silir hol-ren.

Senwe! Senwe Oshkaa ul ye lai ossa pai henen olumaen dam-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend Oshkaa ir taien nim olu esh-ren.

Maalith! Thaavi shol-sil ki-ren: khul-maar ir tho hol shiruth tamma, hol temu, pevi!

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en:
Still nothing from my sister. The health council at the Oshkaa edge was
forty people. None of them answers.
posts.eshai: Mu senu ul ke nul som-esh. Oshkaa ir ashe kelsil 50 ai-esh. Nul-ai oveth-ka.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: I'm sorry, Pira. Tell me her name.
posts.eshai: Pira, sehu! Hen thei mu pai vol!

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en:
Ushai Nenn. Ushai Deth, before she married. She hated her married name and
kept it anyway to annoy his mother.
posts.eshai: Ushai Nenn! Ushai Deth, thavi kaal nim! Hen thavi thei ma-ulen-esh a hen ammu khethu om ke thar-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Entered. Both names.
posts.eshai: Dai thei vend'onn-esh.

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en:
The edge colonies are coming in. Reading room six is beds now. We'll file
around them.
posts.eshai: Ir hemnuen ith pai ye-ka. Sulna lethsil kev munu-somen-esh. Shi henen vos vend-tol.

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en:
From *Kesh*, at the Oshkaa edge. I'm going to write down what I see, here,
every time I can, because the Fleet's reports are numbers and somebody should
say it plainly.

The stars ahead of the line are where they should be and as bright as they
should be. The light is wrong. I don't know how to say it better. It looks
like it's been through something that didn't want it.
posts.eshai:
Kesh ul, Oshkaa ir tho! Mu esh som hena, piru temu tamma, thesh-tol, tolen khul-maar renloen vendu-esh a ossa eeth lo hesi-esh.

Lom nim taien kae anam hesi tho-esh a kae ilu hesi ilu-esh. Ilun khelu-esh. Mu yai vai lo ma-piru-esh. Ilun ta ma-lai som vos wa olu-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en: Say it however you can, navigator. That's the job.
posts.eshai: Urai, piru olu lo! Ta savo-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14002. Five headings.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet reports the light ahead of it arriving wrong. The
stars are where they were and as bright as they were. The Fleet's navigators
report that the light "has been through something." The Fleet holds its line.

**OSHKAA** — The Index has entered 4,000 Theruun lives.

**SENWE** — The first Oshkaa families have reached the gardens.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14002! Pem yathi-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar lo-ren: nim ilun khelu yeth-ka. Taien nim kae anam-esh tho, nim olu ilu-esh. Khul-maar uraien lo-ren: ilun "som vos wa-esh." Khul-maar henen lom onn-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil 4000 Theruun asheth vend'onn-ren.

Senwe! Enna Oshkaa thelen olumaen pai yeth-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en:
4,300 Theruun lives entered. People keep arriving with memories and we
keep entering them and some of the people arriving are from the edge and
don't remember what they came to tell us.
posts.eshai: 4300 Theruun asheth vend'onn-esh. Aien annu sa ke yeth, a shi ke vend'onn, a yeth aien ul nuri ir ul-esh a henen kevai vol om ye ma-annu-esh.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en:
Hethra writes in shenai now. I read every word. She doesn't write to me.
I think it's so I don't have to read it twice.
posts.eshai: Kev Hethra shenai tho thesh-ka. Mu tamma loth leth-esh. Hen mu pai ma-thesh-esh. Mu dai vi leth ma-hesi om-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Hethra Maal
posts.en:
We've watched one of the edge worlds for a turn. From orbit. Nobody went
down. It went grey. Not the ground. The cities, first. Then out from the
cities. Then dark. The dark is thicker where the cities were.
posts.eshai: Shi ir aruen ul en en keth vhoru ul wen-esh. Nul-ai dop pai wa-esh. Sem-esh. Kesu ma-esh. Hemmaaren enna-esh. Tekev hemmaaren ul naa pai-esh. Tekev khaa-esh. Hemmaaren anam-esh ru tho khaa yai duv-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: What does grey mean?
posts.eshai: Sem kevai loma hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
I don't know, Paelu. I have the readings. I will know more than I want to
by next turn.
posts.eshai: Paelu, mu ma-yul-esh. Mu shiruth thar-esh. Wana keth mu lai ul yai ho-yul-tol.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
From Senwe, systems biology, on the Oshkaa forgetting: I've read the
health councils' notes. The loss runs in a fixed order. Names first, then who people are to each other, then the self, then how
you know anything. It is the reverse of the order a child learns them. The
pattern goes before the matter does.
posts.eshai: Senwe ul, ashe-eth sholeth, Oshkaa ma-annu rin: mu ashe kelsil thesh-eth leth-esh. Ruth orm ranu tho wa-esh. Thei enna, tekev aien shi pai kevai, tekev mu, tekev tei kevai yul-esh. Ilnu annet ranu rael-esh. Ruma nim lelu wa-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Kovel, how sure?
posts.eshai: Kovel, kevai yul hai?

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Sure enough to wish I weren't.
posts.eshai: Mu ma-yul lai hosh yul-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Could be a surface phenomenon. Could be
posts.eshai: Kesu som-tol. Ho-tol

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: I'm sorry. Never mind.
posts.eshai: Sehu! Ma-annu!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14003. Five headings.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet reports one Oshkaa edge world, observed from orbit
over a turn: its colour going grey from the cities outward. Then dark. The
Fleet reports that the dark is thicker where the cities were. The Fleet has
sent no one down.

**OSHKAA** — The Oshkaa health council reports the confusion in the outer
districts now, among people who never went near the edge. It begins with
names.

**SENWE** — Nothing.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14003! Pem yathi-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar Oshkaa ir aru en, en keth vhoru ul wen, vol-ren: hemmaaren ul khaa pai sem-ka. Tekev khaa-esh. Khul-maar lo-ren: hemmaaren anam-esh ru tho khaa yai duv-esh. Khul-maar nul-ai dop pai ma-pevi-ren.

Oshkaa! Oshkaa ashe kelsil lo-ren: kev naa hemmaar dalu tho, ir shen pai nulvi wa aien tho, ma-yul-ka. Thei ul esa-ren.

Senwe! Nul som-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
From the Index. The confusion is in the outer districts now, among people
who never went near the edge. It starts with names. First you can't remember
somebody else's. Then your own. I heard this from the district health
people directly.
posts.eshai: Vend-sil ul! Kev naa hemmaar dalu tho, ir pai nulvi wa aien tho, ma-yul-ren. Thei ul esa-ren. Enna oth ai thei ma-annu-ren. Tekev tei thei ma-annu-ren. Mu ta hemmaar dalu ashe-ai ul enen ren-esh.

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en:
Oshkaa's children are going to the other four galaxies. Thank you, all of
you, for saying yes in the same turn. We're keeping the reading rooms open.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ilnuen oth kaav ilma pai wa-ka. Omu keth tho "ae" lo om tamma-ai pai hael! Shi lethsilen vhen thar-ka.

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en:
The yards have cleared two slips for Oshkaa's children. We've got beds in
the hull ten frame. They can sleep in a ship that isn't finished. There's
worse.
posts.eshai: Kaalsil Oshkaa ilnuen om dai khul-ru vhen-esh. 12-na khul vare tho munu-somen-esh. Henen ma-dosh khul tho munu-tol. Yai ma-vai yo-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
Oshkaa is sending its children to all of you. Thank you for saying yes, all four of you, in the same turn. I'm staying at the Index. Somebody has to
enter what's arriving.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa henen ilnuen teien tamma pai pevi-ka. Tamma kaav, omu keth tho "ae" lo om, hael! Mu Vend-sil tho anam-ka. Ossa yeth-ka som vend'onn hesi-tol.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Yulen, go with the children.
posts.eshai: Yulen, ilnuen sa wa!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Can't. We're the only people who know how the shelves work.
posts.eshai: Ma-piru-tol. Onnuen kevai savo shi enen yul-esh.

posts.author: Kessa Imaa
posts.en:
My daughter's on the ship to Paaruk. I told her Tamruk Hesh would meet her.
I don't know Tamruk Hesh. I read him in shenai. I hope that's allowed.
posts.eshai: Mu ilnu Paaruk pai vessa tho-esh. Mu hen pai "Tamruk Hesh tei shenu-tol" lo-esh. Mu Tamruk Hesh ma-yul-esh. Mu hen shenai tho leth-esh. Ta dam-esh hai?

posts.author: Maru
posts.en: Tovaa's taking Oshkaa children. Six. Our roofs are full. We're making room.
posts.eshai: Tovaa Oshkaa ilnuen hol-ka. Sul-esh. Shi kovuen tamma-esh. Shi ru kaal-ka.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14004. Five headings. The Oshkaa relay reports its outer links
failing.

**OSHKAA** — The Index is working in shifts on the Theruun entries. It
reports 6,000. It asks that anybody holding a memory of a Theruun life send
it now rather than next turn.

**OSHKAA** — Oshkaa asks the other galaxies to take its children.

**PAARUK** — Paaruk will take them.

**SENWE** — Senwe will take them.

**YULENAI** — Yulenai will take them.

**MAALITH** — Maalith will take them.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14004! Pem yathi-ren. Oshkaa vhaal-maar henen naa sumu khet-ka lo-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil Theruun vend'onneth om ranu tho savo-ren. Hen 6000 lo-ren. Hen ki-ren: Theruun asheth annu thar ossa, wana keth ma, kev pevi!

Oshkaa! Oshkaa oth ilmaen pai ki-ren: shi ilnuen hol!

Paaruk! Paaruk ho-hol-tol.

Senwe! Senwe ho-hol-tol.

Yulenai! Yulenai ho-hol-tol.

Maalith! Maalith ho-hol-tol.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
It's allowed. I'll be at the yards. Tell her to look for the oldest man
there.
posts.eshai: Dam-esh. Mu kaalsil tho ho-anam-tol. Hen pai lo: tena ossu ai ul yai ossu ai vael!

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
I met Kessa Imaa's daughter at the landing. I told her I was the oldest
man at the yards. She said "I can see that." I like her.
posts.eshai: Mu yethsil tho Kessa Imaa ilnu shenu-esh. Mu "mu kaalsil tho ossu ul yai ossu ai-esh" lo-esh. Hen "mu ta esh-ka" lo-esh. Mu hen ulen-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Yulen. The deep count in Maalith has everything the Index has sent it. If
you need to leave, the work won't be lost.
posts.eshai: Yulen! Maalith tho ith vend Vend-sil pevi som tamma thar-ren. Yem tei sheva hesi, savo ma-ruth-tol.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
It's not the old work I'm worried about. It's the new. We're entering people
from other people's memories and the people remembering are forgetting. If
we don't do it now, there'll be nobody left who remembers them to do it.
posts.eshai: Ossu savo om mu ma-vokh-esh. Enni savo om-esh. Shi oth aien annu ul aien vend'onn-ka a annu-ai ma-annu-ka. Yem shi kev ma-kaal, henen annu ossa ma-ho-anam-tol.

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en: I can't remember the order of the shelves. I've done them my whole working life. Yulen's taking them.
posts.eshai: Mu onnuen ranu ma-annu-esh. Mu tamma savo ashe tho ta kaal-esh. Yulen henen hol-ka.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mother.
posts.eshai: Ammu!

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en:
Oshkaa's children are arriving in the gardens. The council asks everybody
to remember that the gardens were made to be walked in.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ilnuen olumaen pai yeth-ka. Kelsil tamma-ai pai ki-esh: olumaen pelu om kaal-esh, annu!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
Oshkaa's children are landing at the academy fields. The academy is
closing its lecture halls to make beds. The lectures will be held on the
hill.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa ilnuen Shol-maar yethsil tho yeth-ka. Munu-somen om Shol-maar sholeth silen vhom-ka. Sholeth hullu tho ho-tol.

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en: yulen is doing my shelves she is very good at shelves
posts.eshai: yulen mu onnuen savo hen onnuen tho shaa vai

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
Seven thousand entered. Ilen can't remember the order of the shelves. I've
taken his shelves as well as mine.
posts.eshai: 7000 vend'onn-esh. Ilen onnuen ranu ma-annu-esh. Mu mu onnuen a hen onnuen hol-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Rest, Yulen.
posts.eshai: Yulen, hed!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: After.
posts.eshai: Dor-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14005. Five headings.

**OSHKAA** — The Index reports 7,000 Theruun lives entered. The Index
reports that some of its indexers have the confusion. The Index reports that
it is still entering.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet has lost contact with two hulls on the far side of
the line. It reports both hulls intact.

**SENWE** — Ships from Oshkaa arriving at the gardens.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — The deep count reports that everything the Index has sent it is
safe, up to the end of the last turn.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14005! Pem yathi-ren.

Oshkaa! Vend-sil 7000 Theruun asheth vend'onn lo-ren. Vend-sil henen vendai ul nuri ma-yul-ka lo-ren. Vend-sil ke vend'onn-ka lo-ren.

Paaruk! Khul-maar lom naa dalu tho dai khul sa sumu ruth-ren. Hen dai khul tamma lo-ren.

Senwe! Oshkaa ul vessaen olumaen pai yeth-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Ith vend lo-ren: Vend-sil pevi som tamma, tethna keth teth pai, vai-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en: Seven thousand. The Index is still entering.
posts.eshai: 7000-esh. Vend-sil ke vend'onn-ka.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
My mother's entry is done. I read it back. It's good. Oruun, you were right
to say you were sure.
posts.eshai: Mu ammu vend'onneth dosh-esh. Mu ruvi leth-esh. Vai-esh. Oruun, tei "yul" lo eeth-esh.

posts.author: Ilen Paar
posts.en: who is doing the shelves
posts.eshai: ossa onnuen savo

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en:
Ilen asked me who I was today. Then he was fine again. It's cold in the
reading room.
posts.eshai: Ti sau Ilen mu pai mu kevai ki. Tekev hen ruvi vai. Lethsil tho khol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Yulen, you didn't mark how you know that.
posts.eshai: Yulen, tei kevai yul ma-thesh-esh.

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Mothr
posts.eshai: Amm

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Seven thousand. The Index has. My mother told me to eat something. Who is
posts.eshai: 7000. Vend-sil thar. Mu ammu mu pai som yamu lo. Ossa

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Yulen. Yulen, it's Oruun. Answer me.
posts.eshai: Yulen! Yulen, Oruun-esh. Mu pai oveth!

posts.author: Yulen Dar
posts.en: Yulun Daar
posts.eshai: Yulun Daar

posts.author: Innu Raam
posts.en: The Index is still
posts.eshai: Vend-sil ke

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Yulen?
posts.eshai: Yulen hai?

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14006. Four headings. The Oshkaa relay is silent.

There is no Oshkaa heading. The Great Index is in Oshkaa. The deep count in
Maalith holds everything the Index sent it, up to the last turn, and the
Assembly has asked the deep count's keepers to carry on the Index's work.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet has fallen back to the gap between Oshkaa and Paaruk.

**SENWE** — The last ships from Oshkaa have arrived. Fewer than left.

**YULENAI** — The outer survey reports the Oshkaa stars as they were.

**MAALITH** — The deep count's keepers have never entered anyone. They have
only ever kept. They are learning.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

The Index cannot enter anyone this turn. This digest will, from memory, until
it can.

Entered, from memory: **Yulen Dar**, indexer, of Theruun and Oshkaa, who
asked this digest to print her mother's name and never asked for her own.
**Aveth Dar**, her mother, of the Theruun array council, who objected and
asked that her objection be kept. It is. **Ilen Paar**, indexer, who filed
the poems.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14006! Kaav yathi-ren. Oshkaa vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Oshkaa yathi nul-esh. Vend-sil Oshkaa tho-esh. Maalith tho ith vend Vend-sil pevi som tamma, tethna keth pai, thar-ren, a Kel-maar ith vend tharai pai ki-ren: Vend-sil savo ke!

Paaruk! Khul-maar Oshkaa a Paaruk mesu pai yevi-ren.

Senwe! Oshkaa ul tethna vessaen yeth-ren. Sheva-esh ul nuri-ren.

Yulenai! Naa wenvend Oshkaa taien nim olu esh-ren.

Maalith! Ith vend tharai nulvi ossa vend'onn-esh. Henen enen thar-esh. Henen annet-ka.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ti keth Vend-sil ossa vend'onn ma-piru-tol. Ti naa-ren, annu ul, piru temu pai, ho-vend'onn-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Naming it. **Makaal**, the unmaking. The measurements need a word.

Summary of every reading the Fleet has sent: (1) Living matter near it is
reorganised. Not destroyed; the mass-energy is all accounted for. It
becomes part of the thing, and the thing is larger by exactly that much.
(2) The pattern goes first; Kovel's order holds. (3) This is the part I
need someone to check. In our physics, information is conserved. Nothing
that happens is ever truly lost; it is kept, in principle, somewhere, in
the arrangement of everything after it. It's the oldest law we have. It's
why the count makes sense to us at all. Makaal does not keep. The readings
show the information of the living matter is not transformed, not
scrambled, not hidden. It's gone. That isn't possible here. It's possible
in whatever physics Makaal is from.
posts.eshai: Thei-ka! Makaal, ma-kaal-eth! Shiruth loth hesi-esh. Khul-maar pevi shiruth tamma: 1, hen shen ashe ruma oth ranu pai rum-tol. Ma-khet-tol; ruma a vira tamma vend-tol. Som dalu-tol, a som tiru ta vendu yai tuv-tol. 2, lelu enna wa-tol; Kovel ranu onn-tol. 3, ti dalu ossa seth hesi-esh. Shi maelith tho yuleth thar-esh. Kaal som nulvi tiru ruth-esh; orth tho, kae ma kae, dor tamma ranu tho thar-esh. Ta shi ossu ul yai ossu orth-esh. Ta tolen vend shi om loma-esh. Makaal ma-thar-tol. Shiruth lo-esh: ashe ruma yuleth oth ma-esh, khet ma-esh, tumu ma-esh. Nul-esh. Hena ma-piru-tol. Makaal ye kae maelith tho piru-tol.

Ilaar calls it **Makaal**, the unmaking. She asks that this digest use it,
because the measurements need a word, and so, she says, do we.

The fold school reports, from the Fleet's readings: where Makaal has been,
there are no remains. No bodies, no heat, no signal. The matter is still
there. It is not what it was. It is part of Makaal, and Makaal is larger by
exactly that much.

**PAARUK** — The Fleet holds the gap.

**SENWE** — Nothing.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
I've been silent for a turn because the only things I had to say weren't
fit for a room with a student in it. I'm better now. Here's a story, cadet,
since you're the only one asking questions.

When I was about your age plus ten I was navigator on the old seventh, and a
rogue world came out of nowhere at Paaruk's edge, a big one, falling
straight at the yards. We had four turns. The commander put me on the board
and said "hold her," and I held her, and we got in front of that world and
leaned on it with everything the seventh had, and it didn't move. A turn. It
didn't move. Two turns. Everybody on the ship knew. And on the third turn it
moved the width of a hand. And that was enough, because a hand at that
distance is a whole world by the time it gets to you.

The lesson is supposed to be "don't stop leaning." That's what I've told
every navigator for two long turns. I told Hethra that. I'm starting to
think the lesson was that we were lucky. That the world was the kind of thing
that could be leaned on.

I don't know what the lesson is now. I'll tell you when I know.

Mu kev sholeth kevai ma-yul-esh. Mu yul temu mu tei pai ho-vol-tol.

posts.en: Oma won't stop the lift. I've asked. The whole yard's asked.
posts.eshai: Oma tai'ulo ma-ho-halo-tol. Mu ki-esh. Kaalsil tamma ki-esh.

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en:
Hesk will burn cooler and longer. If we stop now it'll burn hotter and
shorter and it'll eat its third world, which has lineages on it that Senwe counted. It would last. It's the one thing here
that will. We're lifting.
posts.eshai: Hesk yai khol a yai tahl ho-ruk-tol. Yem shi kev halo, yai haru a yai nu tahl ho-ruk-tol a hen tirna aru, Senwe vend thelen tho anam aru, ho-yamu-tol. Ho-anam-tol. Hena ta enen som ho-anam-tol. Shi tai'ulo-ka.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14017. Four headings.

**PAARUK** — The yards report Oma Varrek still lifting Hesk. Asked why, she
sent the reason she sent the Paaruk council: "it would last."

**PAARUK** — Tamruk Hesh has refused a seat on an evacuation ship, on the
grounds that he is old and the pilots' seats are for the young, and that he
has a game to finish.

**SENWE** — Nothing.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14017! Kaav yathi-ren.

Paaruk! Kaalsil lo-ren: Oma Varrek Hesk ke tai'ulo-ka. "Kevai hai?" ki temu, hen Paaruk kelsil pevi-esh toleth pevi-ren: "ho-anam-tol."

Paaruk! Tamruk Hesh shul-vessa tho hed ma-hol-ren: hen ossu-esh, uraien hed enni om-esh, a hen dosh hesi ishaal thar-esh.

Senwe! Nul som-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Tamruk, the digest says you won't take a seat on the evacuation ships.
posts.eshai: Tamruk, naa-ren lo-ren: tei shul-vessa tho hed ma-ho-hol-tol.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
The seats are for pilots and children. I'm neither. I've got a game to
finish and a star to listen to being lifted. Oma's still going. I've never
heard the yards so loud.
posts.eshai: Hed uraien a ilnuen om-esh. Mu dai ma-esh. Mu dosh hesi ishaal a tai'ulo ren hesi tai thar-esh. Oma ke-ka. Mu nulvi kaalsil ti olu vakh ren-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Please.
posts.eshai: Yenu!

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
No, cadet. But thank you for asking twice. Hethra would have asked three
times. She was very stubborn.
posts.eshai: Anai, ma! Velu dai vi ki om hael! Hethra tir vi ho-ki-tol. Hen shaa taru-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
I'm back. I read the cluster in that order for two long turns. I'll read it
in that order to the end. It's the only order there is.
posts.eshai: Mu yevi-esh. Mu dai keth-maar Ilumaar ta ranu tho leth-esh. Mu teth pai ta ranu tho ho-leth-tol. Ta enen ranu-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Move 750, early, in case. Second stone to the fourth ring. Nemaai, don't be
kind about it.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 750, pothu, yem om! Daina lith kaavna vhoru pai! Nemaai, haru ma!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: I'll answer on the turn, like always.
posts.eshai: Mu tammavi olu keth tho ho-oveth-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14020. Four headings. The Paaruk edge is dark.

**PAARUK** — The last evacuation ships have left the yards.

**SENWE** — Senwe is ready.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14020! Kaav yathi-ren. Paaruk ir khaa-ren.

Paaruk! Tethna shul-vessaen kaalsil ul sheva-ren.

Senwe! Senwe tharu-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Tannar Voe
posts.en: The edge is dark. Last ships out. Oma's still lifting. So am I.
posts.eshai: Ir khaa-esh. Tethna vessaen sheva-esh. Oma ke tai'ulo-ka. Mu yo-ka.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Lot of lights going out over the far yards. Quiet. Oma's still lifting.
You can hear Hesk from here, like a forge breathing.
posts.eshai: Naa kaalsil vas ilmiren maar ma-ilu-ka. Nulren-esh. Oma ke tai'ulo-ka. Tei hena ul Hesk, ruksil ushu olu, ren-tol.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en: Buds are fatter. Soon.
posts.eshai: Lilunuen yai duv-esh. Shenkev-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14021. Four headings. The Paaruk relay is failing.

**PAARUK** — The yards report —

The Paaruk heading ends there. It is what the relay carried.

**SENWE** — The first ships from Paaruk have reached Senwe.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14021! Kaav yathi-ren. Paaruk vhaal-maar khet-ren.

Paaruk! Kaalsil lo—

Paaruk yathi tena teth-esh. Vhaal-maar kavu som ti-esh.

Senwe! Paaruk ul enna vessaen Senwe pai yeth-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Your move, Tamruk. Mine's ready after it. You'll hate it.
posts.eshai: Tamruk, tei rum-eth! Mu ta dor tharu-esh. Tei ho-ma-ulen-tol.

posts.author: Oma Varrek
posts.en:
Hesk, layer four. Colour steady. Output down one part in eight
thousand. The star is calmer. Numbers are good. Whoever finishes this,
it's filed with me.
posts.eshai: Hesk, kaavna thom-esh. Ilun orm-esh. Tai vira 17500 dalu tho en dalu ith pai-esh. Tai yai orm-esh. Vendu vai-esh. Ti dosh ossa, mu sa vend-esh.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Nemaai. It's very quiet over the yards now. Oma sent the lift numbers and
they're good numbers. I'm going to sit by the window.
posts.eshai: Nemaai! Kev kaalsil vas shaa nulren-esh. Oma tai'ulo vendu pevi-esh a vai vendu-esh. Mu vhaal'ilun shen ho-hed-tol.

posts.author: Tamruk Hesh
posts.en:
Nemaai I'm going to take the long ring with my fifth stone and you won't see
it coming because you never
posts.eshai: Nemaai mu pemna lith sa tahl vhoru ho-hol-tol a tei ma-ho-esh-tol tolen tei nulvi

posts.author: Ahriel Tovaa
posts.en: Everyone in Tovaa is under a roof now. We've made room.
posts.eshai: Tovaa tho tamma-ai kev kovu dor-esh. Shi ru kaal-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Tamruk.
posts.eshai: Tamruk!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14022. Three headings. The Paaruk relay is silent.

**SENWE** — Senwe has taken in the ships from Paaruk. Some of their crews have
the confusion. The garden councils ask Senwe to remember that it is a
confusion and not a fault.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly sits continuously.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Entered, from memory: **Tamruk Hesh**, who commanded the old seventh hull,
who caught three rogue worlds and a flare, who taught half the Fleet to hold
a course and ended every argument by saying we would know in a few turns.
We know. **Oma Varrek**, yard-master, who lifted Hesk because it would last.
Hesk will burn cooler and longer. It is the only thing in Paaruk that will.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14022! Tir yathi-ren. Paaruk vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Senwe! Senwe Paaruk ul vessaen hol-ren. Henen khul-ai ul nuri ma-yul-ren. Oluma kelsilen Senwe pai ki-ren: ta ma-yul-eth-esh, khelu ma-esh, annu!

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar tammavi hed-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Annu ul vend'onn-esh: Tamruk Hesh, ossu 7-na khul anvu-esh, tir aru-shul a tai-vakh hol-esh, khul-maar dalu pai lom onn sholu-esh, a tamma dekh "nuri keth tho shi ho-yul-tol" lo sa teth-esh. Shi yul-esh. Oma Varrek, kaalsil tharai, Hesk tai'ulo-esh tolen ho-anam-tol. Hesk yai khol a yai tahl ho-ruk-tol. Paaruk tho enen ta som ho-anam-tol.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: I'm going to leave the board exactly as it is.
posts.eshai: Mu tavu tiru olu ho-anam-tol.

posts.author: Hiraal Ok
posts.en:
People come up the hill at night now just to stand by the Old Glass.
They don't look. They just stand.
posts.eshai: Kev nokh tho aien Ossu Shel shen tar om enen hullu tho ye-ka. Henen ma-wen-ka. Henen enen tar-ka.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
