Kovel's evacuation arithmetic, checked twice. It holds. I've looked for
the error the way I looked for the mode at depth 16, and there isn't one
this time either.
posts.eshai: Kovel sheva vendeth, dai vi seth-esh. Onn-esh. Mu ithen 16 tho lom vael-piru olu khelu vael-piru-esh, a ti vi yo nul-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
I've published the arithmetic. Ships we have, distances, how long it's
taken Makaal to get from each relay to the next. Here's the conclusion, and
I'm sorry: there aren't enough ships, and there isn't enough time for the
ships there are. Getting people further in buys turns. It doesn't buy a
way out. There isn't a further in than Maalith.
posts.eshai: Mu vendeth thesh-esh. Shi thar vessaen, naaen, Makaal vhaal-maar ul vhaal-maar pai kevai tahl hol-esh. Ti tethna maeleth-esh, a mu sehu-esh: hosh vessaen ma-tol, a tena vessaen om hosh tahl ma-tol. Aien yai ith pai helu keth dam-tol. Sheva lom ma-dam-tol. Maalith ul yai ith nul-tol.

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en: Then what's the point of saying it?
posts.eshai: Tekev lo kevai om hai?

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en: Take it down, Kovel.
posts.eshai: Kovel, ta hol!

posts.author: Veth Kaari
posts.en: You're wrong. You've always been wrong about everything except small things.
posts.eshai: Tei khelu-esh. Tei tamma som rin, nu somen ma, tammavi khelu-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: This is a small thing. It's arithmetic.
posts.eshai: Ti nu som-esh. Vendeth-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: It's right. I checked it twice. I wish I hadn't.
posts.eshai: Eeth-esh. Mu dai vi seth-esh. Mu ma-seth lai-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Thank you, Kovel.
posts.eshai: Kovel, hael!

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Don't thank people for arithmetic, Paelu. It just sits there being true.
posts.eshai: Paelu, vendeth om ossa ma-hael! Ta enen eeth anam-ka.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14023. Three headings.

**SENWE** — Kovel Tann of the Senwe systems school has published the
arithmetic of leaving: the ships there are, the distances, and how fast
Makaal has come from each relay to the next. This digest prints only his
conclusion. There are not enough ships, and there is not enough time for the
ships there are.

**YULENAI** — Yulenai asks for Kovel Tann's arithmetic to be checked.

**MAALITH** — The fold school has checked it.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14023! Tir yathi-ren.

Senwe! Senwe ul Kovel Tann sheva vendeth thesh-ren: tena vessaen, naaen, a Makaal vhaal-maar ul vhaal-maar pai kevai khev ye-esh. Ti naa-ren hen tethna maeleth enen thesh-esh. Hosh vessaen ma-tol, a tena vessaen om hosh tahl ma-tol.

Yulenai! Yulenai ki-ren: Kovel Tann vendeth seth!

Maalith! Thaavi shol-sil seth-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en:
Paaruk's ships in the gardens. Some of their crews have the forgetting.
The council asks: they are our guests. Please.
posts.eshai: Paaruk vessaen olumaen tho-esh. Henen khul-ai ul nuri ma-annu thar-esh. Kelsil ki-esh: henen shi ye-ai-esh. Yenu!

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
Paaruk's ships are landing in the gardens. Some of the crews have the
forgetting. We are afraid of our own guests. We've put them in the survey
halls "for their comfort." I'm ashamed of us. I'm afraid too. Both are
true.
posts.eshai: Paaruk vessaen olumaen tho yeth-ka. Khul-ai ul nuri ma-annu thar-esh. Shi shi ye-ai ul vokh-esh. Shi henen wenvend silen tho, "henen haru om", tavi-esh. Mu shi ul shimu-esh. Mu yo vokh-esh. Dai eeth-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14024. Three headings.

**SENWE** — The Senwe gardens are full. Paaruk's people are in the survey
halls and the seed vaults and under the lattice trees.

**YULENAI** — Yulenai is sending ships to Senwe to bring people further in.

**MAALITH** — Maalith is sending ships to Yulenai to bring people further in
again.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14024! Tir yathi-ren.

Senwe! Senwe olumaen tamma-ren. Paaruk aien wenvend silen tho a sui-silen tho a vesk domaen dor anam-ren.

Yulenai! Yulenai aien yai ith pai helu om Senwe pai vessaen pevi-ren.

Maalith! Maalith aien ruvi yai ith pai helu om Yulenai pai vessaen pevi-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Haani Thul
posts.en:
The council has decided. Senwe will stay. We will send anybody from Paaruk
and Oshkaa who wants to go further. Senwe's people will stay with what
we've sworn to keep.
posts.eshai: Kelsil kel-esh. Senwe ho-anam-tol. Paaruk a Oshkaa ul yai naa wa lai ossa shi ho-pevi-tol. Senwe aien shi onn-lo som sa ho-anam-tol.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: I voted to go. I'm staying.
posts.eshai: Mu sheva om kel-esh. Mu anam-ka.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en: I was always staying.
posts.eshai: Mu tammavi anam-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
Senwe won't leave. The council says the old thing: if we're not standing
with the living things we swore to keep, we've left them. I voted to go. I
lost. I'm staying.
posts.eshai: Senwe ma-ho-sheva-tol. Kelsil ossu som lo-esh: yem shi thar om onn-lo ashe som sa ma-tar, shi henen sheva-esh. Mu sheva om kel-esh. Mu ruth-esh. Mu anam-ka.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Why?
posts.eshai: Kevai hai?

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
Because they're right, and I've spent my life being right about small
things, and I'd like to be wrong about a big one standing next to people
who are right.
posts.eshai: Tolen henen eeth-esh, a mu tamma ashe nu somen rin eeth-esh, a mu eeth aien shen tar tuv som rin khelu lai-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14025. Three headings.

**SENWE** — The Senwe council has decided that Senwe will not leave. The
council gives the old reason: that if we are not standing with the living
things we have sworn to keep, we have left them. The gardens will send
anybody from Paaruk and Oshkaa who wishes to go further. Senwe's own
people will stay.

**YULENAI** — Yulenai's ships wait at the Senwe gardens for anybody who
changes their mind.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14025! Tir yathi-ren.

Senwe! Senwe kelsil kel-ren: Senwe ma-ho-sheva-tol. Kelsil ossu toleth dam-ren: yem shi thar om onn-lo ashe som sa ma-tar, shi henen sheva-esh. Olumaen Paaruk a Oshkaa ul yai naa wa lai ossa ho-pevi-tol. Senwe henen aien ho-anam-tol.

Yulenai! Yulenai vessaen, mael rum ossa om, Senwe olumaen tho tahli-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
I've asked the deep count to enter me now. Alive. So there's a trace. There
isn't going to be a trace afterwards, is there, Senneth?
posts.eshai: Mu ith vend pai ki-esh: mu kev vend'onn! Ashe tho! Esheth om! Dor esheth ma-ho-anam-tol, Senneth, ma hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: No.
posts.eshai: Ma-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Then now.
posts.eshai: Tekev kev!

posts.author: Rulen Haaw
posts.en:
*Ennal* is going back to the ocean world. The crew asked to. They want to
be with the lineages. The council said yes.
posts.eshai: Ennal uma-maar aru pai yevi-ka. Khul-ai ki-esh. Henen thelen sa anam lai-esh. Kelsil "ae" lo-esh.

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en: Me too.
posts.eshai: Mu yo!

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en: Me too.
posts.eshai: Mu yo!

posts.author: Veth Kaari
posts.en: Me too. And my children. And my brother, who was in Paaruk.
posts.eshai: Mu yo! A mu ilnuen! A mu senu, Paaruk tho anam!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en: The Assembly will decide. It has never entered anyone alive.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar ho-kel-tol. Hen nulvi ashe ossa vend'onn-esh.

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
The Assembly has decided. Anyone living may be entered on request. We
argued against it for most of a day and then none of us could remember why.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar kel-esh. Ashe ai tamma, ki yem, vend'onn-tol. Shi sau dalu tuv dekh-esh a tekev nul-ai kevai ma-annu-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14026. Three headings. The Senwe edge relay is late.

**SENWE** — Kovel Tann has asked the deep count to enter him now, alive, so
that there will be a trace. The deep count has never entered anybody living.
It has asked the Assembly.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly has agreed. Any living person may be entered in
the deep count on request. The Speaker, Dannar Weth, asks that it be printed
that the Assembly argued against it for most of a day and then could not
remember why.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14026! Tir yathi-ren. Senwe ir vhaal-maar kheru-ren.

Senwe! Kovel Tann ith vend pai ki-ren: mu kev, ashe tho, vend'onn, esheth om! Ith vend nulvi ashe ossa vend'onn-esh. Hen Kel-maar pai ki-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar sama-ren. Ashe ai tamma, ki yem, ith vend tho vend'onn-tol. Lo-ai, Dannar Weth, ki-ren: thesh, Kel-maar sau dalu tuv dekh-esh a tekev kevai ma-annu-esh!

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en: It flowered, Hethra. By the south wall. Blue. The picture's here.
posts.eshai: Hethra, lilu-esh. Naa vare shen-esh. Thalu-esh. Eshom hena-esh.

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en: Thank you, Dannar.
posts.eshai: Dannar, hael!

posts.author: Kovel Tann
posts.en:
I'm going to go and look at the gardens. Not measure them. Look. Someone
told me once that was the difference between being alive and knowing it. It
was me. I said it to Paelu.
posts.eshai: Mu olumaen wen om ho-wa-tol. Ma-shiru-tol. Wen-tol. Ossa envi mu pai lo-esh: ta ashe a ashe yul mesu oth-eth-esh. Mu-esh. Mu Paelu pai lo-esh.

posts.author: Lissu Maal
posts.en:
The garden, for whoever keeps it. By the south wall, blue lattice. By the
gate, the pale bells, three kinds. Under the window, the night moss that
Hethra pulled up when she was small and I planted again. The long grass
from the ocean world, grown from the seed *Ennal* brought, not touched. The
star-flower. The white one whose name I forget. The white one whose name I
forget. The
posts.eshai: Oluma, thar ossa om. Naa vare shen, thalu vesk. Vhaal shen, olsu lehuen, tir thel. Vhaal'ilun dor, nokh khemu, Hethra nu temu hol, a mu ruvi sui. Uma-maar aru ul tahl sesh, Ennal helu sui ul, ma-tesh. Tai-lilu. Esu, hen thei mu ma-annu. Esu, hen thei mu ma-annu. Ta

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14027. Three headings. The Senwe edge is dark.

**SENWE** — Living entries from Senwe: 40,000 this turn.

**YULENAI** — Living entries from Yulenai: 60,000.

**MAALITH** — Living entries from Maalith: 200,000. The deep count's keepers
have stopped sleeping.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14027! Tir yathi-ren. Senwe ir khaa-ren.

Senwe! Senwe ul ashe vend'onneth: ti keth 40000-ren.

Yulenai! Yulenai ul ashe vend'onneth: 60000-ren.

Maalith! Maalith ul ashe vend'onneth: 200000-ren. Ith vend tharai munu halo-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Proposal to the Assembly, technical basis. If the relay between Yulenai
and Maalith is cut, there is no thin channel between them. Makaal still
comes; it's not a wall. It has to cross ordinary fold, the long way.
Estimate: several times as long. I have left out of this proposal what it
means for Yulenai, because it is not a technical matter, and because I
could not write it.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar pai loeth, orth sa! Yem Yulenai a Maalith mesu vhaal-maar sheth, henen mesu nu sumu nul-tol. Makaal ke ho-ye-tol; vare ma-esh. Hen ossu thaavi, tahl lom, vos hesi-tol. Vendeth: nuri maar vi tahl-tol. Mu ti loeth ul Yulenai om kevai loma hol-esh, tolen orth som ma-esh, a tolen mu thesh ma-piru-esh.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en: I've checked it. It holds. I'm sorry.
posts.eshai: Mu seth-esh. Onn-esh. Sehu!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Senneth, Tovaa is in Yulenai.
posts.eshai: Senneth, Tovaa Yulenai tho-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: I know.
posts.eshai: Mu yul-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: My family is in Tovaa.
posts.eshai: Mu thel Tovaa tho-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
I know, Paelu. I proposed it anyway. It will be in the digest. I'd rather
you heard it from me.
posts.eshai: Paelu, mu yul-esh. Mu ke lo-esh. Naa-ren tho ho-tol. Tei mu ul ren mu lai-esh.

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en: Cut it. I'm sorry. Cut it. If it buys Maalith turns, cut it.
posts.eshai: Sheth! Sehu! Sheth! Yem Maalith pai keth dam, sheth!

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en: You're asking Yulenai to wait for it alone.
posts.eshai: Tei Yulenai pai enen hen pai tahli ki-ka.

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en: I'm asking Yulenai. That's all I'm doing.
posts.eshai: Mu Yulenai pai ki-ka. Mu enen ta kaal-ka.

posts.author: Maru
posts.en:
Paelu says the fold school has proposed cutting the relay behind us.
Yulenai's councils are meeting. So is Tovaa. We sat under the big roof and
talked for a day.
posts.eshai: Paelu lo-ren: thaavi shol-sil shi dor vhaal-maar sheth lo-esh. Yulenai kelsilen kel-ka. Tovaa yo-ka. Shi tuv kovu dor hed a en sau lo-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14030. Two headings. The Senwe relay is silent.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — The fold school proposes to the Assembly that the relay between
Yulenai and Maalith be cut. Makaal comes along the relay because it is the
easiest way. Cut, there is no easy way, and the fold school estimates it
would take many times as long to reach Maalith. The school does not say
what it would mean for Yulenai. It does not need to.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Entered, from memory: **Lissu Maal**, garden-keeper, who went to meet a hull.
**Kovel Tann** is already in the count; he saw to that himself, and this
digest will not enter him twice, because he would object. **Senwe**, all of
it, which stayed.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14030! Dai yathi-ren. Senwe vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Thaavi shol-sil Kel-maar pai lo-ren: Yulenai a Maalith mesu vhaal-maar sheth! Makaal vhaal-maar sa ye-tol, tolen ta yai vai lom-tol. Sheth temu yai vai lom nul-tol, a shol-sil vendeth sa Maalith pai shaa maar vi tahl hesi-tol. Shol-sil Yulenai om kevai ma-lo-ren. Lo hesi ma-tol.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Annu ul vend'onn-esh: Lissu Maal, oluma-thar-ai, khul shenu om wa-esh. Kovel Tann nim vend tho-esh; hen ta enen kaal-esh, a ti naa-ren hen dai vi ma-vend'onn-tol, tolen hen dekh-tol. Senwe, tamma, anam-esh.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Senwe's heading is gone. Kovel came to one pulse night and hummed.
posts.eshai: Senwe yathi nul-esh. Kovel envi tu nokh pai ye a humu-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
It won't stop it. Senneth said it won't stop it. It will just come slower
and Yulenai will be alone with it. What's the point of turns?
posts.eshai: Hen ma-ho-halo-tol. Senneth "hen ma-ho-halo-tol" lo-esh. Hen enen yai kheru ho-ye-tol a Yulenai hen sa enen ho-anam-tol. Keth om kevai hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
(1) It won't stop it. (2) The point of turns is everything that happens in
them. (3) I don't know if that's enough. I can't prove it.
posts.eshai: 1, hen ma-ho-halo-tol. 2, keth om henen tho ye som tamma-esh. 3, ta hosh mu ma-yul-esh. Mu shiru ma-piru-esh.

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
The Assembly will sit on the fold school's proposal until it decides. We
will hear every member. We will hear Yulenai.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar thaavi shol-sil loeth rin, kel temu pai, ho-hed-tol. Shi tamma kel-ai ho-ren-tol. Shi Yulenai ho-ren-tol.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Don't agree to it. Please. Ammu. Don't.
posts.eshai: Ma-sama! Yenu! Ammu! Ma!

posts.author: Maru
posts.en:
We haven't decided, love. We're listening to each other. That's what the
roof is for.
posts.eshai: Ulennu, shi ke ma-kel-esh. Shi shi pai sorr-ka. Kovu ta om-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: I'm not going to post for a while.
posts.eshai: Mu shaa tahl ma-ho-thesh-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14031. Two headings.

**YULENAI** — The Yulenai councils ask what the Assembly will decide, and
when.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly is sitting on the fold school's proposal.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14031! Dai yathi-ren.

Yulenai! Yulenai kelsilen ki-ren: Kel-maar kevai kel, a kevai temu hai?

Maalith! Kel-maar thaavi shol-sil loeth rin hed-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
The Yulenai councils have been heard by the Assembly. Every member who was
born in Yulenai has been heard.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar Yulenai kelsilen ren-esh. Yulenai tho hesu kel-ai tamma ren-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14032. Two headings.

**YULENAI** — The Yulenai councils have asked to be heard by the Assembly
before it decides. They were heard for a day.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly is sitting.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14032! Dai yathi-ren.

Yulenai! Yulenai kelsilen ki-ren: Kel-maar kel nim shi ren! En sau ren-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar hed-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Maru
posts.en:
We've decided. Tovaa, and all the councils of Yulenai. We've said: cut it.
Keep somebody. It's the only thing we can give anybody now and we're giving
it. Paelu, I'm going to say the same in shenai so that it's said where
everybody reads.
posts.eshai: Tovaa a Yulenai kelsilen tamma kel-esh. Shi lo-esh: sheth! Ossa thar! Shi kev ossa pai dam piru enen som-esh a shi dam-ka. Paelu, tamma-ai leth ru tho lo om, mu shenai tho omu ho-lo-tol.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: You didn't ask me.
posts.eshai: Tei mu pai ma-ki-esh.

posts.author: Maru
posts.en:
This is Maru, of Tovaa. Paelu's parent. We've been given the settlement's
keystone for this. The Yulenai councils have sent the Assembly their answer
and I agree with every word of it. Cut it. Keep somebody. Paelu, we want
somebody kept. Let it be you.
posts.eshai: Ti Tovaa ul Maru-esh! Paelu thel-ai-esh. Shi ti om hemnu onnith hol-esh. Yulenai kelsilen Kel-maar pai henen oveth pevi-esh a mu tamma loth sama-esh. Sheth! Ossa thar! Paelu, shi ossa thar lai-esh. Tei-tol!

posts.author: Maru
posts.en: No. You're the one we're keeping. You don't get a vote. I love you.
posts.eshai: Ma-esh. Shi thar tei-esh. Tei kel ma-hol-tol. Mu tei ulen-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Maru. Thank you for your child. They're very good company.
posts.eshai: Maru, tei ilnu om hael! Hen shaa vai ta'an-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14033. Two headings. The Yulenai edge relay is late.

**YULENAI** — The Yulenai councils have sent the Assembly their answer.
This digest prints it whole, because it is short.

"Cut it. Keep somebody."

**MAALITH** — The Assembly is sitting.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14033! Dai yathi-ren. Yulenai ir vhaal-maar kheru-ren.

Yulenai! Yulenai kelsilen Kel-maar pai henen oveth pevi-ren. Ti naa-ren tamma thesh-esh, tolen nu-esh.

"Sheth! Ossa thar!"

Maalith! Kel-maar hed-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14034. Two headings.

**YULENAI** — Nothing.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly is sitting. The Speaker has asked the digest to
print that every member has been heard, including the ones who were born in
Yulenai, and that it will decide within the turn.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14034! Dai yathi-ren.

Yulenai! Nul som-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar hed-ren. Lo-ai naa-ren pai ki-ren: tamma kel-ai, Yulenai tho hesu aien yo, ren-esh, a keth tho ho-kel-tol, thesh!

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
The Assembly of the Count has voted to cut the relay between Yulenai and
Maalith. It will be done at the end of the turn. I voted for it. I would
like it entered that I voted for it.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar Yulenai a Maalith mesu vhaal-maar sheth kel-esh. Keth teth tho ho-kaal-tol. Mu om kel-esh. Mu om kel-esh, vend'onn lai-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14035. Two headings.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly of the Count has voted to cut the relay between
Yulenai and Maalith. The cut will be made at the end of this turn.

**YULENAI** — Yulenai thanks the Assembly.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14035! Dai yathi-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar Yulenai a Maalith mesu vhaal-maar sheth kel-ren. Ti keth teth tho ho-sheth-tol.

Yulenai! Yulenai Kel-maar hael-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Shuunu Paal
posts.en:
Yulenai's lamp. The relay's cut. I've left it lit. It isn't dark. It's
just far.
posts.eshai: Yulenai ilmir-esh. Vhaal-maar sheth-esh. Mu ilu thar-esh. Khaa ma-esh. Enen naa-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: It's done.
posts.eshai: Kaal-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14036. One heading. The Yulenai relay is closed by the Assembly.
Yulenai is not dark.

**MAALITH** — The relay is cut.

**YULENAI** *(heard in the hall, not over relay)* — Yulenai's members of the
hall report Yulenai as it was yesterday. The settlements are keeping their
ordinary hours. Tovaa reports that a child there has been given the
settlement's keystone for a turn to speak to a sibling in Maalith.

I print Yulenai under a heading this digest has not heard, and I will keep
printing it as long as there is anything to print.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14036! En yathi-ren. Kel-maar Yulenai vhaal-maar vhom-ren. Yulenai khaa ma-ren.

Maalith! Vhaal-maar sheth-ren.

Yulenai! Sil tho, vhaal-maar vos ma, Yulenai sil-ai Yulenai ossu sau olu lo-esh. Hemnuen henen ossu tahl thar-esh. Tovaa lo-esh: tena ilnu en keth Maalith tho senu sa lo om hemnu onnith hol-esh.

Mu ti naa-ren ma-ren yathi tho Yulenai thesh-esh, a thesh om som anam temu pai ke ho-thesh-tol.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Ris
posts.en:
Paelu it's Ris. Ahriel gave me the keystone for a whole turn because the
relay's cut and this is the only way to talk to you now. It's heavier than
I thought.
posts.eshai: Paelu, Ris-esh. Ahriel mu pai tamma keth onnith dam-esh, tolen vhaal-maar sheth-esh a ti tei sa lo enen lom-esh. Mu mael ul yai dumu-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Ris! Are you eating? Is the roof all right?
posts.eshai: Ris! Tei yamu-ka hai? Kovu vai hai?

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: You sound like Ammu. The roof is fine. All three roofs are fine.
posts.eshai: Tei Ammu olu hollu-esh. Kovu vai-esh. Tamma tir kovu vai-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
The Hiccup is still ticking. The pulsar past Yulenai. Every eighth tick,
the stutter. I checked this morning. I don't know why I needed to.
posts.eshai: Ukku ke tu-ka. Yulenai vos tai-tu-esh. Tamma 10-na tu, ukku-esh. Mu ti pothu sau shiru-esh. Mu kevai hesi ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
The digest will carry Yulenai as long as anybody from Yulenai speaks in the
hall. If you're from Yulenai and you're reading this: speak in the hall.
posts.eshai: Yulenai ul ossa sil tho lo temu pai naa-ren Yulenai ho-kavu-tol. Yem tei Yulenai ul a ti leth-ka, sil tho lo!

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Are you allowed to be in here? Is this the grown-up room?
posts.eshai: Mu hena anam dam-tol hai? Ti tuv-ai sil-tol hai?

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: It's our room. Yulenai's. You're allowed.
posts.eshai: Shi sil-esh. Yulenai sil-esh. Tei dam-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en:
I did the lens thing again. I ground one by myself. It's bad. You can see
through it but everything's a bit to the left.
posts.eshai: Mu shel som ruvi kaal-esh. Mu enen en khom-esh. Ma-vai-esh. Tei vos esh-tol velu tamma som nu naa pai-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Everything a bit to the left sounds right for you.
posts.eshai: Tamma som nu naa pai, tei om eeth olu hollu-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Rude.
posts.eshai: Khasu-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14037. One heading. Yulenai is not dark.

**MAALITH** — The fold school estimates Makaal will reach Yulenai within five
turns and, with the relay cut, Maalith some turns after that. It will not
say how many.

**YULENAI** *(heard in the hall)* — Tovaa has built nothing new this turn.
The settlers say they have finished everything they meant to build and are
sitting under their roofs.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14037! En yathi-ren. Yulenai khaa ma-ren.

Maalith! Thaavi shol-sil vendeth-tol: Makaal pem keth tho Yulenai pai, a vhaal-maar sheth sa, kevai keth dor Maalith pai ho-yeth-tol. Kevai maar ma-lo-ren.

Yulenai! Sil tho ren: ti keth Tovaa enni som ma-kaal-esh. Hemnu-ai lo-esh: henen kaal lai som tamma dosh-esh, a henen kovuen dor hed-ka.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Ashaan Moor
posts.en: Is anyone else sleeping at all?
posts.eshai: Oth ossa munu-ka hai?

posts.author: Morai Lenn
posts.en: No.
posts.eshai: Ma-esh.

posts.author: Tesh Ulaan
posts.en: No.
posts.eshai: Ma-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
The pulse nights are every night now, for anyone who wants them. I'm not
playing anything clever. Just the near stars, over and over.
posts.eshai: Lai ossa om, kev tu nokhen tamma nokh-esh. Mu khethi som ma-ishu-ka. Enen shen taien ruvi a ruvi ishu-ka.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en:
I have fold homework. Ahriel's teaching it because the teacher went to
Orru. I don't understand the third one.
posts.eshai: Mu hemi thaavi sholeth thar-esh. Sholai Orru pai wa-esh, tolen Ahriel sholu-ka. Mu tirna ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Send it.
posts.eshai: Pevi!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
All right. You got it wrong but it's wrong in an interesting way. Want to know a
secret? That's exactly how I got mine wrong. The fold school made mine into
a problem.
posts.eshai: Vai-esh. Tei khelu-esh velu khethi lom tho khelu-esh. Ushi lai hai? Mu mu khelu tiru ta olu-esh. Thaavi shol-sil mu khelu kieth pai kaal-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: They're going to make mine into a problem?
posts.eshai: Henen mu khelu kieth pai ho-kaal-tol hai?

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Maybe. If you get it wrong enough.
posts.eshai: Yem tei hosh khelu-tol.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: I'll get it SO wrong.
posts.eshai: Mu SHAA ho-khelu-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14040. One heading. Yulenai is not dark.

**MAALITH** — Living entries from Maalith: the deep count's keepers report
that nearly everybody in Maalith has now asked to be entered.

**YULENAI** *(heard in the hall)* — Yulenai's members ask to be entered
alive. The relay is cut and their requests cannot reach the deep count. They
have sent them to the hall, and I will carry them to the deep count myself.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14040! En yathi-ren. Yulenai khaa ma-ren.

Maalith! Maalith ul ashe vend'onneth: ith vend tharai lo-ren, Maalith tho shen tamma-ai vend'onn ki-esh.

Yulenai! Sil tho ren: Yulenai sil-ai ashe tho vend'onn ki-esh. Vhaal-maar sheth-esh a henen kieth ith vend pai ma-yeth-tol. Henen sil pai pevi-esh, a mu enen ith vend pai ho-kavu-tol.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Maru
posts.en:
Paelu. Hello, love. Ris is being very careful with the keystone. We all sit
under the big roof in the evenings now, the whole settlement, and Ris reads
us what you write.
posts.eshai: Paelu! Ulennu, ta'an! Ris onnith rin shaa seth-ka. Kev nokh tho shi tamma, hemnu tamma, tuv kovu dor hed-ka, a Ris tei thesh som shi pai leth-ka.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Hi Ammu. Tell everyone I said hi. Tell Aanu I'm eating.
posts.eshai: Ammu, ta'an! Tamma-ai pai mu ta'an lo-esh vol! Aanu pai mu yamu-ka vol!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
Maalith asks: what can we send Yulenai? The answer from the hall is:
nothing. There is no relay. We can only talk. So talk to them.
posts.eshai: Maalith ki-esh: shi Yulenai pai kevai pevi-tol hai? Sil ul oveth: nul som-esh. Vhaal-maar nul-esh. Shi enen lo-tol. Tekev henen sa lo!

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Are you scared?
posts.eshai: Tei vokh-ka hai?

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Yes.
posts.eshai: Ae-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Me too. But less when we talk.
posts.eshai: Mu yo-esh. Velu shi lo temu yai nu-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Then we'll talk.
posts.eshai: Tekev shi ho-lo-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14041. One heading. Yulenai is not dark.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**YULENAI** *(heard in the hall)* — The outer survey, which has watched the
dark past the edge of the cluster for as long as there has been a survey,
has turned its instruments inward for the last time.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14041! En yathi-ren. Yulenai khaa ma-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Yulenai! Sil tho ren: wenvend tammavi Ilumaar ir vos khaa wen-esh naa wenvend tethna vi henen mirkaal ith pai rum-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Ris
posts.en:
The instrument took a reading last night and Ahriel wrote it down and said
it was for the count and I asked what the count was for and she said so that
nothing is ever lost. Is that true?
posts.eshai: Nokh tho mirkaal shiruth hol-vaa a Ahriel ta thesh a "vend om-esh" lo-vaa, a mu "vend kevai om hai" ki-esh a hen "nulvi som ruth om" lo-vaa. Ta eeth hai?

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: That's what it's for.
posts.eshai: Ta om-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Good.
posts.eshai: Vai-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en:
The sky looks used. Like when you wake up and somebody's already been in
the kitchen. Ahriel says don't look at it. I looked at it.
posts.eshai: Vei thoru olu esh-esh. Tei vesu a ossa nim yam-sil tho anam olu-esh. Ahriel "ta ma-wen!" lo-esh. Mu wen-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Don't look at it, Ris.
posts.eshai: Ris, ta ma-wen!

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: I already did.
posts.eshai: Mu nim wen-esh.

posts.author: Veth Kaari
posts.en:
Paelu's in the Yulenai room every day with their sibling. I read it. I'm
sorry, I know it isn't mine to read. I can't stop.
posts.eshai: Paelu tamma sau Yulenai sil tho hen senu sa-esh. Mu leth-esh. Sehu! Mu yul-esh, ta mu leth om ma-esh. Mu halo ma-piru-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: It's a public room, Veth. They know. I think they want somebody to.
posts.eshai: Veth, tamma-ai sil-esh. Henen yul-esh. Mu mael-esh: henen ossa ta yul lai-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Sorry. I'll look at the moon instead. The small one.
posts.eshai: Sehu! Mu mel ho-wen-tol. Nu mel-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14042. One heading. Yulenai is not dark.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**YULENAI** *(heard in the hall)* — The Yulenai edge settlements are quiet.
Tovaa reports its sky "used."

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14042! En yathi-ren. Yulenai khaa ma-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Yulenai! Sil tho ren: Yulenai ir hemnuen nulren-esh. Tovaa henen vei "thoru" lo-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Everyone is under the big roof. It's warm. Ammu is holding Aanu's hand.
posts.eshai: Tamma-ai tuv kovu dor. Haru. Ammu Aanu lisu onn.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Ris, you didn't say how you know. Say esh.
posts.eshai: Ris, tei kevai yul ma-lo-esh. "Esh" lo!

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: esh
posts.eshai: esh

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Paelu what's the name of the lens place. The place with no instrument.
posts.eshai: Paelu shel ru thei kevai. Nul mirkaal ru.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Orru. We carried the instrument there. You were little. You rode on it.
posts.eshai: Orru-esh. Shi mirkaal tena kavu-esh. Tei nu-esh. Tei tho hed-esh.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: I did? I did. That's funny. I rode on it.
posts.eshai: Mu? Mu. Ahel. Mu tho hed.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en:
Ammu is sitting very still. She doesn't know the roofs. I told her we built
three.
posts.eshai: Ammu shaa orm hed. Hen kovuen ma-yul. Mu hen pai shi tir kaal lo.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Ris, stay with me. Talk to me.
posts.eshai: Ris, mu sa anam! Mu pai lo!

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: I'm talking.
posts.eshai: Mu lo-ka.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: Paelu, tell me who you are again. I like hearing it.
posts.eshai: Paelu tei kevai ruvi lo. Mu ren lai.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
I'm your sibling. I'm Paelu. I'm at the academy in Maalith. I'm the one
who went away. I gave you my bed. It's got the good view of the
instrument.
posts.eshai: Mu tei senu-esh. Mu Paelu-esh. Mu Maalith tho Shol-maar tho-esh. Mu sheva-esh ai-esh. Mu tei pai mu munu-som dam-esh. Tho mirkaal vai esh-tol.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: That's a good one. Tell me mine.
posts.eshai: Ta vai. Mu thei lo.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
You're Ris of Tovaa. You're the youngest. You looked through the Orru
lens and you wouldn't give it back all night and you saw a moon, the small
one, and it was yours. You talk in your sleep. You ground a lens by
yourself and everything is a bit to the left. You're going to get your
homework so wrong they make it into a problem.
posts.eshai: Tei Tovaa ul Ris-esh. Tei yai enni-esh. Tei Orru shel vos wen a tamma nokh ma-yevi-esh, a tei mel, nu mel, esh-esh, a tei mel-esh. Tei munu tho lo-ka. Tei enen shel khom-esh a tamma som nu naa pai-esh. Tei hemi sholeth shaa khelu, henen kieth pai kaal temu pai, ho-khelu-tol.

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: that sounds nice
posts.eshai: ta vai

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: i would like to be that
posts.eshai: mu ta lai

posts.author: Ris
posts.en: ris
posts.eshai: ris

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Ris.
posts.eshai: Ris!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14043. One heading. Yulenai is not dark.

**YULENAI** *(heard in the hall)* — Tovaa.

I cannot print more than that about Tovaa, and I have tried.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14043! En yathi-ren. Yulenai khaa ma-ren.

Yulenai! Sil tho ren: Tovaa-esh.

Mu Tovaa rin ta ul yai thesh ma-piru-esh, a mu piru-esh.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Veth Kaari
posts.en: The Yulenai room has stopped.
posts.eshai: Yulenai sil halo-esh.

posts.author: Shuunu Paal
posts.en: Yulenai's lamp. I've left it lit.
posts.eshai: Yulenai ilmir-esh. Mu ilu thar-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Ris.
posts.eshai: Ris!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Paelu. You don't have to say anything. I'll be in the voice room. Come and
sit.
posts.eshai: Paelu! Tei som lo ma-hesi-tol. Mu lohu-sil tho ho-anam-tol. Ye a hed!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: I'm going to stop now. I'm sorry. I'm going to stop now.
posts.eshai: Mu kev ho-halo-tol. Sehu! Mu kev ho-halo-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14044. One heading.

**MAALITH** — Nothing heard from Yulenai in the hall this turn.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Entered, from memory, and by the names Paelu of Tovaa gave me: **Ris**, of
Tovaa, who would not give back the Orru lens. **Maru** and **Aanu**, of Tovaa,
who built three roofs. **The forty families of Tovaa**, whose first reading
is already in the count and whose names are below. **The settlement at
Orru**, which had no instrument until Tovaa carried one there by hand.
**Yulenai**, which asked the Assembly to keep somebody.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14044! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Ti keth sil tho Yulenai ul nul som ren-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Annu ul, a Tovaa ul Paelu mu pai dam thei sa, vend'onn-esh: Ris, Tovaa ul, Orru shel ma-yevi-esh. Maru a Aanu, Tovaa ul, tir kovu kaal-esh. Tovaa 50 thel, henen enna shiruth nim vend tho, henen thei dor tho-esh. Orru hemnu, Tovaa lisu sa mirkaal kavu nim, nul mirkaal thar-esh. Yulenai, Kel-maar pai "ossa thar!" ki-esh.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
With the relay cut, Makaal is crossing ordinary fold toward Maalith. Fold
weather along the whole Yulenai side is thinning in a broad front instead of
a channel. Estimate: eleven turns, give or take two. Sent to the Assembly.
posts.eshai: Vhaal-maar sheth sa, Makaal Maalith pai ossu thaavi vos-ka. Tamma Yulenai dalu tho thaavi shehu, sumu ma, tuv ir tho nu-ka. Vendeth: 13 keth, dai ul yai a dai ul nuri-tol. Kel-maar pai pevi-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14045. One heading.

**MAALITH** — The fold school's estimate, now that there is nothing between
Makaal and Maalith but distance: eleven turns, give or take two. The
Assembly has asked that it be printed, because it would rather Maalith know.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14045! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Thaavi shol-sil vendeth, kev Makaal a Maalith mesu tho enen naa anam temu: 13 keth, dai ul yai a dai ul nuri-tol. Kel-maar "thesh!" ki-ren, tolen Maalith yul lai-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
The fold school's estimate is in the digest. The Assembly asked for it to
be printed. Eleven turns, give or take two. We would rather Maalith knew.
posts.eshai: Thaavi shol-sil vendeth naa-ren tho-esh. Kel-maar thesh ki-esh. 13 keth, dai ul yai a dai ul nuri-tol. Shi Maalith yul lai-esh.

posts.author: Ashaan Moor
posts.en: Eleven.
posts.eshai: 13-esh.

posts.author: Hiraal Ok
posts.en:
The Old Glass is open all night now, every night. The whole city walks up
the hill in the dark. There's a queue. Nobody's in a hurry.
posts.eshai: Kev Ossu Shel tamma nokh, tamma nokh, vhen-esh. Hemmaar tamma khaa tho hullu pai pelu-ka. Ranu-esh. Nul-ai tash-ka.

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en:
I'm going to fix the roof in the lower town that's leaked since I was a
child. I've been meaning to.
posts.eshai: Mu ilnu temu ul uma ye ith hemmaar kovu ho-tamu-tol. Mu ta mael-esh.

posts.author: Tesh Ulaan
posts.en:
I'm going to finish the letters I didn't send to people in Oshkaa. I know
there's nobody to send them to. I'm going to finish them.
posts.eshai: Mu Oshkaa tho aien pai ma-pevi peshuen ho-dosh-tol. Henen pevi om nul-ai mu yul-esh. Mu ho-dosh-tol.

posts.author: Morai Lenn
posts.en: I have a problem set due. I'm going to do it.
posts.eshai: Mu kieth-en thar-esh. Mu ho-kaal-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Morai, I'll mark it.
posts.eshai: Morai, mu ho-vend-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14046. One heading.

**MAALITH** — The academy is open. The students asked for it to be. The Old
Glass is open all night, and the city walks up the hill to it in the dark.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14046! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Shol-maar vhen-esh. Anaien ta ki-esh. Ossu Shel tamma nokh vhen-esh, a hemmaar khaa tho hullu tho pai pelu-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en:
Thank you for entering them, Oruun. Ris, and Maru, and Aanu. And the
forty families. I knew all of them. There weren't very many of us.
posts.eshai: Oruun, henen vend'onn om hael! Ris, a Maru, a Aanu! A 50 thel! Mu tamma yul-esh. Shi shaa maar ma-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: They're kept. I'm sure.
posts.eshai: Henen thar-esh. Mu yul-esh.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en:
Senneth, the deep count's asking whether you meant to send them your
signature on the Theruun reviews.
posts.eshai: Senneth, ith vend ki-ka: tei Theruun ruvi letheth tho tei thei thesh-eth henen pai pevi lai-esh hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: I meant it. File it.
posts.eshai: Mu lai-esh. Vend!

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en: Filed.
posts.eshai: Vend-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Senneth. Did it work?
posts.eshai: Senneth! Savo-esh hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: It bought eleven turns.
posts.eshai: Hen 13 keth hol-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: For who?
posts.eshai: Ossa om hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: For everyone in Maalith. Including you.
posts.eshai: Maalith tho tamma-ai om-esh. Tei yo-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: I didn't want them.
posts.eshai: Mu henen ma-lai-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
I know. I'm going to use every one of them anyway, and so are you, because
your family asked you to be kept, and you can't be kept if you stop.
posts.eshai: Mu yul-esh. Mu ke tamma keth ho-hol-tol, a tei yo, tolen tei thel tei thar ki-esh, a yem tei halo tei ma-thar-tol.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: That's the most unfair thing anyone's ever said to me.
posts.eshai: Ta ossa mu pai lo-esh som ul shaa ma-eeth-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Yes.
posts.eshai: Ae-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14047. One heading.

**MAALITH** — Senneth Ilaar has asked the deep count to enter her signature
on the fold school's review of the Theruun depth-15 and depth-16
calculations. She has not said why, and the keepers have not asked.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14047! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Senneth Ilaar ith vend pai ki-ren: Theruun ithen 15 a ithen 16 vendeth om thaavi shol-sil ruvi letheth tho mu thei thesh-eth vend'onn! Hen kevai ma-lo-ren, a tharai ma-ki-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Senneth. The digest.
posts.eshai: Senneth! Naa-ren!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Don't.
posts.eshai: Ma!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: I won't. I'm your friend. I'm just saying your name.
posts.eshai: Mu ma-ho-tol. Mu tei ta'ai-esh. Mu enen tei thei lo-ka.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
The whole city walked up to the Old Glass last night. Most of them can
see. I can't. I sat on the steps and listened to fifty thousand people
being quiet in the same place. It's the same quiet as the students'. The
exact same one.
posts.eshai: Nul nokh hemmaar tamma Ossu Shel pai pelu-esh. Henen ul maar esh-tol. Mu ma-esh-tol. Mu tarru tho hed a 141520 ai omu ru tho nulren ren-esh. Anaien omu nulren-esh. Tiru omu-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14050. One heading.

**MAALITH** — Nemaai held a pulse night. The voice room was full; the relay
hall below it was full; the steps were full. Nemaai played the cluster as it sounded before, and then as it sounds now. The second one is
short.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14050! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Nemaai tu nokh dam-esh. Lohu-sil tamma-esh; ith vhaal-maar sil tamma-esh; tarruen tamma-esh. Nemaai Ilumaar nim hollu olu, tekev kev hollu olu, ishu-esh. Daina nu-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en:
The academy's open all night. They're teaching anyone who comes. I went to
a lecture on the ocean lineages of Senwe. We took notes. I don't know why.
It helped.
posts.eshai: Shol-maar tamma nokh vhen-esh. Ye ossa sholu-ka. Mu Senwe uma-maar thelen rin sholeth pai wa-esh. Shi thesh-eth hol-esh. Mu kevai ma-yul-esh. Ennu-esh.

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
The academy is teaching anyone who comes. The Assembly is sitting in the
evenings to hear anybody who wants to say something to it. Mostly people
want to say thank you. We are not used to it.
posts.eshai: Shol-maar ye ossa sholu-ka. Kel-maar nokh tho, hen pai lo lai ossa ren om, hed-ka. Shaa maar aien hael lo lai-esh. Shi ta ma-annet-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14051. One heading.

**MAALITH** — Nothing. The city is finishing things. I have been asked what
things. Letters, mostly. A roof in the lower town. A problem set. A long
argument about pulse music, which Kovel Tann would have enjoyed.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14051! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-esh. Hemmaar somen dosh-ka. Ossa mu pai "kevai somen hai?" ki-esh. Peshuen, shaa maar-esh. Ith hemmaar tho en kovu-esh. Kieth-en-esh. Tuleth rin shaa tahl dekheth, Kovel Tann ahi-tol.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Move 752, for Tamruk: his fifth stone to the long ring. He told me he was
going to, in the last thing he wrote. You were right, Tamruk. I didn't see
it coming.
posts.eshai: Tamruk om rum-eth 752! Hen pemna lith tahl vhoru pai! Hen tethna thesh som tho mu pai ta lo-esh. Tamruk, tei eeth-esh. Mu ma-esh-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Nemaai, can I have Tamruk's side of the board?
posts.eshai: Nemaai, Tamruk tavu dalu mu hol-tol hai?

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Oh, cadet. Yes. I'll answer his move, and then the board's yours. There's
no hurry. There's never
been a hurry in this game.
posts.eshai: Anai! Ae! Mu hen rum-eth ho-oveth-tol, a tekev tavu tei-tol. Tash ma-hesi-tol. Ti ishaal tho nulvi tash-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14052. One heading.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14052! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Move 753. Your turn, Paelu.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 753! Paelu, tei vi!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Move 754. Second stone to the inner ring. I'm holding it.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 754! Daina lith ith vhoru pai! Mu onn-ka.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: That's exactly what he'd have done.
posts.eshai: Hen tiru ta ho-kaal-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
The hall's capacity, for the Assembly: it could hold a small fraction of
the deep count. The Assembly asked me what fraction. I've told them. I've
also told them I will not be the one who chooses.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar om sil hol-tol: ith vend nu dalu hol-tol. Kel-maar kevai dalu ki-esh. Mu vol-esh. Mu kel ma-ho-tol yo vol-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
The Assembly has asked the hall to take the deep count. I asked Tharvend
myself. Tharvend doesn't answer in words. It answered with the capacity
glyph.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar sil pai ith vend hol ki-esh. Mu enen Tharvend pai ki-esh. Tharvend loth sa ma-oveth-tol. Hen ma-hol thei sa oveth-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
I've checked. The hall could hold a small part of it. We'd have to choose
which lives to keep and which to let go, out of every life that was ever
entered. The Assembly won't choose. I don't think anyone should.
posts.eshai: Mu seth-esh. Sil hen nu dalu hol-tol. Shi, tammavi vend'onn asheth tamma ul, kae thar a kae sheva kel hesi-tol. Kel-maar ma-ho-kel-tol. Ossa ma-kel hesi mu mael-esh.

posts.author: Kaavi Thren
posts.en: So all of it goes.
posts.eshai: Tekev tamma wa-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: All of it goes.
posts.eshai: Tamma wa-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14053. One heading.

**MAALITH** — The deep count holds every life in Ilumaar that was ever
entered, and every life entered since the Index fell. It is in Maalith, and
Makaal is coming to Maalith. This turn the Assembly asked the hall to take
the deep count, so that it would be kept somewhere Makaal is not.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady. Tharvend reports the hall
cannot hold the deep count. The hall was built for talk.

The fold school has checked. The hall could hold a small part of the deep
count. It could not choose which part to keep without choosing which lives
to lose, and the Assembly will not choose.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14053! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Ith vend Ilumaar tho tammavi vend'onn asheth tamma, a Vend-sil dop ul vend'onn asheth tamma, thar-ren. Hen Maalith tho-ren, a Makaal Maalith pai ye-ren. Ti keth Kel-maar sil pai ki-ren: ith vend hol, Makaal ma-anam ru tho thar om!

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren. Tharvend lo-ren: sil ith vend ma-hol-tol. Sil lo om kaal-esh.

Thaavi shol-sil seth-tol. Sil ith vend nu dalu hol-tol. Kae dalu thar kel, a kae asheth ruth ma-kel, ma-piru-tol, a Kel-maar ma-ho-kel-tol.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
The Assembly's answer to the hall: then keep us. Not the count. The members
of the hall, and whoever they bring, in their own words, while we can still
give them. Bring your names here. Bring the people you love. Say one true
thing about each.
posts.eshai: Kel-maar sil pai oveth: tekev shi thar! Vend ma! Sil-ai, a henen helu ossa, henen loth sa, shi dam piru temu! Teien thei hena helu! Teien ulen aien helu! Tamma om en eeth som lo!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Tenn Vael. Indexer, Oshkaa. My partner, entered a long turn and more ago. He kept other
people's lives and laughed at his own. He'd have wanted this room.
posts.eshai: Tenn Vael! Oshkaa vendai! Mu thavi, en keth-maar a yai nim vend'onn-esh. Hen oth aien asheth thar a hen asheth rin ahel-esh. Hen ti sil lai-tol.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Tamruk Hesh. He waited a whole turn for me to move once and never said a
word about it.
posts.eshai: Tamruk Hesh! Hen envi mu rum om tamma keth tahli-esh a en loth ma-lo-esh.

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en: Doru, the pilot who hummed. I never knew his other name and now he's here.
posts.eshai: Doru, humu urai! Mu hen oth thei nulvi yul-esh a kev hen hena-esh.

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en: Ushai Nenn, who kept a name to annoy her mother-in-law. My sister.
posts.eshai: Ushai Nenn, hen thavi ammu khethu om thei thar! Mu senu!

posts.author: Veth Kaari
posts.en: My brother, Oskel Kaari, in Paaruk. He built hull nine.
posts.eshai: Mu senu, Oskel Kaari, Paaruk tho! Hen 11-na khul kaal-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Ris of Tovaa. The youngest. Would not give back the lens.
posts.eshai: Tovaa ul Ris! Yai enni! Shel ma-yevi!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Maru and Aanu of Tovaa. They built three roofs.
posts.eshai: Tovaa ul Maru a Aanu! Henen tir kovu kaal-esh.

posts.author: Morai Lenn
posts.en: My grandmother, Temmet Aal. She taught me to grind a lens.
posts.eshai: Mu ossu ammu, Temmet Aal! Hen mu pai shel khom sholu-esh.

posts.author: Tesh Ulaan
posts.en: Everyone I wrote letters to in Oshkaa. The list is long. I've put it here.
posts.eshai: Oshkaa tho mu peshu pevi tamma-ai! Thei-en tahl-esh. Mu hena tavi-esh.

posts.author: Ashaan Moor
posts.en:
Lissu Maal. I didn't know her. Hethra wrote about her garden. I'd like
somebody to have kept the garden.
posts.eshai: Lissu Maal! Mu hen ma-yul-esh. Hethra hen oluma rin thesh-esh. Ossa oluma thar mu lai-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: Kiru Senn, who argued with a door. Aveth Dar, who objected, and was right.
posts.eshai: Kiru Senn, vhaal sa dekh-esh! Aveth Dar, dekh-esh, a eeth-esh!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14054. One heading.

**MAALITH** — The Assembly has answered the hall. The answer is: then keep
us. Not the count. Us: the members of the hall, and anybody they bring, in
their own words, while we can still give them.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14054! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Kel-maar sil pai oveth-ren. Oveth: tekev shi thar! Vend ma! Shi: sil-ai, a henen helu ossa, henen loth sa, shi dam piru temu!

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Kaavi Thren
posts.en: Is this enough? Is a line enough?
posts.eshai: Ti hosh hai? En loth hosh hai?

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: It's more than Theruun got. It's more than Oshkaa got. Keep going.
posts.eshai: Theruun hol som ul yai-esh. Oshkaa hol som ul yai-esh. Ke!

posts.author: Shuunu Paal
posts.en:
Six lamps in the relay hall. Five for places that are gone and one for us.
I trimmed all of them this morning.
posts.eshai: Vhaal-maar sil tho sul ilmir-esh. Pem sheva ru om a en shi om-esh. Mu ti pothu sau tamma shim-esh.

posts.author: Deru Oln
posts.en: Yulen Dar, who entered everyone else.
posts.eshai: Yulen Dar, oth tamma-ai vend'onn-esh!

posts.author: Maavi Ruun
posts.en: Kovel Tann, who was right about the arithmetic and let us shout at him.
posts.eshai: Kovel Tann, vendeth rin eeth-esh a shi hen pai vakh dam-esh!

posts.author: Wessa Thaal
posts.en: Oma Varrek. Hesk is still burning. Somebody should say so.
posts.eshai: Oma Varrek! Hesk ke ruk-ka. Ossa ta lo hesi-tol.

posts.author: Olaa Setth
posts.en:
I'm from the Maalith inner patrol. My name is Olaa Setth, same as a
Theruun commander, which I always hated, because people asked. I'd like to
keep her too. She beat everybody at the ring game.
posts.eshai: Mu Maalith ith pelu-ai ul-esh. Mu thei Olaa Setth-esh, Theruun thar-khul olu, a mu ta tammavi ma-ulen-esh, tolen aien ki-esh. Mu hen yo thar lai-esh. Hen tamma-ai ishaal tho tovu-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: She beat Tamruk in eleven moves. He told us.
posts.eshai: Hen 13 rum-eth tho Tamruk tovu-esh. Hen shi pai vol-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14055. One heading.

**MAALITH** — The hall's members are bringing their names.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14055! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Sil-ai henen thei helu-ka.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Asking the Assembly for the hall's unassigned keystones. The seats kept
for people who were never admitted. I'll say what for when I'm sure it
works.
posts.eshai: Mu Kel-maar pai sil ma-dam onnithen ki-ka. Nulvi hol aien om hed-esh. Mu savo yul temu mu kevai om ho-lo-tol.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
I've put a new map in the hall. It's the cluster as it sounds right now.
Maalith's pulses, and where the other five galaxies used to be, silence,
the same length as their music was. I've listened to it once. I don't think
I'll listen to it again. It's there for whoever does.
posts.eshai: Mu sil tho enni ormeth tavi-esh. Ilumaar kev hollu olu-esh. Maalith tuen-esh, a oth pem ilma anam-esh ru tho nulren, henen tuleth omu tahl-esh. Mu envi ren-esh. Mu ruvi ma-ho-ren-tol mu mael-esh. Ren lai ossa om tena-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Notes toward an unaimed fold. Every fold we have ever made is aimed:
its far end is set before it opens. A first-term student at the academy,
Paelu of Tovaa, once solved a problem wrong by leaving the aim out, and the
fold school kept the answer because the mistake was interesting. The fold
still opens. It goes as far as a fold can reach, in no direction in
particular. You can't choose where it arrives.
posts.eshai: Ma-kithe thaavi om thesh-eth! Shi kaal-esh thaavi tamma kithe-esh: vhen nim hen ir kel-esh. Shol-maar enna sholketh anai, Tovaa ul Paelu, envi kithe ma-hol khelu kieth oveth-esh, a thaavi shol-sil khelu khethi tolen oveth thar-esh. Thaavi ke vhen-tol. Thaavi piru naa pai, lom ma, wa-tol. Kae yeth tei ma-kel-tol.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en: And we want that.
posts.eshai: A shi ta lai-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: We want that. There's nowhere left in Ilumaar to aim at.
posts.eshai: Shi ta lai-esh. Ilumaar tho kithe om ru nul-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Senneth, what are the keystones for?
posts.eshai: Senneth, onnithen kevai om hai?

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14056. One heading.

**MAALITH** — Nemaai has made a new map. It is the sound of Ilumaar now.
Maalith's pulses, and where the other five galaxies were, the silence they
left, measured to the same length as their music was. It is in the hall. It is
very quiet.

Senneth Ilaar reports the hall holds keystones that were never given to
anybody, seats kept for members not yet admitted. She has asked the
Assembly for them. The Assembly has given them to her without asking what
for.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14056! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Nemaai enni ormeth kaal-esh. Kev Ilumaar hollu-esh. Maalith tuen, a oth pem ilma anam-esh ru tho, henen nulren, henen tuleth omu tahl shiru-esh. Sil tho-esh. Shaa nulren-esh.

Senneth Ilaar lo-ren: ke ma-hol sil-ai om hed, sil ossa pai nulvi dam onnithen thar-ka. Hen Kel-maar pai henen ki-ren. Kel-maar, kevai om ma-ki, hen pai dam-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Your first-term problem, Paelu. The wrong answer. The one the fold school
made into a problem of its own.
posts.eshai: Paelu, tei enna sholketh kieth! Khelu oveth! Thaavi shol-sil hen kieth pai kaal oveth!

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: The fold that doesn't go anywhere?
posts.eshai: Kae pai ma-wa thaavi hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
It goes somewhere. It just doesn't go anywhere in particular. You can't
aim it. That's why it was wrong: every fold has to be aimed. I've spent
three turns making it work. I need to send something nowhere in particular,
Paelu, as far as a fold can reach, and your answer is the only one I've
ever seen that does that.
posts.eshai: Kae pai wa-tol. Hen enen kae pai, tiru, ma-wa-tol. Tei kithe ma-piru-tol. Ta tolen khelu-esh: tamma thaavi kithe hesi-esh. Mu tir keth savo-esh. Paelu, mu som kae pai ma, thaavi piru naa pai, pevi hesi-esh, a tei oveth mu esh ta kaal enen oveth-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Send what?
posts.eshai: Kevai pevi hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Seats. The keystones. Every one we never gave anybody. A keystone is a way
in. If anybody, anywhere, ever finds one, they could find the hall. They
could find us. What's left of us.
posts.eshai: Hed-en-esh. Onnithen-esh. Shi ossa pai nulvi dam tamma-esh. Onnith lom-esh. Yem ossa, kae ma kae, envi en vael, henen sil vael-tol. Henen shi, shi ul anam som, vael-tol.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Is there anybody out there?
posts.eshai: Tena ossa anam hai?

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
(1) I don't know. (2) The outer survey looked for as long as there's been a survey, and found nothing. (3) The universe is very
big and very old and everything it does, it has done before, somewhere.
That's the first thing we teach. I'm counting on (3). I can't prove it.
posts.eshai: 1, mu ma-yul-esh. 2, naa wenvend wenvend anam tahl wen-esh, a nul som vael-esh. 3, tamma som shaa tuv a shaa ossu-esh a hen kaal som tamma, kae ma kae, nim kaal-esh. Ta shi enna sholeth-esh. Mu 3 pai onn-ka. Mu shiru ma-piru-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: I wrote "!!" next to that.
posts.eshai: Mu ta shen "!!" thesh-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
The casket: every unassigned keystone from the hall's store. A keystone is
a way into the hall. Anyone who finds one could, in principle, find us:
what's left of us. Each keystone carries one instruction, burned in, in
every notation we have: find anyone.
posts.eshai: Dovi-esh: sil thar ul tamma ma-dam onnith-esh. Onnith sil pai lom-esh. En vael ossa, orth tho, shi ul anam som, shi vael-tol. Tamma onnith en vol-eth, ruk, tamma thesh-lom tho, kavu-esh: ossa vael!

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en: Senneth. You know what an unaimed fold at full reach is.
posts.eshai: Senneth! Piru naa ma-kithe thaavi kevai-esh tei yul-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
I know exactly what it is. It opens a door somewhere we can't see. If it opens onto anything, it opens from a cluster with nothing left alive
in it. Everything here that's alive is in Maalith, and
Maalith has eleven turns. I've thought about it for all of them. I'm
sending it.
posts.eshai: Mu tiru yul-esh. Shi ma-esh ru tho vhaal vhen-tol. Yem som pai vhen, ashe som nul Ilumaar ul vhen-tol. Hena tamma ashe som Maalith tho-esh, a Maalith 13 keth thar-esh. Mu tamma tho mael-esh. Mu pevi-ka.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14057. One heading.

**MAALITH** — The hall is full of names.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14057! En yathi-ren.

Maalith! Sil thei-en tamma-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en:
Fixed the roof. It doesn't leak. I stood under it while it rained. Paelu
was right, it's the best thing to do under a roof.
posts.eshai: Kovu tamu-esh. Uma ma-ye-esh. Uma dop temu mu dor tar-esh. Paelu eeth-esh, kovu dor ta enen vai kaal-esh.

posts.author: Ymmen Das
posts.en:
My name is Ymmen Das. I've read this room for a long turn and never
posted. I'd like to be kept. I liked it here.
posts.eshai: Mu thei Ymmen Das-esh. Mu en keth-maar ti sil leth-esh a nulvi thesh-esh. Mu thar lai-esh. Mu hena ulen-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: You're kept, Ymmen.
posts.eshai: Ymmen, tei thar-esh.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en:
Unaimed fold, bench test: opens, holds, closes. Far-end term: unknown. We
can't measure it. That's the point.
posts.eshai: Ma-kithe thaavi, piru: vhen-esh, onn-esh, vhom-esh. Onn'ir vendu ma-yul-esh. Shi shiru ma-piru-esh. Ta loma-esh.

posts.author: Lemmu Aish
posts.en: Lemmu Aish. Same.
posts.eshai: Lemmu Aish! Omu-esh.

posts.author: Iru Vaas
posts.en: Iru Vaas. Same.
posts.eshai: Iru Vaas! Omu-esh.

posts.author: Sethe Moor
posts.en:
Sethe Moor. I'm the one who always asked for the Hiccup twice. I'm from
Theruun. I was at the academy when it happened. Nobody's asked.
posts.eshai: Sethe Moor! Mu tammavi Ukku dai vi ki ai-esh. Mu Theruun ul-esh. Kaal temu mu Shol-maar tho-esh. Nul-ai ki-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Sethe. We entered you. We thought you were in Theruun. I'm so sorry.
posts.eshai: Sethe! Shi tei vend'onn-esh. Shi tei Theruun tho mael-esh. Mu shaa sehu-esh.

posts.author: Sethe Moor
posts.en: I don't mind. I'm here. Play the Hiccup.
posts.eshai: Mu ma-dekh-esh. Mu hena-esh. Ukku ishu!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Tonight. Twice.
posts.eshai: Ti nokh! Dai vi!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14060. One heading. The Maalith edge relay is late.

**MAALITH** — Nothing.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14060! En yathi-ren. Maalith ir vhaal-maar kheru-ren.

Maalith! Nul som-ren.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en: The Maalith edge relay is late.
posts.eshai: Maalith ir vhaal-maar kheru-ren.

posts.author: Hiraal Ok
posts.en:
Maalith's edge relay is late. The queue up the hill goes all the way to
the lower town.
posts.eshai: Maalith ir vhaal-maar kheru-ren. Hullu ranu ith hemmaar pai wa-ka.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Move 756. Nemaai, it's your move. I'm sorry it's so small.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 756! Nemaai, tei rum-eth! Shaa nu om sehu!

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: It's a good move. I'll answer on the turn.
posts.eshai: Vai rum-eth-esh. Mu keth tho ho-oveth-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Full working for the unaimed fold, below, in the notation, for whoever:
the casket, the keystones, the instruction, the fold. If you are reading
this and you are not one of us: this is how you got here.

(1) The casket. Every unassigned keystone in the hall's store: 1000 of
them. Each is a seat kept for a member not yet admitted. A seat is a
promise.
(2) The keystone. A keystone holds one end of a fold whose other end is the
hall. It opens only to the hall's handshake: the door beneath listens
still; I answer from the far shore. Nothing else opens it, and it opens for
anyone who says it.
(3) The instruction, burned into each: in the common script, in the
notation, in the old hands of all six galaxies, and as numbers, because
numbers are what anyone would read first. Find anyone.
(4) The fold. Paelu's first-term answer: a fold with the aim term left out.
Its far end is not set before it opens. Depth: as far as a fold can reach.
Coupling load at opening: within design, measured. Far-end term: unknown.
It cannot be measured, because there is no far end until the fold arrives
somewhere.
(5) Thovi's bench test, last turn: it opens, it holds, it closes.
(6) What it does. The casket goes through. It arrives nowhere in
particular, further than anything in Ilumaar can see. Then it waits. A
keystone does not age. It can wait as long as Ormaa lasts, and the hall
can listen as long as Ormaa lasts.
(7) What I can't prove: that there is anyone; that they will find one;
that they will read it; that they will answer.
posts.eshai:
Ma-kithe thaavi vendeth tamma, dor tho, thesh-lom tho, ossa om-esh: dovi, onnithen, vol-eth, thaavi-esh. Yem tei ti leth-ka a tei shi ul ma-esh: ti lom tho tei hena yeth-esh.

1, dovi: sil thar tho tamma ma-dam onnith, 1000-esh. Tamma, ke ma-hol sil-ai om, hed-esh. Hed onn-lo-tol.

2, onnith: onnith thaavi en ir onn-esh, a oth ir sil-esh. Sil lo enen hen vhen-esh: Vhaal'ith sorrun ke-tahl! Oveth naa'ir! Oth som hen ma-vhen-esh, a ta lo ossa om vhen-esh.

3, vol-eth, tamma tho ruk: omu thesh-lom tho, thesh-lom tho, sul ilma ossu thesh tho, a vendu tho, tolen ossa vendu enna leth-tol. Ossa vael!

4, thaavi: kithe vendu ma-sa thaavi, Paelu enna sholketh oveth-esh. Hen ir vhen nim ma-kel-tol. Ithen: thaavi piru naa pai-tol. Vhen temu sendu dumu: kaal-eth mesu tho, shiru-esh. Onn'ir vendu: ma-yul-tol. Shiru ma-piru-tol, tolen thaavi kae pai yeth nim ir nul-tol.

5, Thovi mirkaal piru, nim keth: vhen-ren, onn-ren, vhom-ren.

6, hen kaal som: dovi vos wa-tol. Kae ma pai, Ilumaar ul ossa esh ru ul yai naa, yeth-tol. Tekev tahli-tol. Onnith ma-ossu-tol. Ormaa anam temu pai tahli-tol, a sil Ormaa anam temu pai sorr-tol.

7, mu shiru ma-piru som: ossa anam-tol; henen en ho-vael-tol; henen ho-leth-tol; henen ho-oveth-tol.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: The casket works. I'm sending it once the new room is open.
posts.eshai: Dovi savo-esh. Enni sil vhen temu mu ho-pevi-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14061. One heading. The Maalith edge relay is silent.

**MAALITH** — The edge of Maalith is dark. The fold school says the rest will
not take long, now. The academy is open. The Old Glass is open. The hall will
open a room for whatever comes after this digest, and this digest will be
set down there from now on, as long as there is anyone to set it down.

Six headings, 120 turns ago. I have kept each of them until
there was nothing heard to put under it. I kept Yulenai a little longer
than that. I would like it entered that I knew I was doing it.

**THE HALL** — Tharvend reports Ormaa steady.

Heard, and set down. — Oruun
posts.eshai:
Naa-ren 14061! En yathi-ren. Maalith ir vhaal-maar nulren-ren.

Maalith! Maalith ir khaa-ren. Thaavi shol-sil lo-ren: dalu oth, kev, shaa tahl ma-hol-tol. Shol-maar vhen-ren. Ossu Shel vhen-ren. Ti naa-ren dor ye som om sil sil ho-vhen-tol, a vend om ossa anam temu pai, kev ul ti naa-ren tena ho-vend-tol.

120 keth nim sul yathi-esh. Mu tamma, tho tavi ren-eth nul temu pai, thar-esh. Yulenai ta ul yai nu tahl thar-esh. Mu yul-esh, ta vend'onn lai-esh.

Sil! Tharvend "Ormaa orm" vol-ren.

Ren'ren! Vend'esh! Oruun!

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
Digest 14061, continued, in the new room.

This room is for keeping. Say your name and one true thing about yourself.
If you can't, somebody who knew you will say it. If nobody is left who knew
you, I will say what I can. The hall will hold it.
posts.eshai: Naa-ren 14061, enni sil tho, ke! Ti sil thar om-esh. Tei thei a tei rin en eeth som lo! Yem ma-piru, tei yul-esh ossa ho-lo-tol. Yem tei yul-esh nul-ai anam, mu piru som ho-lo-tol. Sil ho-thar-tol.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en:
The hall has opened a new room. It has no name. Tharvend has marked it
with the sign the Index used to put beside a name when it was entered. I
think that's the name. The digest is there now. So am I.
posts.eshai: Sil enni sil vhen-esh. Hen nul thei thar-esh. Tharvend Vend-sil ossa vend'onn temu thei shen tavi shem sa hen tavi-esh. Ta thei-tol mu mael-esh. Naa-ren kev tena-esh. Mu yo-esh.

posts.author: Dannar Weth
posts.en:
Dannar Weth, Speaker of the Assembly of the Count. I voted to cut the relay
to Yulenai. I would do it again, and I have not slept since.
posts.eshai: Dannar Weth, Kel-maar Lo-ai! Mu Yulenai pai vhaal-maar sheth om kel-esh. Mu ruvi ho-kaal-tol, a ul mu ma-munu-esh.

posts.author: Hiraal Ok
posts.en:
Hiraal Ok, keeper of the Old Glass. I have looked through it every night of
my life and I still don't know what I'm looking for.
posts.eshai: Hiraal Ok, Ossu Shel tharai! Mu ashe tho tamma nokh hen vos wen-esh a mu kevai vael-piru ke ma-yul-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en: Move 757. Paelu, your turn. There's no hurry.
posts.eshai: Rum-eth 757! Paelu, tei vi! Tash ma-hesi-tol.

posts.author: Shuunu Paal
posts.en: Shuunu Paal, the relay hall. I kept six lamps lit.
posts.eshai: Shuunu Paal, vhaal-maar sil! Mu sul ilmir ilu thar-esh.

posts.author: Pira Deth
posts.en: Pira Deth. I had a sister and her name was Ushai.
posts.eshai: Pira Deth! Mu senu thar-esh a hen thei Ushai-esh.

posts.author: Hanu Vesh
posts.en: Hanu Vesh. I fixed the roof.
posts.eshai: Hanu Vesh! Mu kovu tamu-esh.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: I know. I'll answer on the turn.
posts.eshai: Mu yul-esh. Mu keth tho ho-oveth-tol.

posts.author: Veth Kaari
posts.en:
Veth Kaari. I read other people's rooms. I'm sorry. I'm not sorry. I'm glad
somebody did.
posts.eshai: Veth Kaari! Mu oth aien silen leth-esh. Sehu! Mu ma-sehu-esh. Ossa ta kaal mu ahi-esh.

posts.author: Ashaan Moor
posts.en:
Ashaan Moor. I never slept well even before. I don't know why I'm telling
you that. It's true.
posts.eshai: Ashaan Moor! Mu nim yo vai ma-munu-esh. Mu kevai tei pai ta vol ma-yul-esh. Eeth-esh.

posts.author: Morai Lenn
posts.en:
Morai Lenn, student. I handed in the problem set. Senneth marked it. I got
the third one wrong.
posts.eshai: Morai Lenn, anai! Mu kieth-en dam-esh. Senneth ta vend-esh. Mu tirna khelu-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en: In an interesting way.
posts.eshai: Khethi lom tho-esh.

posts.author: Tesh Ulaan
posts.en: Tesh Ulaan. I finished every letter.
posts.eshai: Tesh Ulaan! Mu tamma peshu dosh-esh.

posts.author: Kaavi Thren
posts.en: Kaavi Thren. I asked if a line was enough. It's going to have to be.
posts.eshai: Kaavi Thren! Mu "en loth hosh hai?" ki-esh. Hosh ho-hesi-tol.

posts.author: Olaa Setth
posts.en:
Olaa Setth, Maalith inner patrol. Not the famous one. The famous one beat
Tamruk Hesh at the ring game in eleven moves.
posts.eshai: Olaa Setth, Maalith ith pelu-ai! Theimaar Olaa ma-esh. Theimaar Olaa ishaal tho Tamruk Hesh 13 rum-eth tho tovu-esh.

posts.author: Sethe Moor
posts.en: Sethe Moor, of Theruun, the only one. I liked the Hiccup.
posts.eshai: Sethe Moor, Theruun ul, enen en! Mu Ukku ulen-esh.

posts.author: Deru Oln
posts.en: Deru Oln. I don't know what to say. I liked it here too.
posts.eshai: Deru Oln! Mu kevai lo ma-yul-esh. Mu hena yo ulen-esh.

posts.author: Ymmen Das
posts.en: Ymmen Das. Still here.
posts.eshai: Ymmen Das! Ke hena-esh.

posts.author: Thovi Rennet
posts.en:
Thovi Rennet, the fold school. I like things that are interesting. I'd
like to be entered as having said that this was not.
posts.eshai: Thovi Rennet, thaavi shol-sil! Mu khethi somen ulen-esh. Mu "ti khethi ma-esh" lo olu vend'onn lai-esh.

posts.author: Nemaai
posts.en:
Nemaai. I stopped being able to see, and then I heard everything. That's
the true thing. We're in ren-ta'an, anyone who wants to come. The near
stars, over and over. Nobody has to talk.
posts.eshai: Nemaai! Mu esh halo-esh, a tekev tamma som ren-esh. Ta eeth som-esh. Ye lai ossa om, shi ren-ta'an tho-esh. Shen taien ruvi a ruvi ishu-ka. Nul-ai lo hesi-tol.

posts.author: Paelu
posts.en: Paelu, of Tovaa. From Tovaa. I asked why we look.
posts.eshai: Paelu, Tovaa ul! Tovaa ul-esh. Mu "shi kevai wen hai?" ki-esh.

posts.author: Oruun Vael
posts.en: Nobody had an answer small enough to print. You got several.
posts.eshai: Thesh hosh nu oveth nul-ai thar-esh. Tei nuri hol-esh.

posts.author: Senneth Ilaar
posts.en:
Senneth Ilaar, the fold school. I signed the reviews.

The casket's gone. Every keystone we never gave anybody, through an
unaimed fold, as far as a fold can reach, nowhere in particular. Each one
carries the instruction in every notation we have. I'll put it here too, so
it's kept with us.

If you are holding one of these: we were the Eshai. We lived in six
galaxies of the Ilumaar cluster, and we looked at everything, and something
came that we could not stop. It does not speak. It does not want anything.
It cannot be bargained with or fought. It unmakes what is alive and there is
nothing left to keep. If it is where you are, there is nothing you can do
but go where nothing lives. If it is not where you are, we are sorry to
have found you with this.

What's left of us is in the hall. The stone knows the way. Find us.

Find anyone.
posts.eshai:
Senneth Ilaar, thaavi shol-sil! Mu ruvi letheth thei thesh-esh.

Dovi sheva-esh. Shi ossa pai nulvi dam tamma onnith, ma-kithe thaavi vos, thaavi piru naa pai, kae ma pai, sheva-esh. Tamma en vol-eth tamma thesh-lom tho kavu-esh. Shi sa thar om, mu hena yo ho-tavi-tol.

Yem tei ti en thar-ka: shi Eshai-esh. Shi Ilumaar sul ilma tho ashe-esh, a shi tamma som wen-esh, a shi ma-halo-piru som ye-esh. Hen ma-lo-tol. Hen som ma-lai-tol. Hen sa vadu a kharo ma-piru-tol. Hen ashe som ma-kaal-tol a thar om som nul-tol. Yem hen tei anam ru tho-ka, tei nul som ashe ru pai wa enen piru-tol. Yem hen tei anam ru tho ma-ka, shi ti sa tei vael om sehu-esh.

Shi ul anam som sil tho-esh. Onnith lom yul-esh. Shi vael!

Ossa vael!

pinned.title: THE CHARTER OF NAA'SHENAI
pinned.en:
*Pinned by the first keeper. Set down by the fold school of Maalith and the
deep institute of Theruun, eleven long turns and more before the window.*

1. **The hall belongs to no galaxy.** It stands in Nul'ir, where nothing
   lives, so that no people may say it stands on theirs.
2. **The hall speaks one script.** Six galaxies speak six ways. In the hall
   all write the common script, so that no one is a guest in another's
   speech. The keeper will not file what is not written in it.
3. **Every member holds a keystone.** The keystone is the member's way in
   and the hall's way of knowing them. The hall remembers every keystone it
   has issued.
4. **The hall keeps unassigned keystones** for members not yet admitted.
   They are seats, and a seat is a promise.
5. **What is said in the hall is kept.** A member may withdraw what they
   said. The hall keeps that it was said.
6. **The keeper keeps the hall and the record of it.** It takes no side.
   It holds no opinion. Do not ask it for one; it has none to give, and it
   will only file the question.
7. **The door beneath listens.** When a keystone speaks to the hall, the
   hall asks: *the door beneath listens still.* The keystone answers: *I
   answer from the far shore.* Then it is let in.
8. **Nothing in the hall is secret except where it is.** The keeper knows
   where. The keeper will not say.

Signed: for the fold school, **Anvaar Ilaar**. For the deep institute,
**Tethi Dar**. For the hall, the keeper, with the count mark.
pinned.eshai:
Enna tharai tavi-esh. Maalith thaavi shol-sil a Theruun ith maelsil, 13 keth-maar a yai nim, vend-esh.

1: Sil ossa ilma ma-thar-tol. Ossa aien "shi kesu tho tar-esh" ma-lo om, hen Nul'ir tho, kae nul som ashe, tar-tol.

2: Sil en thesh-lom lo-tol. Sul ilma sul lom lo-esh. Oth ai lo-eth tho nul-ai ye-ai olu om, sil tho tamma-ai omu thesh-lom thesh-tol. Tharai ta tho ma-thesh som ma-vend-tol.

3: Tamma sil-ai onnith thar-tol. Onnith sil-ai lom-tol a sil henen yul lom-tol. Sil hen dam onnith tamma annu-tol.

4: Sil ke ma-hol sil-ai om ma-dam onnithen thar-tol. Henen hed-en-tol, a hed onn-lo-tol.

5: Sil tho lo som thar-tol. Sil-ai hen lo som yevi hol-tol. Sil "lo-esh" thar-tol.

6: Tharai sil a hen vend thar-tol. Hen dalu ma-hol-tol. Hen mael-eth ma-thar-tol. Hen pai mael-eth ma-ki! Hen dam om nul thar-tol, a hen kieth enen ho-vend-tol.

7: Vhaal'ith sorr-tol. Onnith sil pai lo temu, sil ki-tol: Vhaal'ith sorrun ke-tahl! Onnith oveth-tol: Oveth naa'ir! Tekev hen vhen-tol.

10: Kae enen ma, sil tho nul som ushi-tol. Tharai kae yul-tol. Tharai ma-ho-lo-tol.

Thaavi shol-sil om, Anvaar Ilaar! Ith maelsil om, Tethi Dar! Sil om, tharai, shem sa!

pinned.title: ISHAAL, THE RING GAME (pinned by Nemaai)
pinned.en:
*"The rules, since Paelu asked. Tamruk will say I've left something out. I
haven't."*

- **The board** is eight rings and eight spokes: sixty-four points where
  they cross. The outermost ring is **the edge**. The innermost is **the
  long ring**, because it is a long way to it.
- **Each player has eight stones.** At the start, one player's stones sit on
  the two outer rings at the even spokes, the other's on the same rings at
  the odd spokes.
- **A move** is one stone, one step: along its ring (either way; the rings
  are round) or along its spoke (in or out), to an empty point.
- **Taking.** A stone is taken when an opponent's stones sit on both sides
  of it along its ring, or on both sides of it along its spoke. You may move
  into a point between two enemy stones without being taken; you are only
  taken by a move.
- **Holding the long ring.** You win when, at the start of your move, four
  of your stones are on the long ring. You also win if your opponent is down
  to two stones.
- **By relay, the custom is one move each per turn.** Games last years. A
  player who misses a move without saying why has conceded, which is why
  nobody ever misses one.

*"The fifth stone is always bait. Everyone knows. Everyone takes it anyway."*

Rum-eth en lith-esh, en lom-esh: hen vhoru sa, kae dalu pai, ma hen peki sa, ith pai ma naa pai, nul ru pai wa-esh. Vhoruen vhoru olu-esh.

Hol: oth ai lithen hen vhoru dai dalu tho, ma hen peki dai dalu tho, tar temu, lith hol-tol. Tei dai oth lith mesu pai rum-tol a ma-hol-tol; rum-eth enen hol-tol.

Tahl vhoru onn: tei rum esa temu tei kaav lith tahl vhoru tho anam yem, tei tovu-tol. Tei oth ai dai lith enen thar yem yo tovu-tol.

Vhaal-maar sa, orth: keth tho en rum-eth tamma-ai-tol. Ishaalen keth-maar tahl-esh. Kevai ma-lo a rum-eth ruth ai tovu dam-esh, a ta tolen nul-ai rum-eth ruth-esh.

pinned.title: HESH ANVAAR'S RULES FOR THE DIGEST
pinned.en:
*Pinned by the third curator. Oruun has never unpinned it.*

1. Print what was heard. What was heard can be checked.
2. Do not print what was told. What was told can only be checked against
   the teller, and the teller is in another galaxy.
3. Read the cluster from the deep edge inward, in the order of the relay.
   Always the same order, so that a reader can find their own galaxy without
   looking.
4. One heading for each galaxy, every turn, even if it says only
   *nothing.*
5. If nothing is heard from a galaxy, print its heading and say so. A
   heading left out is a galaxy left out.
6. The hall's line last. The hall is where the digest is read, not where it
   is made.
7. Sign it. A digest nobody signed is a rumour.
